chapters.title: Chapter 1251: Massacre (1)
paragraphs: Kent appeared behind the Root Immortal, a broad smile playing on his lips. Like he said, killing the 24 forsaken beings will be a pleasure.
His hatred for them is just too much that whenever a forsaken being dies, he feels some sense of accomplishment.
So with his soul map allowing him to teleport, he appeared behind the forsaken immortal without even disturbing the air. Even then, the world had no time to register his movement.
The only thing it captured was the aftermath of the devastating attack he had planned.
His claws gleam coldly, then they descend.
SHRRRKKK
A clean, merciless slice carved through the Root Immortal’s spine. The poor loser didn’t even scream or have the luxury of knowing what went wrong.
His upper body slid forward, lower half collapsing backwards. There was no resistance whatsoever. In an instant, he had a complete body; the next, he was cut in two.
Both halves hit the ground with wet thuds.
Even though he is a forsaken being and not a dragon, the fact that his body was severed in half so easily was just too shocking.
Immortals are meant to be fast and extremely strong in defence. However, Kent’s speed was just too fast, and his attack was just too damaging.
"Like cutting a tofu."
A shockwave of silence rippled through the battlefield.
Only then did the others process what had happened.
Kent grinned, a mocking smile painting his face as he met the gaze of the second. His left claw moved and grabbed the second forsaken Root Immortal by the neck.
"Ssshhhhh, don’t fight it. It will be over before you know."
The third forsaken immortal was on the move, attempting to stop Kent from choking the life out of his friend.
Even if the concept of friendship isn’t something the forsaken race is capable of, the idea that a fellow forsaken being is about to have his neck snapped sure wasn’t something he would accept.
They are fighting the same dragon after all.
So he lunged forward, spear trembling with condensed forsaken qi. He knew snapping the neck of a Root Immortal wasn’t something that could be achieved easily—at least, by his standards.
So even for a second, he lunged forward to stop Kent. His movements were sharp, desperate, fueled by the sudden realisation that Kent was not prey—they were.

He had just killed one of them. Even if they aren’t to the standards of Root Immortals in the Immortal Worlds, they are still Immortals. They have Immortal Platforms with their Immortal Cores hanging on them within their soul.
It is a clear sign that someone with the capabilities of splitting such an Immortal in half is no easy cookie to take for granted.
But Kent didn’t even bother turning. Despite the danger aimed at his life, his smile lingered, and his hold on the forsaken Root Immortal remained firm.𝒻𝑟ℯℯ𝑤𝑒𝑏𝑛𝘰𝓋𝑒𝓁.𝒸𝑜𝘮
Still gripping the second Immortal by the throat, he tightened his claws just slightly. Then, as if he didn’t mean to, he heard a sound.
CRACK.
The neck snapped like brittle wood. The light vanished from the Root Immortal’s eyes before he even realised he was dead. Kent dropped the limp corpse at his feet like discarded trash.
"Tch. Weak."
[Maybe the master should consider the fact that he is too strong for his own good.]
’I only used 20,000 Blood Runes (seals) out of the 50,600. That shouldn’t be enough to snap his neck like a twig. I mean, he is an immortal...he should have at least suffered first’
[That would have been the case if the master were still a human. The master is now a dragon, and as such, his physical strength has already reached a much higher level.]
’I guess you have a point, Tower. But in any case, are Immortals supposed to be this weak?’
[These aren’t exactly Immortals. They are yet to form their Immortal Qi. But even without that, they lack the vital essence in the air needed to harness their ability truly.
However, they are also way stronger than Death stage warriors. So the master should be proud of himself.]
Kent grin.

The third Immortal was nearly upon him now, spear inches from Kent’s side. His eyes are bloodshot, and while still pale since all forsaken beings are naturally pale, his complexion has become even more pale, showing he meant to kill Kent.
But the Chaos Dragon is not about to stand idle and let him have his way.
The third forsaken Root Immortal stabbed forward with his spear. However, Kent lifted his right leg and stomped hard on the ground, causing it to shake violently.
It felt like a giant was the one who stomped on the ground.
A shockwave of glacial force erupted from beneath him, freezing space itself for an instant. The spear froze mid-air, its tip encased in a thick layer of jagged blue ice.
The Root Immortal gasped as frost crawled up his arms.
He tried to harness more energy to break free. However, no matter how hard he tried, Kent’s ice seemed never to want to loosen its grip on him.
"Don’t rush your death. Allow the coldness to seep into your body. Allow it to marinate your bones," Kent said, stepping forward.
His figure vanished again.
A heartbeat later, he appeared with murder in his eyes.
SHNNNNK.
His claw pierced through the third Immortal’s chest from behind, the icy talons jutting out through bone and flesh. Because of the ice, no blood came out.
A whimper escaped the man’s mouth as he looked down at the claw protruding from his sternum.
"Impossible..." he choked, blood freezing before it could spill from his mouth.
Kent leaned closer, whispering into his ear.
"Nothing is impossible, bastard."
He ripped his hand free, letting go of the body as it fell.
The body fell like a puppet whose strings had been cut.
Before the corpse hit the ground, Kent’s eyes lifted to the sky where the fourth and fifth Root Immortals hovered, trembling in fury.
However, he had no time to focus on them since the thousands of dragons that he had scared with his dragon roar finally recovered and attacked in their numbers.

Kent had no idea why these flame dragons chose to side with the forsaken race. Dragons are prideful and arrogant. And from what he knew of them—since he himself is a dragon—the last thing they would want is bowing to another race.
They would never do that.
The only time a dragon bows is to another dragon.
So this peculiar occurrence is one he never saw coming. However, the fact that they picked an empty planet to lay out their ambush told him the dragons had no plans on backing down.
They are fully committed to the forsaken race.
So killing them is also justified. But even if it doesn’t, the fact that they attacked him shows they meant business. So he responded accordingly.
The sky darkened under the shadows of thousands of dragons taking flight, their wings blotting out what little light remained. A deafening chorus of roars erupted, shaking the planet as a whole.
"I gaze upon the stars and see scums of society flying toward their death," Kent’s claws shine brighter, coldness sipping out from them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1252: Massacre (2)
paragraphs: They came in like a sea—scales glimmering, jaws wide, breaths igniting with chaotic flame of fury. All hundreds of thousands of dragons are flame dragons.
Though they have weaker bloodlines, taking on the combined assault of thousands of said dragons is no joke, even for someone like Kent.
In an instant, Kent was swallowed by a storm of killing intent.
The first wave descended like a torrent of collapsing moon.
Tens of thousands of dragon breaths, all fire, merged into a single catastrophic beam aimed at one lone figure below.
Kent planted his foot lightly on the ground, keeping his focus on Atarah (forsaken seer) and the other Root Immortal. She has Immortal Qi, and as a forsaken seer, Kent knew she was a danger.
In fact, she is the only one Kent is wary of. All forsaken Seers are just too crafty and deadly.
However, that doesn’t mean his attention on the dragon beam is any less.
"Hmph." Kent sighed.
He opened his clawed hand, causing a ball of condence ice to form. Then it quietly exploded. A pulse of cold suddenly swept out, creating a cold field.
The field erupted with frost as the barrage slammed into him—or more like into the ice field.
The explosion was so violent that the void split apart for miles. Trenches were carved into the air. The void closed; however, the shockwave went even beyond the planet’s borders.
Yet Kent walked out of the smoke unscathed.
Only a thin layer of frost coated his shoulders, slowly flaking away.
"Your breath stinks." He grinned, clearly unbothered by the attack he had just taken. He is merely using the blood runes to boost his physical strength.
Since he doesn’t have any ability for the ice element yet, the only thing he can do is use it to freeze or defend. Surprisingly, the ice is proving more perfect for defence than the flame could do.
Of course, with his flame core and Nirvana flames, he can be considered a deadly dragon since using just them is enough to raise his offensive power several-fold.
However, since he is getting used to the ice, Kent keeps going until he can’t anymore on it alone. He had yet to tap into the absolute ice property. However, he is already this deadly.
Suddenly, a crimson dragon swooped in from above, maw wide, claws extended to tear him apart. Kent blinked forward—one instant there, the next gone—and appeared on its massive snout.
His claw sliced downward.
SHRRRKK.
The dragon’s head split clean in half, crashing into a herd of its own allies below, creating a crater of devastation.
But that didn’t cause any hesitation from the other dragons. Before the crimson dragon could hit the ground, a massive shadow eclipsed him.

Another dragon, black-scaled and armoured with bone plating, spun mid-air and whipped its tail infused with forsaken qi toward him. The force behind it could level an army of Heavenly Ascension cultivators.
However, Kent merely raised one hand, allowing the tail to hit his palm.
BOOOOOM.
A shockwave burst outward, sending dozens of dragons spiralling away. Kent didn’t budge.
"Too slow. Too weak."
He clenched his fingers, ice forming instantly around the tail. Before the beast could recoil, Kent swung the frozen limb like a club.
CRACK—CRASH!
The dragon was smashed into the ground, body twisting unnaturally as bones shattered under the impact. It didn’t even have the chance to scream.
However, Kent also couldn’t finish it off the way he wanted to.
Hundreds more descended at once, forming a circle around him. Their throats lit up, each preparing another breath attack.
At that time, Kent brought both hands together and formed a hand seal.
He may not have skills and techniques for the ice element, but he had some for the flame element. So, he replicated the runes for a flame technique, but with ice as the energy source.
It was one of Chao’s signature attacks back when he dominated the Blood System.
"Kunpeng Bow..."
Suddenly, the ground shuddered and cracked open, forcing cold and bone-chilling ice to erupt from it. Then from within, a large bow, about 200 meters in diameter, rose.
BOOM
A wave of ice exploded out from it, causing many dragons to freeze midair, then fall, shattering into chunks of ice.

"Although not perfect like with the flame element, with absolute ice, I can bridge that gap." Kent chose not to waste time and activated the absolute ice form, causing the dragons below the Life stage to start falling from the sky, their wings frozen.
Kent flew and landed on the giant bow, his body emitting coldness beyond understanding.
"Stop him," Atarah commanded.
The other forsaken immortal flew into the air and formed a hand seal.
"Forsaken Art: First Form – Sea of Forsaken Swords."

Countless dark blades materialised behind the forsaken immortal—every last sword forged from corrupted qi, each humming with death and destruction. In a breath, the sky turned into a storm of black steel.
The clicking sound of metal vibrating through the air could be heard as the thousands of swords pointed down at Kent.
Just seeing the swords raining down made Kent feel dread.
Thousands of swords rained toward Kent like a tidal wave meant to erase a continent. If this weren’t a battle to the death, Kent would have taken his dear time to examine this technique.
However, sensing his life is in danger, his eyes narrowed.
The bow beneath his feet pulsed once... then thrummed like a heartbeat.
Ice spread outward.
"Kunpeng Bow... Ten Explosive Absolute Ice Arrow."
The giant bow cracked the air as a massive arrow of condensed absolute ice formed in its centre. It shimmered with killing intent so sharp that even without unleashing it, one could sense the danger.
Kent made a simple gesture in the air, but it manifested as pulling the string back with two fingers. The Kunpeng Bow groaned under the weight of unimaginable cold.
The temperature dropped so sharply that dragons in the distance froze mid-flight before they could process what was happening.

Kent tapped into the absolute ice nature of his ice, causing the temperature to drop even further. The absolute ice form of the ice is so dreadful that even the dragons with a cultivation base of Empyrean and Life stage started finding it difficult to approach Kent.
Even staying in the air seems to become a problem. The cold is just too much for them to bear.
The Sea of Forsaken Swords descended.
But Kent didn’t wait for them to reach him. He quickly released the arrow.
BOOOOOOM—
The arrow erupted from the bow like a divine punishment, tearing through the sky with a howl that split clouds apart.
The impact was immediate.
Ice met corrupted steel.
CRRRRRRRRRAAAASH!
The swords didn’t shatter as one would expect. Instead, they froze, then, with a loud explosion, disintegrated into frozen dust and were wiped from existence.
The arrow kept going, exploding continuously, its trajectory unbroken, shooting straight toward the forsaken immortal who had cast the technique.
The nature of the arrow is to explode ten times before completely coming to an end. Every time it explodes, the swords aimed at Kent are affected.
However, it goes beyond that. The shockwave from the explosions spreads far and wide, freezing all whose resistance to ice is weak or just unlucky enough to be much closer to the explosion.
[Master, be on guard, something weird is happening.] Suddenly, before even the arrow could reach the forsaken immortal, Kent heard the tower’s cautious warning in his ever attentive mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 1253: Massacre (3)
paragraphs: Kent’s eyes sharpened the moment the tower’s warning echoed through his mind. His instincts flared all at once, warning him to be wary.
He didn’t expect the Forsaken Immortal to be this crafty. Of course, with the forsaken seer still alive, he knew the other forsaken immortal was merely following her directions.
But even so, Kent was slightly amused by the fact that the forsaken immortal couldn’t have made his move when he was under the assault of the dragons.
Why wait until a deadly, explosive arrow heads his way before making a move?
That, in a way, didn’t make sense to Kent. However, he also didn’t take the threat the tower warned him about for granted.
If anything, there is this inkling at the back of his mind telling him he had forgotten something. But no matter how hard he thought, he couldn’t figure out what.
So he put it at the back of his mind and wished it wasn’t something life-threatening.
The ninth explosion of the arrow went off in the sky, sending shockwaves of absolute ice across the battlefield. Dozens more dragons froze mid-flight and shattered into icy fragments.
Some were forced to retreat, barely keeping their lives.
But the tenth explosion never came. It was supposed to be the loudest and the most impactful.
Instead, the arrow vanished.
Not shattered.
Not deflected.
It simply blinked out of existence, as if it never existed.
Kent’s pupils constricted. ’That’s new.’
[That is the power of the void, master. All immortals can learn the laws of the universe, and it seems this forsaken immortal knew something about the void.]
’How envious,’ Kent’s intent, will, and need to kill the forsaken immortal had just taken a sudden leap. Hearing the bastard could wield the power of the void made him frown.
A tear formed in space where the arrow had been—thin, jagged, pulsing with a strange darkness. An eerie energy that isn’t quite a void poured out of the tear.
From within that tear, a hand emerged.
It was pale, long-fingered, and marked with dozens of black runes swirling beneath the skin. It is ugly as fuck.
The forsaken immortal whom the arrow should have hit appeared unharmed, stepping out of the void as though walking through a doorway.
His eyes were pitch black, and in them swirled a power Kent recognised instantly.
"Void Energy."
He muttered, genuinely feeling envious of the bastard for possessing some power of the void.

Of course, Kent could also use the void; however, it was linked to a sword gaze skill. So while he could easily harness the void to unleash thousands of other sword attacks, he himself could not interact with it.
He learned that at the Heavenly Ascension stage, a cultivator could harness the power of the void; however, he later found that to do so, one must possess innate talent for it.

His innate talent is in the Chaos energy, one of the strongest and most devastating elements in existence. So while he has the energy to back up void manipulation, he lacks the talent for it... at least for the time being.
But that didn’t mean he wasn’t jealous of those who could harness it. Even his pal Uncle Drake (the flame dragon he saved back in the Sea of Flames) can harness it.
So he could only look at the bastard, who exuded the power of the void. Looking at his pale face, unsure if exhaustion was on there, made him feel somewhat angry.
Of course, the energy isn’t the ordinary kind.
This was Forsaken Void Authority. He was using a technique to harness the void.
Kent clicked his tongue. "Of course, what a loser."
The Root Immortal smiled, but his expression cracked unnaturally at the corners, as though his face wasn’t built to mimic emotion.
This sight angered Kent even further, but the forsaken immortal seemed to be enjoying this sight.
"You wielded absolute ice," he rasped, barely containing his twisted grin. "Impressive. But you lack understanding. For us forsaken beings... the void is our birthright."
He lifted his bony hand.
The frozen fragments of the destroyed swords vibrated... then reversed direction, pulled toward the void tear like metal to a magnet.
They were being eaten, or so it seemed.
However, Kent knew he was pulling back his energy for what he had planned.
Kent’s jaw tightened. "Annoying."
He shot forward without warning.
BOOM!
The sky screamed as he moved, tearing through space, his claws coated in a terrifying mix of ice and compressed dragon force.
He could have teleported to the bastard. However, with the void torn open, using teleportation runs the risk of falling into the void.
Space becomes fragile and unstable whenever the void is opened, so he chose to face it using his speed, which he had boosted with flame veins.

He didn’t even use a quarter of his 120,000 flame veins, since that speed would further destabilise space, this risk widening the tear in the void. He merely chose to go as fast as the eye could track.
The forsaken immortal lifted two fingers, and the void rippled. Then from within, a thick, dark and horrific skull appeared.
’Ah, I hate this,’ Kent smirked in annoyance as he attacked the skull with deadly force.
However, despite his attack possessing the power to split a Root Immortal in half, his claw passed straight through it and even through the skull of the forsaken immortal without injuring it or him.
The immortal’s body wavered like smoke, splitting into dozens of after-images.
Behind Kent, he appeared, a pale smile playing on his lips.
"Forsaken Art: Second Form – Hollow Grave."
A spherical collapse of space shuddered into existence behind Kent, threatening to swallow him whole.
He manifested his tail, appearing in its dense and metallic form.𝒻𝘳ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝒷𝘯ℴ𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝑐ℴ𝑚
It lashed instinctively, wrapping around the incoming singularity. Although he didn’t know exactly what was happening, his reaction speed was fast enough to come into play when needed.
It froze instantly. Absolute ice spread across the Hollow Grave, cracking it like fragile stone.
BOOM!
The singularity shattered like frozen glass. It was immediate and, quite frankly, very devastating to watch.
A shriek tore through the battlefield as the forsaken immortal staggered, clutching his head.
"Impossible... void cannot be frozen..."
Kent smirked and raised one hand.
"Bitch, please. Everything can be frozen."
He vanished again, not teleported, just plain speed that felt like teleportation.
This time, he reappeared much closer to the forsaken immortal, claws already descending.
The forsaken immortal reacted with desperation, slashing his palm through the air.
A thin void blade swept through Kent’s torso.
SHHHHRRRK!
Lines split into his scales, cutting his flesh—only to freeze immediately, halting the damage.
Kent didn’t flinch.
"My turn."
His claw tore upward, ripping through the forsaken immortal’s shoulder, chest, and jaw in one brutal motion. Cuts appeared on his body.
Kent stepped back and snapped his finger, causing the air to shimmer with frost and cold.
Ice exploded along the wounds, coldness seeping deep into his body.
The immortal screamed as half his body froze in midair, spreading rapidly. Kent smirked and instantly moved to finish the job.
However, he froze mid-flight when someone suddenly grabbed his leg.
"Ah shit."

Why wait until a deadly, explosive arrow heads his way before making a move?
That, in a way, didn’t make sense to Kent.

chapters.title: Chapter 1254: Massacre (4)
paragraphs: Kent completely forgot about the 3rd Forsaken Immortal he came close to killing before the 4th Forsaken Immortal attacked him with the thousands of dark steel swords.
In his mind, the bastard had died in the chaos of the moment. After all, the state he left him in wasn’t encouraging.
However, now gripping his leg is the same Forsaken Immortal. However, while Kent could stomp him, possibly freezing his head into a block of ice, he had no time for that.
After all, the forsaken immortal had already initiated his core, aiming to use core explosion to take Kent with him.
Kent turned to face the Forsaken Seer, only to see a sneer on her pale face. This was all her doing.
Kent’s tail whipped, and his dragon wings appeared while still in his humanoid form.
"Ah shit."
BOOOOOOOM
He was swallowed in a megastorm of flame, one that pushed thousands of dragons back, some burning to ash in the process.
The megastorm of flame consumed everything.

The sky became a sun—one born from the detonation of a dying Immortal’s core. The spectacle is just too devastating. If one were looking from outer space, they would have seen a dull blue planet suddenly turn crimson red.
The sight, while beautiful in some way, felt very dangerous.
Space warped. Mountains melted. The ground split open into rivers of molten lava.
The air is filled with howling, roaring and screaming.
Dragons screamed as the shockwave flung them in every direction, scales peeling off, wings tearing, some reduced to drifting ash, taken away by the aftershock waves.
In an instant, tens of thousands of dragons died — wasting precious tower points.

Atarah’s white hair whipped violently in the inferno, but she stood firm behind her formation, Immortal Qi shielding her from the brunt of the explosion. Even so, a line of blood dripped from her nose.
"Burn, you miserable dragon..." she hissed, her hatred for Kent evident.
She may have wanted Kent to become a vessel to summon a Forsaken King from the Immortal Realm. However, from what Kent had shown so far, killing him is the only way.

She had seen and even sensed that Kent hated her kind more than most cultivators he had met. This gave her a bad premonition, so she aimed for him to be killed before he grew up into a creature that could not be handled.
The flames raged, burning even brighter. From how vast and devastating it was, nothing, nobody should be able to survive such devastation.
The explosion of an Immortal core could level cities, shatter planets and even, when done right, kill thousands of Immortals.
So, such an explosion, while it isn’t encouraging, wasn’t enough to discourage the forsaken race, who sensed the danger from this dragon.
They didn’t bat an eye to put him down before he became a problem.
Kent may be a dangerous adversary, but such an explosion is promised to kill even him, regardless of what defence he musters.
"Did we get him?" Atarah asked the other Forsaken Immortal. They are the only Immortals left in this gory battle of futility.
The Forsaken Immortal raised his shoulder, unsure. However, he—they—became sure the next second.
"Oh, sweetheart, you have no idea who you are up against, do you?"
Kent’s cold voice, followed by a low rumble, echoed from within the inferno.
Not the roar of a dragon...
This one was a growl.
Very deep. So deep.
Incredibly ancient and menacing.
Only beings from the Primordial Era would have recognised that growl. Back in the day, they used to say, when you hear the growl, run.
It is a sign that the Chaos Dragon is angry.
Atarah’s eyes widened. "Impossible—he should be dead! You should be dead. The explosion should have killed you."
A bolt of ice-blue light erupted from the centre of the inferno, splitting the storm of flame apart like an executioner’s axe. Suddenly, a rather menacing chill coursed down everyone’s spine.
FWOOOOOOM
A massive pillar of absolute ice surged upward, freezing fire itself. The surging flame halted mid-bloom, flames locked in place like crystalline flowers of death.
Everything came to a halt. The remaining dragons felt their bloodlines rejecting them at the sound of that growl.
The sky dimmed as frost overtook everything within thousands of meters.
Dragons fell from the air, wings frozen solid, bodies shattering upon impact.
Even the Forsaken Immortal, wielding void energy, trembled, backing away instinctively.
A shadow walked out of the crystallised inferno, each step freezing the very ground. In fact, every step seemed to freeze, then shatter the ground.𝑓𝘳𝘦𝑒𝑤𝑒𝘣𝘯ℴ𝘷𝘦𝓁.𝑐𝑜𝑚
Kent walked out, looking menacing. He harnesses the power of absolute ice, dragon scales and dragon wings to defend against the explosion.

However, this time, he didn’t walk out unscathed like he used to. His left arm was burned down to exposed bone, scales cracked and bleeding, parts of his torso scorched black. But he was alive, cold energy healing him slowly.
His eyes were no longer calm.
No longer amused.
They were draconic.
Slitted and very angry.
In a way, Kent felt humiliated that he was injured this badly despite having the upper hand from the start. To a prideful dragon, that was a huge insult, and his hatred and anger could now be felt.
He summoned 20,000 blood runes, humming to life with chilling blood qi. He quickly merged them all into the parts he was injured in.
Of course, he aimed to heal faster, but even without the blood qi, his Eternal Draconic Physique had already started healing him.
However, with the augmentation of his blood runes, the regeneration speed has skyrocketed. This startled the dragons and the remaining forsaken beings.

"That wasn’t cool," Kent muttered, his expression turning cold. "A while back, I had the pleasure of thwarting a forsaken invasion in the medium world... I even came close to killing a Forsaken Lord. Oh, what a pleasure that was."
Atarah’s eyes narrowed... "So that was you? You were the one who injured Lord Bram."
Kent smiled, "Can’t say I enjoyed it as much as I would have liked. That was because by the time I arrived, most of my people had been killed by your kind.

However, in the end, you failed. That was a win for me, but as I said, I didn’t enjoy it as much as I wanted to, considering my hatred for your kind can never be satiated until every last one of you ugly fuckers is dead."
Kent looked at the parts of his body that were injured and smiled.
He is almost healed.
"I was having fun. Now I’m pissed."
He growled lowly, but his tone sent shivers down everyone’s spine...
Kent turned toward Atarah and said coldly, "I expected you to summon more powerful beings by now. However, it seems I overestimated you. You are just a disgrace to the forsaken seers I knew.
You were supposed to be crafted and unpredictable. However, since you are none of that, I will be sending you on your way.
And guess what, I will cherish every last minute of it."
ROAR
Kent abandoned his humanoid form and transformed into his colossal dark-golden dragon form.
"Death is the only way." His deep, draconic voice spread far and wide.
Flames burst out of Kent’s colossal form, instantly suppressing everyone.
"Flame Baptism."
What followed were screams of agony...

chapters.title: Chapter 1255: End of the Massacre
paragraphs: "STOP"
"PLEASE... STOP"
"PLEASE..."
Screams and tears of anguish filled the small planet where Kent, in his Dragon form, was baptising the pitiful dragons in the unholy radiance of his [Primordial Chaos Soul Flames.]
Kent was not paying attention to anyone. If anything, the more they screamed, called for help, or tried to run, the more energetic he became.
It felt like their tears were fueling his flame, their pain soothing his cold heart, and their screams pushing him to do more, allowing him to incinerate the dragons’ forms.
Be it the full-on dragons, demi-dragons, and even those who lowered their forms to appear more human, Kent wasn’t discriminating.
All of them are burning, and the more he flew by, the higher the screams.
His now golden green Chaos flame was spewing everywhere, and with it, screams of pain filled everything.
Some tried to fight back. However, with Kent tapping into the combined power of 35,000 blood runes and 50,000 flame veins, all resistance was futile.
That is more than enough to give him the power to face a Spirit Immortal with complete Immortal Qi.
Naturally, that means the dragons and forsaken beings ambushing him aren’t at his level to resist. Not that anyone had a chance from the start, to begin with.
Kent played it cool at the start of the battle, not because he was weak or because he loved playing with his enemies.
Kent isn’t that. He loves to end his battles quickly and decisively. Whenever he gets an opening, he goes for the kill and always makes sure he has the upper hand.
So for him to start a battle slowly—which in fact wasn’t slow in any way, considering he killed quite a lot of dragons and even three immortals—means there is a reason.
In truth, the reason was simple. Kent placed the forsaken seer on the same level of danger as the ones he knew in the past.
He hadn’t met a forsaken seer in his life as the Chaos Dragon; however, he had met one as the Faceless Assassin, so he knew what kind of people they are.
He also researched them in that life, and from what he found, they are dangerous adversaries.
So Kent placed this one in the same category as them. He gave her a status that should’ve been worthy of her name. However, things turned out disappointing.
He expected a powerful foe, only to be disappointed.
It seemed this forsaken seer doesn’t live up to her name. A rather disappointing outcome considering a being of her calibre was supposed to give Kent a run for his money.
Of course, she came close to killing him with the core explosion. However, that was just it...a somewhat disappointing outcome.
In under 13 minutes, the remaining dragons were reduced to a pile of ash, charred meat, burnt corpses, and a lot of groaning from those who were yet to die despite being burned by Chaos Flames.
Kent’s flame had already reached a Flame Harmony stage, so it is very powerful. He made this progress during his time in hell.
Back when he was training at the core of the Damned Hell Sea, his flame comprehension reached the Perfect Harmony stage.
However, because he had yet to get the chance to comprehend the flame law, he was still stuck at the Harmony stage.𝒇𝙧𝙚𝓮𝔀𝓮𝒃𝙣𝓸𝒗𝒆𝒍.𝙘𝒐𝒎
If he acquired knowledge of flame law, he would be able to elevate the rank of his flame to Absolute Flame. That would be the same stage he was lucky enough to reach after awakening his Ice element.
For now, the reason why his flame element is so much more potent in the offensive mode is that his soul flame has now become a Primordial Soul Flame.
He absorbed a high-level primordial hell flame to form his core and, in doing so, transformed his soul flame into a high-level primordial soul flame.
So, while only at the Harmony stage, the fact that the quality of his flame is actually at the High-Level Primordial Flame stage makes all the difference.
If only his Ice element were also of the same quality, then perhaps only the gods could defend against an ice blast from him.
THUD
A loud thud hit the ground as Kent descended and landed, flames burning all over his majestic dragon scales.
The only ones standing are the Forsaken Seer and the last Forsaken Immortal, who is moaning from the sheer pain he is going through at the moment.
He tried to play hero, only to get burned on his face, chest, and back.
Kent—still in his dragon form—looked down at the forsaken seer, his draconic eyes slitting as if looking into her soul. The latter looked terrified beyond her comprehension.
She doesn’t know why, but when Kent took on his dragon form, she felt deep in her blood a fear that she shouldn’t have felt... not in this body, at least.
However, as she met Kent’s chilling, draconic gaze, her fear deepened. She would love to understand everything, but in the end, she had no idea what was happening to her.
"I know you are scared of me... good. I want you scared when you wake up in your real body."
The forsaken seer narrowed her gaze, a surprising washing over her like she had heard her deepest, darkest secret.
"Don’t look so surprised. I may be a dragon, but that doesn’t mean I have a muscle for a brain. Though I have to be frank, when I first saw you, I had no idea.
I mean, how was it that a clone of a True Immortal was able to harness immortal qi? I mean, clones, unless perfect clones, shouldn’t be able to do that.

But you did. Not that it is needed, but commended at least. In any case, I only have one question before I kill you." Kent paused and let Atarah take in a deep breath since that would be her last, at least in this clone body.
Who knows how many of those she has scattered all over the universe?

"Where are the four foxkins you took from Planet Modu?" Kent asked, his tone deep like a dragon should. He had already figured out that the curse on Aala’s mother came from Atarah, so the only thing left for him was to find the others.
She looked at Kent and smirked coldly before responding... "Go to hell."
"With pleasure."
"AAAAAAAAARGH"
Screams of pain followed. Since she refused to answer, Kent didn’t waste time and engulfed both her and the last remaining forsaken immortal in flames.

He had already planted the [Soul Torture] skill in the two of them, so with their death, their memories became his. And now that he can store memories inside the [Soul Universe], he would be able to go through them slowly and efficiently.

Soon, every last soul died after Kent went all over the planet, burning everything in sight. It was after he was sure every last dragon was dead that he transformed back to his humanoid form, wings and tail deactivated.
Only his horns remained.
"What a hassle," he said, looking all over the scorched battlefield.
’Elaine, you can start healing her.’

sentences.text: "STOP"
"PLEASE...
STOP"
"PLEASE..."
Screams and tears of anguish filled the small planet where Kent, in his Dragon form, was baptising the pitiful dragons in the unholy radiance of his [Primordial Chaos Soul Flames.]
Kent was not paying attention to anyone.
If anything, the more they screamed, called for help, or tried to run, the more energetic he became.
It felt like their tears were fueling his flame, their pain soothing his cold heart, and their screams pushing him to do more, allowing him to incinerate the dragons’ forms.
Be it the full-on dragons, demi-dragons, and even those who lowered their forms to appear more human, Kent wasn’t discriminating.
All of them are burning, and the more he flew by, the higher the screams.
His now golden green Chaos flame was spewing everywhere, and with it, screams of pain filled everything.
Some tried to fight back.
However, with Kent tapping into the combined power of 35,000 blood runes and 50,000 flame veins, all resistance was futile.
That is more than enough to give him the power to face a Spirit Immortal with complete Immortal Qi.
Naturally, that means the dragons and forsaken beings ambushing him aren’t at his level to resist.
Not that anyone had a chance from the start, to begin with.
Kent played it cool at the start of the battle, not because he was weak or because he loved playing with his enemies.
Kent isn’t that.
He loves to end his battles quickly and decisively.
Whenever he gets an opening, he goes for the kill and always makes sure he has the upper hand.
So for him to start a battle slowly—which in fact wasn’t slow in any way, considering he killed quite a lot of dragons and even three immortals—means there is a reason.
In truth, the reason was simple.
Kent placed the forsaken seer on the same level of danger as the ones he knew in the past.
He hadn’t met a forsaken seer in his life as the Chaos Dragon; however, he had met one as the Faceless Assassin, so he knew what kind of people they are.
He also researched them in that life, and from what he found, they are dangerous adversaries.
So Kent placed this one in the same category as them.
He gave her a status that should’ve been worthy of her name.
However, things turned out disappointing.
He expected a powerful foe, only to be disappointed.
It seemed this forsaken seer doesn’t live up to her name.
A rather disappointing outcome considering a being of her calibre was supposed to give Kent a run for his money.
Of course, she came close to killing him with the core explosion.
However, that was just it...a somewhat disappointing outcome.
In under 13 minutes, the remaining dragons were reduced to a pile of ash, charred meat, burnt corpses, and a lot of groaning from those who were yet to die despite being burned by Chaos Flames.
Kent’s flame had already reached a Flame Harmony stage, so it is very powerful.
He made this progress during his time in hell.
Back when he was training at the core of the Damned Hell Sea, his flame comprehension reached the Perfect Harmony stage.
However, because he had yet to get the chance to comprehend the flame law, he was still stuck at the Harmony stage.𝒇𝙧𝙚𝓮𝔀𝓮𝒃𝙣𝓸𝒗𝒆𝒍.𝙘𝒐𝒎
If he acquired knowledge of flame law, he would be able to elevate the rank of his flame to Absolute Flame.
That would be the same stage he was lucky enough to reach after awakening his Ice element.
For now, the reason why his flame element is so much more potent in the offensive mode is that his soul flame has now become a Primordial Soul Flame.
He absorbed a high-level primordial hell flame to form his core and, in doing so, transformed his soul flame into a high-level primordial soul flame.
So, while only at the Harmony stage, the fact that the quality of his flame is actually at the High-Level Primordial Flame stage makes all the difference.
If only his Ice element were also of the same quality, then perhaps only the gods could defend against an ice blast from him.
THUD
A loud thud hit the ground as Kent descended and landed, flames burning all over his majestic dragon scales.
The only ones standing are the Forsaken Seer and the last Forsaken Immortal, who is moaning from the sheer pain he is going through at the moment.
He tried to play hero, only to get burned on his face, chest, and back.
Kent—still in his dragon form—looked down at the forsaken seer, his draconic eyes slitting as if looking into her soul.
The latter looked terrified beyond her comprehension.
She doesn’t know why, but when Kent took on his dragon form, she felt deep in her blood a fear that she shouldn’t have felt... not in this body, at least.
However, as she met Kent’s chilling, draconic gaze, her fear deepened.
She would love to understand everything, but in the end, she had no idea what was happening to her.
"I know you are scared of me... good.
I want you scared when you wake up in your real body."
The forsaken seer narrowed her gaze, a surprising washing over her like she had heard her deepest, darkest secret.
"Don’t look so surprised.
I may be a dragon, but that doesn’t mean I have a muscle for a brain.
Though I have to be frank, when I first saw you, I had no idea.
I mean, how was it that a clone of a True Immortal was able to harness immortal qi?
I mean, clones, unless perfect clones, shouldn’t be able to do that.
But you did.
Not that it is needed, but commended at least.
In any case, I only have one question before I kill you." Kent paused and let Atarah take in a deep breath since that would be her last, at least in this clone body.

chapters.title: Chapter 1256: Fortuitous Encounter and Gains
paragraphs: As always, everything must come to an end, and as such, the battle between Kent and the Forsaken Seers ended like Kent wanted.
Of course, there were some hiccups here and there. However, Kent wanted them all dead, so he ensured the end matched the outcome he envisioned.
They are all dead from both his hand and that of the immortal core explosion.

However, one of the hiccups was the fact that he couldn’t clear his debt as he had envisioned. Per the calculation the tower made, if he were to kill every last warrior, the amount of tower points he would have earned would have been enough to clear his debt.
He did kill all, but the outcome wasn’t as he expected.
Despite all dragons and forsaken beings dying, he is still 1.2 billion tower points in debt. Naturally, that was because of the Immortal Core explosion.
That explosion had killed more dragons than he would have wanted. And since he wasn’t the one who made the kills, the tower points that should have come from them didn’t.
In fact, their death also wasted precious ’Blood Essence’ and ’Soul Spirits’.

To earn a tower point, Blood Essence or Soul Spirit, Kent was supposed to be the one to do the kill. Of course, in the aspect of Soul Spirit and tower points, if his legion and wives kill, he can collect them.
All linked to him adds to the tower point and soul spirits. So if Vexthra ended up killing a god, Kent will earn tower points and the soul spirit from that kill.
However, in an open battle like this, the one who earns the loot is only Kent, so when the core exploded and thousands died, they didn’t count as Kent’s kills.
This deprived him of precious tower points to clear the debt he owes Gaia.
But he had cleared 2.2 billion off his debt, which is more than enough to keep him going for now.
Kent walked to a block and coated it with ice before sitting down. He looks at the horizon and lets out a deep breath.
The battle is over, but he doesn’t seem satisfied.
He had just killed a clone of a True Immortal who he thought would have given him a run for his money. However, in the end, she was such a disappointment.
The battle as a whole was a huge disappointment.
But Kent also knew she would notice him now, and soon, she would come after him in her True Body. Maybe then, he would get to experience the power of a forsaken seer.
But while the battle wasn’t up to the standard of a forsaken battle, Kent had discovered something dangerous that the rest of the universe should be made aware of.
The forsaken race is making moves in the shadows, and if the universe doesn’t do anything, soon, the Forsaken War will happen again, and this time, the universe will find itself in grave danger.
The forsaken race was only sealed by Arien’s past self during the Primordial Era.
She never placed a limit on their growth—she couldn’t. So they had been growing since the Primordial Era and multiplying.

One day, they would come, and Kent, inasmuch as he would love to slaughter them then since his campaign had always been to kill the forsaken race, wasn’t blinded by hatred anymore, so he knew he had to draw the universe’s attention to this.
’I will do my best. If nobody listens, then it will be on them.’
He took another deep breath and tapped into his status page to see the gains he had received after absorbing thousands of Blood Essence into his first blood core...
’Although my first core isn’t saturated yet, I feel so powerful now.’
[You have absorbed enough Blood Essence to level up. Spirit Lord Level 4]
[You have absorbed enough Blood Essence to level up. Spirit Lord Level 5]
[You have absorbed enough Blood Essence to level up. Spirit Lord Level 5]
[You have absorbed enough Blood Essence to level up. Heavenly Ascension Level 4]
Upon reading the messages, a pale smile spread across Kent’s handsome face. He had taken a massive leap toward the Heavenly Ascension stage in just 13 minutes.

The unholy baptism of chaos flame was so violent that within minutes, thousands had died. And since he has the tower and the Soul Universe to handle the Blood Essence absorption, he just ranked up like a madman.
’This is indeed like the fortuitous encounter many talk about. Who knew that in the pursuit of scum who like to prey on the weak would land me in such a Blood Essence farming?’

Kent didn’t even know how to feel about the progress he had made. He at least expected to reach the peak of the Spirit Lord stage; however, in the end, killing four immortals tended to have so many more benefits than he anticipated.

’Hmm, let’s hope I can hold my own against those immortals when we go to save Kaelith. If I can kill just a dozen immortals, I might just saturate the first blood core and even take steps toward saturating the second blood core.
But even if I couldn’t do much, the fact that I will get to see how strong immortals are would be of great help to what Vexthra hinted at.’
’Kent, I have saved her meridians and put her in an induced coma. Unfortunately, her little daughter was so heartbroken that she passed out.
This is why you should kill the person involved slowly and painfully. I hate people who hurt the innocent.’ Elaine’s furious voice entered Kent’s mind, causing a pale smile to appear on Kent’s face.
[The battle is over, my love. However, rest assured, I will find a way for us to get our revenge.]
Elaine nodded, pacing back and forth inside a room where Aala and her mother were soundly asleep.𝓯𝓻𝒆𝙚𝒘𝓮𝙗𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝒍.𝙘𝓸𝙢
Since the one involved is dead, the curse can now be broken. Liora was working on that as they spoke.
’When do you plan on returning?’ Elaine asked.
[Gaia is still not done with the city for the Sky Foxes, so I will hang around for a few hours to check a few things. When she is done, I will meet you ladies on Planet Tianxu.]
’Okay. Take care.’
[I will, my love.]
After the connection was severed, Kent turned back to the tower since, aside from levelling up quickly, he had also gained a new ability for his Soul Universe.
He quickly assessed that.
⟦Soul Weapons⟧
⟦Rank: Divine⟧
⟦Description: For every soul absorbed into the Soul Universe, you can now turn them into deadly one-time-use-only weapons of choice.
↠ The longer the weapons remain tempered in the confines of your Soul Universe, the stronger and deadlier they become.
↠ Note: The rank of the soul consumed determines the grade of the weapon. You can also merge multiple souls to form a more powerful Soul Weapon.⟧
’Well, isn’t this convenient?’ Kent smiled happily.

chapters.title: Chapter 1257: Soul Universe
paragraphs: Although Kent had found other uses for the Soul Universe, so far, he had only awakened three abilities for it.
The first ability allows him to convert Soul Essence into creating deadly weapons.
The Soul Universe grows by absorbing Soul Essence. That essence absorbed can be used to create any form of weapon Kent wants, provided he has a clear picture of what he wants to make.

Of course, there are better uses for the Soul Essence. However, as someone whose life is destined to be full of dangers, the [Soul Creation] ability is better used for making weapons for both offence and defence.
At the moment, he had created seven 40,000km wide asteroids, and over 3000 meteors that he keeps tempering inside his soul for when he will need them.

He had other weapons, but the major ones at the moment are the asteroids and the meteorites. He expected to use it during the just-ended battle. But in the end, his blood runes, flame veins, flame and ice elements were enough.
But should a day come when even his 50,600 blood runes and 120,000 flame veins won’t be enough, then he would unleash his trump cards.
The second ability is the [Soul Map], which allows him to see an 80,000km radius without even trying. This ability came when he needed it during his time in the [Valley of Torture].
Of course, back then, he was merely a Core Formation warrior. However, even after becoming a Heavenly Ascension Stage warrior, the distance hasn’t extended as one would expect.
It is still the same 80,000km radius. However, he can now see more details than before.
Back inside the [Flame Sea], there were many occasions where he failed to see the targets until they were much closer. Even Kaelith succeeded in sneaking up on him.
The tower explained that it was because his cultivation was lower than his opponent’s.
However, after this breakthrough, not even Death Stage warriors can sneak up on him now. He had become so much more powerful.
He is more afraid of Spirit Immortals sneaking up, but even so, he knew he had nothing to fear since, aside from sensing the body, the Soul Map also senses killing intent, shadows, and energy leaks.
This makes it impossible to be snuck up on, even by peak Root Immortals. Once he meets a Spirit Immortal, he will know what to think.
He can also share the Soul Map vision with those he wants to. He can even use the Soul Map to communicate with anyone he wants without their permission.
Aside from that, the Soul Map allows him to see openings in the opponent’s attacks and employ them to kill without having to test many possibilities.
The Soul Map has many other uses, but for now, these are the only uses Kent could harness.
Now, he had awakened a new ability: [Soul Weapons].
Basically, this new ability works the same as the [Soul Creation].
However, instead of creating weapons from Soul Essences, with this new ability, he can easily transform ’Soul Spirits’ into weapons, and then the Soul Essence will be used to temper them.
Basically, this ability simply found a use for the Soul Spirits that Kent had been collecting after finding out he could store them inside his Soul Universe.
Now, he has hundreds of thousands of Soul Spirits that have been getting tempered by the Soul Essence for a while now. He had used some as Haunting Souls back in the Flame Sea.

However, now, he had found a way, actually, to turn those souls into weapons. So, whether he keeps them as Haunting Souls, now, instead of merely using them as soul bombs for the [Soul Explosion] ability that came with the [Soul Map], he can do more.

He can pick ten Heavenly Ascension Stage Soul Spirits and transform four into one legendary soul warrior, transform three into a soul armour to cover the soul warrior, then transform the remaining three into a deadly soul weapon, like a sword or scythe.
If this happens, not only would this soul warrior be a legendary combatant, but in the end, Kent can even explode their body, armour, and weapon, creating an explosion akin to ten Tier 19 souls.
Of course, once a soul weapon is destroyed, it never returns to the Soul Universe again.

However, Kent, who always seeks quality over quantity, knew that if a lot of effort were put into creating powerful soul weapons, then worrying about them getting destroyed would be the last of his worries.
"This is a great ability. It is a way of creating legendary warriors from the souls of those I have killed. I will be giving them purpose, and that purpose would be to fight for a better universe."
Kent made a fist and raised it.
"I can already see a legion of Soul Warriors and Soul Weapons pouring from a dark portal, radiating nothing but the chilling power of the soul."
A smile appeared on his lips, "Oh, what a sight that would be."
A legion of Soul Warriors sure sounded like a good thing. Kent already has the Undead Legion comprising 13 powerful warriors.
Although Kent isn’t done creating his undead, the need for more hasn’t crossed his mind yet. Aside from them, he also has 13 legendary warriors in his Eternal Wrath Legion.
No new dungeon aside from the Planet Killer Dungeon remained to be conquered. Once that is done, it will bring the Eternal Wrath legion to 14 members.
However, Kent knew there would be more. After all, when the Chaos Dragon called, the 13 legions that came had over 50 warriors each, except for the [Lost Knights]
Kent is already aware that there are 69 in the Night Riders Legion. So, aside from the [Lost Knights], who he knew there were only 14 of them, the rest had more left to join.
The battle coming requires all legions to be at their peak.
So for now, he has the following.

13 Undead Legion, 13 Eternal Wrath Legion, 14 Lost Knights (but only one of them had undergone his first evolution: Veydris). He also has 4 Soul Sentinels led by the legendary Aether Warden (Soul Sentinel): Elsa.
There is also the Beast Legion, of which he only has 7 in the Immortal World. He can’t wait to reconnect with them.
Then there are the Night Riders, who he can boldly say are the strongest at the moment. They have demigods and even a god among them.
Now, if he plays his card right, then maybe he might just be adding the next legion. But that would depend on whether, when the Chaos Dragon called, a legion known as the Soul Warriors also came.
And if indeed they heed his call and were among the 13 legions, then the question would be, which of his incarnations brought that legion together?
He knew his legions were ones ruled by his incarnations.

"Bit by bit, I will get there. However, I have to hurry. If the forsaken race had started making moves, then sooner rather than later, they would make their big move, and knowing them, chaos and destruction are what they command."
Kent snapped his finger, forming a recliner from ice that he pressed his back against just when the yellow sun broke through the clouds and illuminated the scorched surface of the planet.
He took a deep breath, then he decided to review the memories of the forsaken seer.

Of course, once a soul weapon is destroyed, it never returns to the Soul Universe again.

However, Kent, who always seeks quality over quantity, knew that if a lot of effort were put into creating powerful soul weapons, then worrying about them getting destroyed would be the last of his worries.
"This is a great ability.
It is a way of creating legendary warriors from the souls of those I have killed.
I will be giving them purpose, and that purpose would be to fight for a better universe."
Kent made a fist and raised it.
"I can already see a legion of Soul Warriors and Soul Weapons pouring from a dark portal, radiating nothing but the chilling power of the soul."
A smile appeared on his lips, "Oh, what a sight that would be."
A legion of Soul Warriors sure sounded like a good thing.
Kent already has the Undead Legion comprising 13 powerful warriors.
Although Kent isn’t done creating his undead, the need for more hasn’t crossed his mind yet.
Aside from them, he also has 13 legendary warriors in his Eternal Wrath Legion.
No new dungeon aside from the Planet Killer Dungeon remained to be conquered.
Once that is done, it will bring the Eternal Wrath legion to 14 members.
However, Kent knew there would be more.
After all, when the Chaos Dragon called, the 13 legions that came had over 50 warriors each, except for the [Lost Knights]
Kent is already aware that there are 69 in the Night Riders Legion.
So, aside from the [Lost Knights], who he knew there were only 14 of them, the rest had more left to join.
The battle coming requires all legions to be at their peak.
So for now, he has the following.
13 Undead Legion, 13 Eternal Wrath Legion, 14 Lost Knights (but only one of them had undergone his first evolution: Veydris).
He also has 4 Soul Sentinels led by the legendary Aether Warden (Soul Sentinel): Elsa.
There is also the Beast Legion, of which he only has 7 in the Immortal World.
He can’t wait to reconnect with them.
Then there are the Night Riders, who he can boldly say are the strongest at the moment.
They have demigods and even a god among them.
Now, if he plays his card right, then maybe he might just be adding the next legion.
But that would depend on whether, when the Chaos Dragon called, a legion known as the Soul Warriors also came.
And if indeed they heed his call and were among the 13 legions, then the question would be, which of his incarnations brought that legion together?
He knew his legions were ones ruled by his incarnations.
"Bit by bit, I will get there.
However, I have to hurry.
If the forsaken race had started making moves, then sooner rather than later, they would make their big move, and knowing them, chaos and destruction are what they command."
Kent snapped his finger, forming a recliner from ice that he pressed his back against just when the yellow sun broke through the clouds and illuminated the scorched surface of the planet.
He took a deep breath, then he decided to review the memories of the forsaken seer.

chapters.title: Chapter 1258: Great Reward
paragraphs: It took Kent just 3 hours to go through all of the forsaken seers’ and the other forsaken immortals’ memories.
Since she was merely a clone, the memories she had were only from when she was made into a clone. However, that was enough for him to know the real Atarah.

"As expected from a Forsaken Seer, she really is crafty." The little he had gotten about her true self, Kent saw she had already anticipated her death, and as such, she wiped most of the vital information from her mind.
She wiped the location of the forsaken world she is from. She wiped what she looked like or even what she sounded like.

In fact, the only reason Kent is even sure she exists is the fact that he had killed her clone. Her planning was rather detailed and airtight, making it impossible for Kent to figure out where she was from.
Even the other forsaken immortal is basically useless. Aside from the forsaken art Kent found, everything in his mind was messed with by the Forsaken Seer.
However, there was one thing Kent found that was worth it. His suffering wasn’t in vain after finding that.
"She may not have thought it was necessary, however, to someone like me, this is the best." Kent smiled, taking out the destiny map.
He activated it and panned in his galaxy. Then, as if looking for a needle in a haystack, he started examining the map. After five minutes, he sighs and flicks his own forehead.
"Dumb me. I have a sentient tower, and here I was searching for something extremely hidden," he laughed, and then he asked the tower for help.
"Tower, help me locate Lanster Barbarian Star System."
The map rotated and stopped on a small part of the map.
"Enlarge and activate a 3D model of the entire star system."
The map moved again, but this time it expanded and transformed into a star system with just 4 planetary systems.

In each planetary system, there are only ten planets. Naturally, that isn’t enough to make a planetary system. A planetary system requires at least 50 planets, and a star system requires close to 15 planetary systems.
However, looking at the enormous sizes of the planets in each planetary system, one can only see why only four planetary systems managed to form a star system.
"Tower, let’s do some calculations here, shall we?"
[I am up for it, master]

Kent nodded and asked, "Take my current location to be Planet Bayla. Now, plot a course from there to the edge of the galaxy and tell me how long it would take to travel there—factor in teleportation gates, teleportation channels, and other methods that can hasten the travel.
When done, also take the Lanster Barbarian Star System, specifically the Bone Dragon Planetary System, into account.
Examine how long that would take if I were to travel there instead of going the previous routes we have mapped."
Kent had seen something in Atarah’s memories that, if he could harness its power, he would be saving several years of travel in his quest to cross over to the other galaxy.
Getting to Elina is a must; however, he must also make sure he doesn’t waste time travelling by any old route.
If he can find a way to reach where he wanted to go faster by passing through even dangerous routes, as someone who is already undisputed in the High Worlds, Kent is up for it.𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝚠𝕖𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝕖𝚕.𝚌𝗼𝗺
He wants to get to her fast and hopefully make sure she is okay before focusing on other things.
The tower soon finished her calculations.
[After factoring in all that the master had said, I calculated that to move from Planet Bayla to the edge of the galaxy would take about 25 to 30 years.
However, from Planet Bayla to the Bone Dragon Planetary System would only take 12 years, and from there to the edge of the galaxy would take no more than 6 years.]
A beaming smile appeared on Kent’s face, hearing what the tower had said. The reason for this was because of something else he had seen in Atarah’s memories.

It turned out the dragons she brought were a small clan from a planet called Yaohe. This planet is in the Bone Dragon Planetary System, which is one of the four planetary systems in the Lanster Barbarian Star System.
They were being suppressed there by a different Flame Dragon Race, which is the primary ruling race on the planet Yaohe.
So when she offered them the deal, they accepted, and she took them away through a teleportation portal in an underground cave somewhere on Planet Yaohe.
If Kent could build the same teleportation portal on his side, then with the coordinates in his mind, he would be on Planet Yaohe in less than 6 weeks instead of 12 years.
"Tower, examine the Six Fangs Teleportation Portal Formation and tell me how long it would take you or Gaia to build it."

[The master will need the fangs of six different beasts. Once that is found, Cosmic Gaia will need about 5 years (outside time) to build it. Of course, it is going to cost billions of tower points, but that can be arranged later.]

The smile on Kent’s face didn’t falter. If anything, he seems even more eager to get right to things. Of course, the sneaky Forsaken Seer wiped the name of the six beasts from her mind as a precaution.
However, the tower is there for moments like this.
"Tell me the names of the six beasts."

[The master must hunt and kill the Six Beasts and harvest their fangs. Their names are as follows: Void Howler Beast, Abyssal Frost Serpent, Solar-Pelt Lion of the First Dawn, Chrono-Jaguar of the Lost Hour, Thunderbone Basilisk, Netherlight Devourer.
Luckily, three of the beasts can be found on Planet Bayla. In fact, the beasts that must be killed as one of the requirements to become a Pill Emperor can be found there, too.

So, your next stop, Planet Bayla, you will make much more progress there. Both the Void Howler Beast, Abyssal Frost Serpent, and Solar-Pelt Lion of the First Dawn live in a perilous forest where your strength will be tested, and you will come close to death’s door many times.]
Kent smiled, a memory of his life as the faceless assassin resurfacing. "The Upside Down Underworld Forest."
[Indeed. Just like Planet Modu, that forest is akin to a lawless domain, where the limits of a High World don’t apply.
But compared to Planet Modu, I will advise the master to be prepared for anything.]
"You don’t have to spell it out to me, Tower. I have lived on Planet Bayla before and have been to the Upside Down Underworld Forest. So I know the kind of danger I will be walking into."
Kent stood up and stretched... "But I am ready to face anything if it makes getting to Elina faster."
There is nothing else to look for since the four foxkins are dead. They had already been used as vessels to summon four forsaken beings.
"I will get revenge for them later." Kent teleported away, appearing in the Soul Tower to see what he could do using his newest ability.
The Soul Weapon ability.

chapters.title: Chapter 1259: First Soul Warrior
paragraphs: Gaia will soon be done with the city, but before that, Kent wanted to test out how efficient his newest ability is.
He had just awakened it, and since he has quite a lot of Soul Spirits, the next step was to see if he could create soul weapons from them.
Right now, he doesn’t know the skill’s limit or whether there is one. For all he knew, with enough Soul Spirits, he could create a god-level soul weapon.
And if he goes through the route of turning Soul Spirits into Soul Warriors, then he might be walking around with literal gods soon.
That would be cool too. The ability to summon gods from deep within his soul would be one hell of a flex. Of course, he knew things aren’t always rainbows and sunshine, so he could only hope.

After he arrived in the Soul Tower, Kent quickly entered the Soul Universe, knowing that inside the Soul Tower, he could easily slip in and out of the most dangerous place known to man—the Soul Universe.
Once outside, he can’t easily do that since he risks others slipping in uninvited.
As usual, when he appeared inside the Soul Universe, a smile appeared on his face.
Looking at seven colossal asteroids and 3000 meteors just waiting to be summoned made him super happy.
But aside from them, there are also thousands of spears and head-sized explosives Kent made purposely for attacking the soul.
The asteroids, meteors, and spears are meant to attack both the body and the soul. However, the soul bombs are for only the soul.
They were his latest creations, so seeing hundreds of thousands of them made him grin. The worlds he had added to his guardian tower sure are feeding him with soul essence.
"I’ve worked really hard for all this. One day, I will show just how deadly I am in combat." Kent clenched his fist. All his preparations had been for when he would need them.
Now, he would be venturing into the one place that is making even his skin crawl.
Back when he entered the Upside Down Underworld Forest, it was to train and prepare for a mission. He wanted to take on the appearance of a powerful beast that lives there.
However, in the end, he abandoned the idea since getting through the millions of beasts there was a headache.

He failed that mission, but he left with valuable knowledge that couldn’t have come at a better time. Although he couldn’t get what he wanted back then, that knowledge now gave Kent an idea of what to expect.
So coming here to try his hand at the [Soul Weapon] skill wasn’t just to test the use of this new ability, but also to see if he could create something he could use when there.

While his legion is free at the moment, Kent doesn’t plan on sending them into the maw of danger simply because he has them. They have their missions, and so he would use his own way to get this mission done.
He teleported and appeared in a different section of the Soul Universe, where thousands of Soul Spirits sat in lotus posture, absorbing the abundance of Soul Essence in the air.
The beasts that can’t sit, hover in the air, while most slept on the ground, absorbing the Soul Essence.
When Kent arrived, they all opened their eyes and turned to him. One could see the respect in their eyes as they gazed upon him.
The organisation is strange, as one would expect. The Soul Spirits are in groups of several hundreds or tens of thousands.
Most of the groups comprise people he had killed in a particular battle.

He could see the dragons he had just killed, the angels and aliens he had slaughtered during his adventurous time in the Paragon Universe, and the many hell beasts and demons he had killed when he went to hell.
Roughly, there are close to 500,000 Soul Spirits inside the Soul Universe, and Kent would have to pick one and create a Soul Warrior out of them.
Kent expanded his vision, allowing him to see thousands of Soul Spirits. Those with the strongest spirits look entirely different. They are much more solid and oozing with power.
Naturally, those who had been inside the Soul Universe the longest have deeper soul bodies. Looking over, he saw thousands of such soul spirits.
"Strange, it is as if I have done this before." Like déjà vu, Kent felt a sense of familiarity as he scrutinised the Soul Spirits.
That feeling that made one think they had done something before, but for as long as they could remember, they had never done such a thing, was now making Kent blink a couple of times.
"I am just overthinking. I have never had the Soul Universe technique until this life. So maybe I am just overthinking."
Even so, the feeling lingered. He knew he was merely making himself feel good, but there was no telling whether he had done so, maybe using different means.
As he continued to look through the Soul Spirits, whenever he found a suitable candidate that he planned to turn into a Soul Warrior, something in him seemed to reject them.
However, if his mindset was to turn them into soul weapons, then there are thousands he could pick from.
"Really strange," Kent smiled inwardly and continued to look.

Soon, he had seen about 98% of the Soul Spirits, but none caught his attention. He didn’t know why, but even the Soul Spirits of the forsaken immortals he had killed didn’t seem right to be transformed into a soul warrior.
"Maybe I can only go for a soul weapon for now, and hopefully, one day I will find the one that I can turn into a soul—"
Kent stopped and narrowed his eyes at a hooded figure sitting somewhere at the back of the thousands of Soul Spirits.
Kent instantly recognised the figure as one of the Hell Demons he killed back in the Damned Hell Sea.
Looking at his soul quality, he clearly is stronger than a Heavenly Ascension Stage warrior; however, due to the suppression of the hell road, he was Tier 19 when Kent killed him.
Now, sitting with two daggers in his firm grip, the feeling that keeps rejecting the others flipped, and now, it seems to like this one. Looking closely, Kent saw a golden core deep inside his chest.
This golden core is radiating a subtle power that feels both too familiar and too distant to Kent.
"Come."
Kent pointed at him, and the hooded figure teleported to him. Just when he appeared before Kent, a message appeared before his vision...
⟦Do you want to transform this Soul Spirit into a Soul Warrior⟧
"Really strange." Kent smiled, but he quickly selected yes because that was why he had come to the Soul Universe in the first place.
⟦Soul Warrior Transformation Process Started. Duration: 7 Days⟧
Under Kent’s shocked gaze, the hooded figure was cocooned, and then, from the thousands of Soul Spirits around, they began turning into golden orbs and merging with the cocoon.𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝚠𝕖𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝕖𝚕.𝚌𝗼𝗺
In less than a minute, over a thousand Soul Spirits were absorbed.
"I expect greatness in seven days." Kent spent some more time looking for a second Soul Spirit with a golden core, but failed.
In the end, he left the Soul Universe. Three days later, Gaia is done with the city, meaning the Sky Foxes can move in.

chapters.title: Chapter 1260: Skyjade City
paragraphs: "Waoooow"
An Elven child exclaimed, gazing at the magnificent city now floating at the centre of a blue river. Out of nowhere, this city was revealed, catching everyone by surprise.

Be it the Humans living in Gaiaville, the Bloodvein tribe living in Blood City, or the Elves living in Nature City, everyone came out to see the latest addition to the cities in the tower.𝑓𝘳𝘦𝑒𝑤𝑒𝘣𝘯ℴ𝘷𝘦𝓁.𝑐𝑜𝑚
From the base of the floating city to the towering buildings that touch even the clouds, everything is made of jade.
The city has five sections, each connected by a glass bridge. Gaia named them East, West, North, South, and Central cities.
The east city is made of white jade, west of green jade, North of purple jade, South of golden jade and Center of diamond jade.
Each section of the city has a tall tower that stretches as far as the eye can see.
Although many buildings float off the main island, these towers pierce the clouds, allowing all who can stand at the top to gaze at the beauty of the night sky.
Gaia named them Jade Towers, with the one standing in the Central City being the tallest. These towers are for cultivation, since inside them, an hour outside is a day inside.

Instead of building them cultivation gardens as she did with the other three cities, Gaia chose to try something new by building Jade Towers that, in many years to come, would be known as Cultivation Towers.
The people living inside the tower would keep expanding, and soon, instead of calling it Tower Cities, it would become Tower World, with many continents.
As long as Kent is alive, they will continue to grow and multiply. One day, even from just the Tower cities, gods and immortals will be everywhere.
Kent appeared inside the Mountain Garden where his wives and some of his legions stood, gazing at the vast expanse of Skyjade city.

"Gaia has outdone herself yet again," Zaila commented, looking at the city. Even though the other three towns are equally stunning, considering how unique this one was, everyone seemed mesmerised by it.
Just as others admire the other three cities when they see them, they admire Skyjade City, too. In the end, they will stand at the same spot and admire the next city.
Liora and her aunt Yuyin also stood among her sisters. Yuyin was in disbelief, staring at the city that she and her fellow Sky Foxes would be staying in from now on.
The best part is that it is free, and everything they will need will be provided. Basically, all they need to do now is cultivate and live the peace they have sought many times.

Of course, she had no idea they also would be working to keep Kent’s reserve of soul essence always full. But even if they knew, they wouldn’t mind, considering this place is the most beautiful place she has ever seen.
"When would you be moving in?" Nara asked.

"Right now, I suppose. The city is ready, but first, let me talk to Gaia," Kent said before teleporting away. He appeared inside Skyjade city, where Gaia and her pals were toasting to yet another job well done.
"I hope that is fruit juice. You little ones are too young to be drinking alcohol."
"Big Brother."

As expected, they were on him before he knew it. Still, Li Hua and Nyxira aren’t back from the dungeon since she decided to hone her skills there. So only the three cosmic sisters, Yuna, and Purity were in Skyjade city.
After hugging him, Gaia handed Kent a glass of apple juice....
’As expected, they really have the mindset of children,’ Kent said inwardly before taking a sip and letting the taste work its way deep into his bones.
"Juicy," he muttered. Although he is beyond fruit juices, he couldn’t help but let the taste get to him. Once he had enough, he turned to look up the tower stretching as far as entering the cloud.
"Nice job, Gaia," Kent finally said, making Gaia smile happily.
"Big Brother should rest assured that whatever he needs, Gaia and her sisters can do it," Gaia said, taking another sip of her drink.
"I know you will because you ladies are the best."
Complimenting them in a way makes them super happy, so Kent knew moments like this warranted a good compliment.
"Can they move in now?"
"Yes. The city is ready, so Big Brother can bring the Sky Foxes."
Kent nodded and turned to his ladies, who understood what he meant. Liora led them back to Tianxu, where the Sky Fox were ready to move.
Kent joined them, and using his authority as the owner of the Tower, he opened five large portals for them.
"Through these portals is a city where, from now onwards, you will have all the peace in the universe to grow and live happily with friends and loved ones.
Also, remember, this was possible thanks to your Princess. So maybe cut her some slack next time," Kent said with a chuckle.

Although he isn’t really bothered if his wives are Princesses, Queens, or even Empresses, learning that the Sky Foxes don’t see Liora as their Princess simply because she is more human than a fox made him a little angry.
So he made sure they knew she was the one who made all this happen.
As expected, all the Sky Foxes bowed in Liora’s direction and spoke in unison... "We thank the Princess." They can now see the bigger picture.

"Good. You can enter your new home now." They bowed to Kent and then entered through the five portals. Soon, they started arriving in Skyjade city, with their eyes wide and jaws hanging open from sheer shock and disbelief.
Their new home is just too beautiful. In no time, they all entered, and the portals closed when Kent and his wives also entered.
However, before leaving, Kent used his sword qi to carve an inscription into the city.

All over Planet Tianxu, the sudden disappearance of the Sky Fox race alarmed everyone, just like how the massacre of the beasts and humans who went to suppress them a couple of hours ago took everyone by surprise.
They didn’t know just what had happened.
However, the brave ones who chose to enter the island after the Sky Foxes left saw an inscription left behind by the one responsible.
"Kent Madson Was Here"
When they saw this, word spread quickly, and within a day, thousands of powerhouses came to Tianxu to see what had happened.
All they found were dead bodies of thousands of humans and beasts, sending chills down everyone’s spine.
Although they failed yet again to meet Kent, the scene they came to meet told them all they needed to know. The person they are looking for is a danger that can’t be messed with.

Later, the curious ones will find the teleportation gate underwater and activate it. Thousands will enter, but none will return. After all, the danger waiting for them on Planet Modu is not one ordinary warriors could handle.
Lawless worlds are called lawless simply because of the lawlessness there. And since Kent had already angered the three Lawless Monarchs, they would welcome the new arrivals with deadly consequences.
