chapters.title: Chapter 1261: Commissioning two new Projects
paragraphs: In no time, the Sky Foxes settled in their new home.

The Humans, Bloodvein, and Elves went over to welcome them as they did for each other. The humans were the first, and Kent’s wives welcomed them. Then they welcome the Blood veins, and together, they welcome the Elves.
Now, it was the turn of the Sky Foxes.
Of course, they seemed startled when they saw them, especially the Humans. However, learning that their Princess made this happen, they knew they had nothing to worry about.
In the end, not all Humans are the same.
Truthfully, after just a day together, they started to bond with them.
Kent seemed pleased with this development.
Later, he left his women there, knowing they would love to stay and make sure everything was handled well.
In the end, they would only be adding to his debt. However, whatever makes them happy is fine with him. He is about to embark on a dangerous mission, and so would they.
They will be challenging the 5th floor of the planet-killer dungeon, so more tower points to come.𝒇𝓻𝓮𝓮𝙬𝙚𝒃𝒏𝓸𝙫𝒆𝙡.𝓬𝓸𝒎
Vexthra told them she would return early, so in three days they would venture into the dungeon yet again.
This means, regardless of how much they spend, they soon will be paying for it, and hopefully, this time, Kent will never go into debt ever again.
But before that, he had something else to handle.
"Tower, have you looked into the Supreme Sky Fox Inheritance inside Liora’s soul?"
After learning that Liora’s mother died from an inheritance from a powerful Sky Fox beast and that she was killed after giving the inheritance to Liora, Kent told the Tower to look into it.
Liora no longer needs such an inheritance, since she now has a True Name. So if he can extract it and give it to her people, that would be for the best.
For now, he had nothing he could do to help the Sky Foxes become powerful like the other races. He is limited in that knowledge.
However, if this inheritance is good, then maybe once one of them inherits it, they can unlock the secret of their bloodline and help the others.
[I did, Master, and it is as you anticipated. It is indeed a Supreme Grade inheritance that goes above and beyond to unleash the hidden powers of the Sky Fox race.]
"Interesting. Do you have any details on who this inheritance came from... like a name or title?"

[As a matter of fact, I do. From what I found on her, she is known as Rael, the Sky Fox Sovereign. The only account on her was that she lived during the Chaos Era and was among the ten legendary Primordial Beasts who followed the Divine Beast Tamer in that era
From her account and the others’, they were the sole reason the Chaos War ended in favour of the universe.
However, I know nothing of her powers and traits. But I do know she was a legendary being, and contained in this inheritance is all the Sky Fox race needs to evolve and unlock their hidden powers.]
"So their inheritance isn’t for just one person. It was meant to be used by all the Sky Fox."
[Yes, Master. Once extracted, Cosmic Gaia can build an ancestral site for them to inherit the knowledge and hopefully, one day, legends could rise from their ranks.]
"I see. That does make some sense. However, Gaia is probably going to have a field day with this." Kent smiled, feeling yet another headache coming.
Gaia is going to charge him a fortune for this.
Of course, thinking about the Six Fangs Teleportation Portal Formation she would also have to work on, Kent knew he would have to work extra hard if he wanted to never go into debt again.
But then again, cutting the time it will take him to go from his current position to the Lanster Barbarian Star System to just 5 years and a few weeks is worth any amount.

Also, if he gets to make the Sky Fox stronger, then one day, not only would he be getting Soul Essence from the many worlds he is connected to, but even gods and immortals will be his source of strength in both Soul Essence and divine faith energy.
"I need to talk to Gaia yet again," Kent said, already aware of the joy this will bring to Gaia.
Building the formation will take 5 years (outside time). That would be 120 years inside the tower. So it is going to cost a lot, and Kent can already see that.
But instead of spending 25 years moving to the edge of this galaxy, it will only take him approximately 10 years and loads of tower points.
That is better than spending 15 years more on the road.
Kent teleported to the Mountain Garden, where he knew Gaia and her sisters would be spending time with Uncle Drew and the demigods.
They jumped on him the moment he appeared. It had only been a day since they last saw him, but that didn’t stop them from welcoming him enthusiastically.
After spending a few minutes hugging their tiny bodies and making sure they are fine, he pulled Gaia to the side for some serious talk.
"I know you are probably going to act shamelessly and overcharge me, but take a look at these two things and tell me how much it would cost you and how long it would take to build them."
Kent smirked, feeling annoyed. However, in the entire universe, there is no better builder than Gaia, so he gets what he gets.

Gaia smiled and started examining the blueprint for the Six Fangs Teleportation Portal Formation and the Supreme Sky Fox Inheritance. After a couple of minutes, she was done, a smile brightening her face.
"It is going to cost you, Big Brother."
"Just tell me and stop throwing dust in my eyes."
"As you wish." She started with the inheritance.
"Building an inheritance shrine for a Supreme Inheritance is not an easy thing. A lot of weaving will go into it, so I will need my sisters’ help, which means it will cost you even more.
However, with their help, we would need just 100 days to complete it, with a budget of 3.5 billion tower points. This covers our overtime and health insurance, not forgetting accident fees."
Kent could only stare at the shameless, tiny bandit hovering in the air before him. The need to grab and squeeze her even crossed his mind, but he just sighed.
"What about the Six Fangs Teleportation Portal Formation?"

Gaia smiled... "Well, as long as the master brings the fangs of the six beasts, with as few as 30 billion tower points and dedication from my team and me, we can have it working in as little as 80 years.
The initial estimation should have been 120 years. But with enough motivation, 80 years is enough."
That would be 1.7 years taken off. However, that would also mean he must farm more tower points.
"Any discount?" Kent asked. However, Gaia shook her head, but then she smiled... "If the master promises to do wrestling with us every ten years, then we can take 5 billion tower points off it."
"Deal."
Gaia jumped into his arms with a giggle.
Kent just let her have this moment.
One day, he is going to get his revenge...

chapters.title: Chapter 1262: First Soul Warrior - Calix Knoll (1)
paragraphs: Gaia joined her sisters to celebrate the contract she had secured for them. Of course, the tower points are only valuable for the three cosmic sisters: Gaia, Dori, and Akira. However, Purity and Yuna didn’t mind joining them.
They also have their roles to play.𝗳𝗿𝐞𝕖𝘄𝗲𝕓𝗻𝚘𝚟𝕖𝐥.𝚌𝕠𝕞
In all, they are just happy to be useful again.
Kent ignored them and moved toward Uncle Drew, Avotha, Vargus, and Lene. They spend most of their time inside the tower garden, if they are not training the legion.
"How are you four doing?" Kent asked, sitting on a swinging chair opposite Uncle Drew and Lene.
"Living the best time of our lives," Vargus replied, feeling very happy to be in the land of the living yet again. The rest had the same expressions on their faces.
Hell was no fun at all.
"Good to hear that. In any case, I will be going away for a while. However, since I promised to accompany you to rescue Kaelith, when you hear from your subordinate, let me know right away."
"Do you need our help?" Lene asked before Uncle Drew could nod in agreement with Kent.
"Having you there will make things easy; however, I have to handle this on my own." Lene nodded, though she would love to go with Kent.
Where Kent is going is considered among the top-most dangerous places in the High Worlds. So having a demigod by his side would surely come in handy.
But Kent is already aware of the dangers ahead of him, so he must do this on his own.
"My guy is only three months out from Kaelith’s planet. Once he lands there, I will let you know. For now, we will join the legion in their mission to the dungeon.
Of course, we won’t help them in clearing the floors. We will only help look for the valuable stuff after they have cleared it.
However, once they start meeting immortals, we will have to make a move," Uncle Drew finally said.
"I don’t have any problem with that. Just keep them safe."

After spending a few more hours talking with them, Kent retired to the Soul Tower to meditate. Since Vexthra is bound to return in three days, he decided to wait for her and also the soul warrior to finish its transformation.
He tried to buy a few skills for his ice element, but in the end, he settled only for a God-grade defence technique called Turtle Shell.

He would create his own skills or later inherit some when he met the Ice Sovereign again. But for now, he would only do with the defence skill and hope it was enough to save him from the dangers he would soon be facing in the mission ahead of him.
Three days later, he received a notification on the completion of his First Soul Warrior creations. It had been seven days already.
"Moment of truth."
Kent entered the Soul Universe and quickly made his way to the site where the process was underway. When he arrived, he was shocked at the sight before him.
Seven days ago, when he came here, there were hundreds of thousands of Soul Spirits here. So imagine his shock when he came to meet fewer than a hundred thousand Soul Spirits.
This doesn’t make any sense to him. However, when he raised his head and saw the golden cocoon shining with a brilliant golden light, he felt his mind suddenly go numb.
He could feel it.

Deep within the cocoon, something – someone – extremely dangerous is about to stir. The sheer danger in the soul energy it emitted told Kent that perhaps sacrificing about 80% of his Soul Spirits was worth it.
CRACK
Suddenly, it cracked, and a wave of terrifying energy poured out from it. Kent took a few steps back, feeling his soul, which is immune to soul attacks, suddenly getting suppressed.
However, while he was being suppressed, he felt no fear. If anything, he seemed to be feeling a new channel for earning Soul Essence opening as more cracks appeared inside the cocoon.

Suddenly, the cocoon shattered, revealing a hooded figure holding two daggers, arms crossed over his chest. His face is hidden behind the hood; however, Kent knew it was the same Soul Spirit he called 7 days ago.
But regardless of how he sees it, this new version of him is solid, like a living being, and much stronger than before. In fact, he looks more deadly than even Kent.
That is because, unlike Kent, the aura this hooded figure is emitting is that of a Tier 22 existence (Death Stage).
However, compared to ordinary Death-stage warriors, this hooded figure is much more dangerous. That can even be felt from just looking at him.
’Damn, this bastard is dangerous.’
Kent took his dear time to examine the hooded figure for a few minutes before he turned to the message that appeared before his eyes.
⟦To finish the Transformation Process, you must give your creation a name⟧
’A name, huh?’ Kent had to think again, since this time, he wasn’t prepared to name anyone. In his mind, he only wanted to see if he would be able to create something good from his latest ability.
However, since it had come to this, he started to think of a good name.
After five minutes of thinking, a good name appeared in his mind.
"I will call him Calix Knoll."
⟦Congratulations, you have created your first Soul Warrior⟧
His status page appeared, but Kent ignored it and focused instead on the person now kneeling before him. Kent didn’t even know how he got there.
One moment, he gave him a name; the next, he was kneeling before him.
"My Lord." A deep voice then entered his head, causing Kent to widen his eyes.
"You can speak."
"Yes, my Lord." The whole thing is just bizarre and sounds very odd. He knew Soul Spirits were non-intelligent beings. They only follow the instructions their owner gives them.
So from the start, he wasn’t expecting to hear a sound from this Soul Warrior. But he was proven wrong.
"Impressive. I suppose this is something new to be happy about." Kent smiled and then told Calix to stand up.
His hood extends into a dark, tattered cloak, and his body is wrapped in black leather-like armour. He held on tightly to his daggers like his life depended on them.
"Tell me your revolutionary path to becoming an Immortal," Kent asked.
He saw that the Soul Spirits of the immortals he had killed were gone. This means Calix had absorbed them, yet he is still a Death Stage Soul Warrior.
So he had to ask... He had yet to know more about him, but that can wait since he still had no idea whether Calix could only be three realms above him or if he could go higher than that.
"To evolve to the next stage, I need to absorb a large amount of pure Soul spirits to saturate my core. I am currently 49% done."
"I see. Then would absorbing the remaining Soul Spirits be enough?"
"No. I need stronger and purer Soul Spirits. These ones are of low quality. The least I could do is use them to forge more weapons."
"Wait, you could forge weapons too..."
Calix lifted his head, allowing Kent to see his crimson eyes. "Of course, one of my [Aspects] is
Forgemaster."

sentences.text: Gaia joined her sisters to celebrate the contract she had secured for them.
Of course, the tower points are only valuable for the three cosmic sisters: Gaia, Dori, and Akira.
However, Purity and Yuna didn’t mind joining them.
They also have their roles to play.𝗳𝗿𝐞𝕖𝘄𝗲𝕓𝗻𝚘𝚟𝕖𝐥.𝚌𝕠𝕞
In all, they are just happy to be useful again.
Kent ignored them and moved toward Uncle Drew, Avotha, Vargus, and Lene.
They spend most of their time inside the tower garden, if they are not training the legion.
"How are you four doing?" Kent asked, sitting on a swinging chair opposite Uncle Drew and Lene.
"Living the best time of our lives," Vargus replied, feeling very happy to be in the land of the living yet again.
The rest had the same expressions on their faces.
Hell was no fun at all.
"Good to hear that.
In any case, I will be going away for a while.
However, since I promised to accompany you to rescue Kaelith, when you hear from your subordinate, let me know right away."
"Do you need our help?" Lene asked before Uncle Drew could nod in agreement with Kent.
"Having you there will make things easy; however, I have to handle this on my own." Lene nodded, though she would love to go with Kent.
Where Kent is going is considered among the top-most dangerous places in the High Worlds.
So having a demigod by his side would surely come in handy.
But Kent is already aware of the dangers ahead of him, so he must do this on his own.
"My guy is only three months out from Kaelith’s planet.
Once he lands there, I will let you know.
For now, we will join the legion in their mission to the dungeon.
Of course, we won’t help them in clearing the floors.
We will only help look for the valuable stuff after they have cleared it.
However, once they start meeting immortals, we will have to make a move," Uncle Drew finally said.
"I don’t have any problem with that.
Just keep them safe."

He would create his own skills or later inherit some when he met the Ice Sovereign again.
But for now, he would only do with the defence skill and hope it was enough to save him from the dangers he would soon be facing in the mission ahead of him.

It had been seven days already.
"Moment of truth."

Seven days ago, when he came here, there were hundreds of thousands of Soul Spirits here.
So imagine his shock when he came to meet fewer than a hundred thousand Soul Spirits.
This doesn’t make any sense to him.
However, when he raised his head and saw the golden cocoon shining with a brilliant golden light, he felt his mind suddenly go numb.
He could feel it.
Deep within the cocoon, something – someone – extremely dangerous is about to stir.
The sheer danger in the soul energy it emitted told Kent that perhaps sacrificing about 80% of his Soul Spirits was worth it.
CRACK
Suddenly, it cracked, and a wave of terrifying energy poured out from it.
Kent took a few steps back, feeling his soul, which is immune to soul attacks, suddenly getting suppressed.
However, while he was being suppressed, he felt no fear.
If anything, he seemed to be feeling a new channel for earning Soul Essence opening as more cracks appeared inside the cocoon.

His face is hidden behind the hood; however, Kent knew it was the same Soul Spirit he called 7 days ago.
But regardless of how he sees it, this new version of him is solid, like a living being, and much stronger than before.
In fact, he looks more deadly than even Kent.
That is because, unlike Kent, the aura this hooded figure is emitting is that of a Tier 22 existence (Death Stage).
However, compared to ordinary Death-stage warriors, this hooded figure is much more dangerous.
That can even be felt from just looking at him.
’Damn, this bastard is dangerous.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1263: First Soul Warrior - Calix Knoll (2)
paragraphs: Kent quickly pulled up Calix’s status page to see everything about him. Hearing that one of his aspects is a Forgemaster made him curious about what he is capable of.
As expected, his profile showed his name, race, rank, affinity, and Job Class.
He is a peak Death-stage Soul warrior with immense firepower.
His race is surprisingly a [Soul Demon] instead of a [Hell Demon].
Basically, that perfectly aligns with his previous form before he was killed. He was a Hell Demon previously, and now, after his rebirth as a Soul Warrior, he has become a Soul Demon.
Kent didn’t know if such a race existed, but he was sure Calix was qualified to live again among the living. And surprisingly, the one-time-only death has been lifted off him.
There is an ability tied to his soul called [Bind]. This ability has bound his soul to Kent, allowing him to draw sustenance from Kent’s Soul Essence.
However, that doesn’t make him a leech. If anything, it is a two-way street. Aside from living off Kent’s Soul Essence, he also pays that back in something called [Soul Crystals].
Kent doesn’t know what those Soul Crystals are for, but the fact that his Soul Cultivation has now moved from Tier 16 to Tier 19 after creating Calix told him there is plenty of use for them.
He would find out more.

However, the [Bind] ability means that after Calix’s death, his soul core will return to Kent’s Soul Universe and, using enough Soul Spirits, create him a new body with his memories and weapons intact.
If he dies, that won’t be the end for him. And it is all thanks to his [Soul Demon] race and the [Bind] ability that came with it.

However, instead of having a class called Soul Warrior, considering the ’Soul Weapon’ ability literally allowed him to create such a being, he came out as a [Soul Reaper] with three affinities: [Soul], [Shadow], and [Fire].

The [Soul] affinity allows him to strike straight at the soul. Basically, if Kent were a Soul Warrior and he had this affinity, he would use it for soul battles rather than physical battles to injure the soul.
It is a dangerous affinity that many soul cultivators would love to have. Strangely, unless they became Soul Warriors, they would never be able to possess it.

Aside from that, his soul cultivation is already at Tier 23, which is comparable to a Root Immortal in soul cultivation. Additionally, he can also enter Kent’s soul and defend it if he were to meet a terrifying soul cultivator.
Kent possesses soul immunity, but he recently learned Flame Immunity isn’t the peak. So he wasn’t about to get cocky when he soon would be ascending to the Immortal Realm.
Calix has the power to command the soul, and as such, he is a danger. But he is also a powerful warrior.
Then there is the [Shadow] affinity that basically allows him to harness the elusive power of the shadows. He is not an assassin, per se, but he can be likened to already being a ’Shadow Emperor’.
That is, one level above Kent’s.
This makes him a dangerous foe who can easily switch from soul to shadow without any discomfort.

Lastly, there is the [Fire] affinity that allows him to harness the power of his soul flame. Kent would have to examine this further to know more, considering it is elusive in a way. The description is vague, so he had no proper explanation for it.
Basically, his three affinities allow him so much power that, when used right, he can easily make him undisputed in battle.
But away from his affinities, there also are the four aspects that Kent wanted to see. He didn’t know what kind of bloodline Calix has, but these aspects are just too good to be true.
Aspects: [Battle Master], [Soul Master], [Shadow Master], and [Forge Master]

At first glance, it appears like the four aspects are basically a replica of the three affinities. After all, Soul for Soul Master, Shadow for Shadow Master, and Fire for Forge Master. The only thing new is the Battle Master.
However, comparing the two, while in a way they can be regarded as the same, they are also completely different, considering the Aspects have something called Aspect abilities.
That separates them from the affinities.
These abilities further allow Calix to harness the power of his affinities and, to some degree, merge them to create something good.

Of course, the [Battle Master] aspect allows him to adapt to any mode of combat easily. However, while merely adapting is something Kent has mastered, this aspect also allows him to improve his combat style in any battle he fights.𝒇𝙧𝙚𝓮𝙬𝙚𝓫𝒏𝓸𝓿𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝙤𝓶
It is a must-have aspect that came with some bonus abilities.
The [Soul Master] aspect basically has to do with the soul. With knowledge from the [Battle Master] aspect, he can do more damage to the soul using this aspect.
[Shadow Master] is also on the same level as [Soul Master]. However, the added abilities to this aspect make him dangerous when harnessing the Shadow element.
Then lastly, the [Forge Master] aspect that basically allows him to harness the power of his soul flame and the soul spirits to forge whatever weapon he wants.
Kent saw that his inventory was very empty. This means he can forge more weapons from Soul Spirits and use them in combat.
But the best part is that he can forge weapons for others, too. And even better, unlike the one-time-use-only weapons Kent could make, Calix’s weapons are indestructible.
Naturally, Kent, who had been hoping to make powerful flying weapons, couldn’t, since he lacked the power to forge them. Now, Calix will fix that for him.
"Use half of the remaining Soul Spirits to forge some weapons for yourself and a couple of flying spears for me. I will use the remaining half to see what kind of weapons I could make."

"As you command, my Lord," Calix turned away and flew toward the thousands of Soul Spirits. Under Kent’s watchful gaze, he retrieved a forging table and some forging tools from his inventory and started forging.
He turned the Soul Spirits into blocks of metal ore.
Meanwhile, when Kent tapped into the [Soul Weapon] ability again with the intent to create weapons, a message appeared.
⟦What type of weapon do you want to make⟧
↠ Sword
↠ Spear
↠ Dagger
↠ Needles
↠ Darts
The options are limited to these five. However, Kent only needed swords and spears, which he could use as flying weapons.

The moment he selected those weapons, the option to add the materials appeared. He merely commanded half of the Soul Spirits, and they all turned into streaks of light and flew into a formation that appeared in the air.
⟦You will be alerted when the process is completed⟧
This time, he wasn’t given a time frame. However, he knew it wouldn’t be long before he had thousands of weapons to command.
After telling Calix to focus on his forging, Kent left the Soul Universe and went to meet Vexthra, who had returned while he was inside the Soul Universe.
She returned with a gifts and some bad news.

chapters.title: Chapter 1264: God Level Gifts
paragraphs: By the time Kent arrived in the harem tower, all his wives were tinkering with gifts that any god would kill to have.
In Zaila’s hand lay a bell that many gods would recognise as the [Mind Haunting Bell], looking ordinary despite the danger it contains and the power it commands.
Zaila might not be able to harness its true power just yet, but even so, when used at this stand, it can cause some severe brain damage.

Alina held a Rune Brush whose legend would shock everyone. It was said to have been used by the King of Arrays billions of years ago to draw the legendary [64 Collapsing Strike Array], one that the Dragon Tribulation Dao later took as a trial for all dragons who want to shed their scales.
For the past three eras, the dragons had been searching for it but found no trace of it. It is said that the only way to defeat the [64 Collapsing Strikes] is to harness the power of the brush used.
Of course, while Zaila held the [Mind Haunting Bell] like it was a trinket, Alina held onto the brush as an expert.
It has already been established that, aside from Zaila, a mind cultivator, and Vexthra, a goddess, none of the ladies in the Chaos Dragon harem came close to Alina in intelligence.
She is super intelligent, and that can be seen from what she has been working on in the past months.
Holding the [Jade Mantis Brush] that the Array King wielded, Alina could tell she would do so many great things with it. She saw the power hidden within it, and she is thrilled.
Velyra held a red sword, its blade radiating intense blood qi. That sword was once wielded by a powerful god who walked the path of blood but fell in a duel against a forsaken god.
His sword vanished after that battle, and ever since, gods and supremes have been searching for it.

It was said that there is a seal within this sword that had been used to seal the legendary [Seven Cut Blood Annihilation] sword technique, a celestial-grade technique that came from the Primordial Era.
This legendary sword now lies like an ordinary sword in Velyra’s hand.
That is just a mind-bending sight that, if someone has even a tiny idea of what treasures the ladies are holding.
Every last one of them held a treasure. Even Miryssa held a small token in her palm, and considering the look on her face, she was probably in deep shock.
She is a Universal God, so for Vexthra to give her something that brought such a reaction from her, Kent knew it might be something even gods would love to have.

Yuyin was also there, seated beside Liora, reading through a scroll that felt both real and illusory. She doesn’t have a True Name yet, but she fits in with the ladies, especially considering she is a foxkin, one of the most beautiful races in the universe.
"Looks like you ladies are having some fun," Kent said, walking toward them with a broad smile on his face. Miryssa and Yuyin shifted, suddenly feeling like they were overdressed for the moment.
They are basically in their lingerie like the rest of Kent’s wives. However, while they seem comfortable in their skin, the two were a bit shy.
However, they quickly calmed down when they realised they were among their fellow ladies. Being shy is just an instinctive reaction.
And as the rest of the ladies hugged and kissed him, they further calmed down. Luckily, Kent didn’t make things difficult for them by coming for a kiss or a hug.
The ladies also didn’t force them. However, what followed next left them flustered.
Kent sat down and hugged Vexthra from behind. Then, using both hands, he started kneading her boobs. This sight left the two newcomers flustered, even prompting them to run away.
But they had nowhere else to go.
In the end, they could only adapt and, hopefully, become used to this and make some progress with him one of these days.
"How was your trip?" Kent asked in a soothing tone, while his hands gently pressed Vexthra’s nipples. She let out a gentle moan before responding.
"It was eventful. I got to walk down the street of a god world and felt how a normal person should feel. It was great, and I couldn’t have felt that if I hadn’t met you and my sisters.
Of course, as you would expect, there were some hiccups, but after flicking a certain bastard into infinity of space, I had a good time."

Kent smiled, hearing how casually Vexthra described her trip. While she may have never walked down the street of even a god-only city before, now that she had tried it, the feeling she got from that made her happy.
She was always cold and distant. But that changed when she met Kent and her sisters. So she was super happy, in fact.
However, the part about what happened between her and the storm god cracked Kent up.
He had no idea that she basically shooed a True God into space, letting him fall for thousands of light-years without even trying, but the way she said it sounded nonchalant and somehow funny.
"Sounds like you had a blast while away."

"That I did. I managed to finally retrieve the gifts I have kept in my domain all these years since I had no use for them." She looked around with a delighted expression, "Now, I have a use for them."
Kent looked around, watching his wives hold onto their gifts. They all seem happy to receive such great gifts from their big sister.
"I won’t ask for my gift because I know it will make the ladies jealous," Kent shamelessly said, already waiting for his gift.
He may have legendary weapons and treasures in the tower store that he can buy any day. However, just one of said treasures costs hundreds of billions in tower points.
So if he can receive a gift of the same value from Vexthra, but for free, he would be happy.
"I have something good for you. However, it isn’t exactly a treasure... more like an item that will help you in activating a treasure that is already in your possession."
Kent furrowed his brow, hearing that... ’A treasure already in my possession,’ he thought for a moment, then he suddenly sent his mind to an item given to him by Enzi.
"The Jade Void Wings."
"Indeed. To bind it, you need something called Void Liquid. It is extremely rare, but I had one stored away years ago. Now, you can use it to bind the wings to your soul.
Once you are done with that, I can assure you that, be it your humanoid dragon form or your real dragon form, nobody below the Immortal stage can catch up to you in terms of speed."
Kent smiled and gave Vexthra’s boobs a gentle squeeze, "Lucky me, I guess."
"That is indeed true. I also managed to secure what I went for ahead of time, so you are set to embark on your journey to finding Elina."
"Thank you."
"Don’t worry about it. Finding Elina is the most important thing now. We have no idea how she is faring — whether she is having a good life or not — so you must get to her faster."
Kent nodded and kissed her neck.
"However, I have some good news and some bad news for you. Which do you want to hear first?"

This legendary sword now lies like an ordinary sword in Velyra’s hand.
That is just a mind-bending sight that, if someone has even a tiny idea of what treasures the ladies are holding.
Every last one of them held a treasure.
Even Miryssa held a small token in her palm, and considering the look on her face, she was probably in deep shock.
She is a Universal God, so for Vexthra to give her something that brought such a reaction from her, Kent knew it might be something even gods would love to have.
Yuyin was also there, seated beside Liora, reading through a scroll that felt both real and illusory.
She doesn’t have a True Name yet, but she fits in with the ladies, especially considering she is a foxkin, one of the most beautiful races in the universe.
"Looks like you ladies are having some fun," Kent said, walking toward them with a broad smile on his face.
Miryssa and Yuyin shifted, suddenly feeling like they were overdressed for the moment.
They are basically in their lingerie like the rest of Kent’s wives.
However, while they seem comfortable in their skin, the two were a bit shy.
However, they quickly calmed down when they realised they were among their fellow ladies.
Being shy is just an instinctive reaction.
And as the rest of the ladies hugged and kissed him, they further calmed down.
Luckily, Kent didn’t make things difficult for them by coming for a kiss or a hug.
The ladies also didn’t force them.
However, what followed next left them flustered.
Kent sat down and hugged Vexthra from behind.
Then, using both hands, he started kneading her boobs.
This sight left the two newcomers flustered, even prompting them to run away.
But they had nowhere else to go.
In the end, they could only adapt and, hopefully, become used to this and make some progress with him one of these days.
"How was your trip?" Kent asked in a soothing tone, while his hands gently pressed Vexthra’s nipples.
She let out a gentle moan before responding.
"It was eventful.
I got to walk down the street of a god world and felt how a normal person should feel.
It was great, and I couldn’t have felt that if I hadn’t met you and my sisters.
Of course, as you would expect, there were some hiccups, but after flicking a certain bastard into infinity of space, I had a good time."
Kent smiled, hearing how casually Vexthra described her trip.
While she may have never walked down the street of even a god-only city before, now that she had tried it, the feeling she got from that made her happy.
She was always cold and distant.
But that changed when she met Kent and her sisters.
So she was super happy, in fact.
However, the part about what happened between her and the storm god cracked Kent up.
He had no idea that she basically shooed a True God into space, letting him fall for thousands of light-years without even trying, but the way she said it sounded nonchalant and somehow funny.
"Sounds like you had a blast while away."
"That I did.
I managed to finally retrieve the gifts I have kept in my domain all these years since I had no use for them." She looked around with a delighted expression, "Now, I have a use for them."
Kent looked around, watching his wives hold onto their gifts.
They all seem happy to receive such great gifts from their big sister.
"I won’t ask for my gift because I know it will make the ladies jealous," Kent shamelessly said, already waiting for his gift.
He may have legendary weapons and treasures in the tower store that he can buy any day.
However, just one of said treasures costs hundreds of billions in tower points.
So if he can receive a gift of the same value from Vexthra, but for free, he would be happy.
"I have something good for you.
However, it isn’t exactly a treasure... more like an item that will help you in activating a treasure that is already in your possession."
Kent furrowed his brow, hearing that... ’A treasure already in my possession,’ he thought for a moment, then he suddenly sent his mind to an item given to him by Enzi.
"The Jade Void Wings."
"Indeed.
To bind it, you need something called Void Liquid.
It is extremely rare, but I had one stored away years ago.
Now, you can use it to bind the wings to your soul.
Once you are done with that, I can assure you that, be it your humanoid dragon form or your real dragon form, nobody below the Immortal stage can catch up to you in terms of speed."
Kent smiled and gave Vexthra’s boobs a gentle squeeze, "Lucky me, I guess."
"That is indeed true.
I also managed to secure what I went for ahead of time, so you are set to embark on your journey to finding Elina."
"Thank you."
"Don’t worry about it.
Finding Elina is the most important thing now.
We have no idea how she is faring — whether she is having a good life or not — so you must get to her faster."
Kent nodded and kissed her neck.
"However, I have some good news and some bad news for you.
Which do you want to hear first?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1265: Good News and Bad News
paragraphs: When asked to choose which to hear first, between good news and bad news, the choice should always be good news first.
Some would say that going for the bad news first, then picking the good news later, helps clear the bad news and leaves the person enthusiastic about the good news they hear.
However, bad news is always there to stay, whereas good news is but a fleeting moment.

If one learns bad news before hearing good news, they would still have the lingering bad news at the back of their minds. This, in a way, limits the amount of joy they should have felt from the good news.
So Kent made his choice..."The good news first."
As they say, live now and cry later.
Vexthra nodded and produced a small disc-like item. "This is the Star Compass. It is what I went to the god realm for. This item is what you will need to cross over from this galaxy to the other."
Kent looked at the item with a scrutinising gaze. It seems ordinary to him. There seems to be nothing interesting about it.
However, when he tried to probe deeper into it, something blocked his senses, preventing him from seeing what it was made of.
"How does it work?" Kent asked.
"Very simple. Once you reach the edge of this galaxy and you activate it, it will lead you to a pathway called [Star Gateway]. This Star Gateway links galaxies together.
From what I learned, these pathways used to be safe and very easy to traverse, but not anymore." Vexthra paused and took a deep breath..."Now, about the good news part."
Kent raised his brow, somehow stunned..."So that wasn’t the good news?"
"Of course not. The good news starts when you step into the Star Gateway. In fact, the good news and the bad news are both on the path through the Star Gateway."
"I see." Kent nodded, slightly taken aback but ready to hear what lies ahead, "You can go ahead then."
"So the good news is, there is a path that is relatively safe compared to the chaotic path through the Spatial Field, where terrifying space beasts lie in wait to slaughter and devour you.
Through this Gateway, although there are space beasts, their numbers are limited, and they aren’t too powerful compared to the Spatial Field.
Of course, the reason why they wouldn’t be too dangerous is that this Star Compass will shield you from Immortal King-level space beasts and above.
However, you would have to fight True Immortal-level space beasts and below."
Kent smiled and said, "Some good news you have there, Vex. But I suppose it’s better than facing demigods and shit."
Vexthra also smiled, but she said nothing. Deep down, she knew battling space beasts, even those at just the Death Stage, was already too damn dangerous for someone like Kent, who was but a mortal.
So, if that is an impossible battle, then moving from Root Immortal to True Immortal would be a battle that Kent would never forget.

"I know it is impossible to face such danger. But you can run since this is not a trial but a journey from one point to another," Vexthra said thoughtfully. "You can even choose not to battle a single beast and just make a run for it."
"It was also one of the reasons why I brought the Void Liquid. Once you fuse with the Jade Void Wings, your speed will become much more explosive."
"That makes sense. If you can’t win, then better run," Kent chuckled, already feeling a headache.
"What about the bad news?" If the good news is already this depressing, then the bad news will be heartbreaking for sure.

"For the bad news, the Star Compass, once activated, will only last for 101 days. Not even a second would be added to that time, so you would have that long to traverse the chaotic path of the Star Gateway from this galaxy to where you intend to go.
If you fail to reach there and the time runs out, then the Immortal Kings and above space beasts will sense you and come after you."𝚏𝐫𝚎𝗲𝕨𝐞𝐛𝕟𝚘𝐯𝚎𝗹.𝕔𝐨𝗺
"What was I even expecting?" Kent laughed, feeling amused at the moment. He had never once considered that maybe this was just him facing the backlash for all the pain he had caused in the past.
He knew he had lived many lives after all. However, looking at the journey now laid out before him, he knew he would soon be embarking on a chaotic adventure, one that would test him.
Of course, he could have easily travelled to the other galaxy if he were selfish.
In fear of causing irreversible damage to the fabric of reality, using the Starbound Compass would have come in handy at this point.
However, he learned that whenever he used the Starbound Compass to travel the universe, he irretrievably harmed the fabric of reality.
This harm can, in a way, destroy an entire planet overnight, or even a whole planetary system.
So he refuses to use it again. According to Vexthra, the compass is a part of something big. Using it in its singular form is a risk he cannot afford to take.
Now, his only way forward is to use the method Vexthra had gotten him and hope that he makes it through within 101 days.
"It is better than none," Kent said, somehow okay with the turn of events..."At least I now know there is a path and the strength of the beings I would be facing."
Kent let out a deep sigh. "Although no training will ever prepare me to face True Immortals, with enough preparation, I can make it through."
"That is the spirit." Vexthra commended him. Of course, she didn’t want to dampen his spirit, not when he was already under a lot of pressure.
"I would work hard to prepare for this adventure. But before that, I have to go away for a while. I believe that with where I intend to go next, I will make some progress there."
Vexthra turned and stared at him wildly, "Where do you intend to go?"
"The Upside-Down Underworld Forest." This time, Vexthra furrowed her brow, somehow intrigued with the choice Kent had made.
"One of the Ten Calamity Zones. Looks like you will be facing a lot of danger there. Perhaps that is for the best. It will prepare you for the star gateway"
"I know and am prepared for it. After all, the plan is to get to Elina as fast as possible."
"I see. Be careful then. I know you are strong, but a lawless domain is both unpredictable and incredibly dangerous for everyone, regardless of your strength."
Kent nodded.
He had already done his research many years ago, so he is ready to face it. However, before that, there is also the need to address the remaining three beasts he needed the fangs for.
He gave that task to the tower and Gaia, so by the time he is back from the Upside-Down Underworld Forest, he will have an answer for them.
Kent decided to spend some quality time with Vexthra, who had missed out on all the fun. Of course, his wives had already made up their minds to let him spend most of his time on the mission.
They don’t want to disturb him more often and distract him from his mission.
So in the end, he spent only two days with Vexthra and retired to the Sword Tower to fuse with the Jade Void Wings.

chapters.title: Chapter 1266: Roadmap to greatness
paragraphs: The moment Kent arrived in the Sword Tower, he retrieved the [Jade Void Wings] and placed them before him. It had three pairs, meaning the left wing had three and the right also had three, making six in total.
Looking at the silver shine on the dark metallic jade wings, Kent couldn’t help but wonder just what would happen to his dragon wings when he fused with them.
He wasnt even concerned about the origin of the wings. He is more focused on what would become of his own wings.
"I am probably overthinking this, but with my dragon wings almost metallic, wouldn’t this add the metal I am lacking, thereby making me have metal wings from henceforth?"
Kent said, a chuckle following.
The last couple of days had been wild.
He got to battle immortals—even if they were sorry excuses for immortals—and even created a legendary Soul Warrior that could go toe to toe with a Root Immortal.
He also seemed to have unlocked a new aspect of cultivating his soul, and an even bigger boon since he could now break at least three more limits on each of his attributes.
He had already broken 12—three each: body, mind, soul, and cultivation.
However, with this new way of cultivating his soul, now that he had reached level 3 Heavenly Ascension and Tier 19 in soul cultivation, he was eligible to break 12 more, three for each.
Now, lying before him was a wing he seemed to have some familiarity with, yet he couldn’t make sense of where that familiarity was coming from.
But that is beside the point. His focus is more on how fast his speed will become when he is already super fast.
[The master is already faster than a Death Stage warrior. The master can even go toe to toe with a Root Immortal that has formed their first Immortal Qi if he uses all 120,000 flame veins.
So if the master were to fuse with the Jade Void Wings, the chance of you surpassing even Spirit Immortal and matching Core Immortal in speed isn’t impossible.
Of course, this is just my assumption. The master is known to turn small things into big ones, so anything can happen.]
Kent smiled and nodded to the encouraging words of the tower. He indeed tended to make things big when they were only meant to be small.
Of course, the last time he checked, he was much more dangerous in his real dragon form. This meant that with these new wings, there was no telling what was possible or impossible.
Still, Kent couldn’t get his mind off what Vexthra said.
The idea that to get to Elina, he would have to face immortals as strong as True Immortals was just too absurd.
He had an appointment with [Fate] in less than five years. Vexthra had already warned him that he should be careful when dealing with Fate. He tended to be tricky and wicked most of the time.
However, now, he would have to face another level of danger simply because one of his destinies was trapped on the other side of the galaxy.𝑓𝑟ℯ𝘦𝓌𝘦𝘣𝑛𝑜𝓋𝑒𝓁.𝑐ℴ𝓂

"Tower, be honest with me. Even if I fuse with this wing and somehow manage to saturate my two cores, what are my chances of making it to Elina’s galaxy in one piece?" Kent asked, already prepared to hear that his chances were next to zero.
However, what the tower said took him aback.
[Master, one of my abilities is to find ways for the master to break through his shackles. So far, the master has made so much progress. However, there is still room for improvement.
This is also why I believe the master is not only ready, but he will always rise to the occasion when the time comes.
For now, I have created a list of five things the master must accomplish over the next five years to be prepared for what is coming.
First, the master must saturate both cores and store about 500,000 blood essence for emergencies.
Second, the master must break 36 limits. You have already accomplished 12; you have 24 more left to go.
Third, the master must add 30,000 more flame veins to the 120,000 already created. This is a must if the master wants to match the speed of a True Immortal.
Fourth, the master must awaken at least 90,600 blood runes (seals). This can be accomplished through two additional blood-cleansing baths. The master had already awakened 55,600 blood seals.
Lastly, the master must awaken his Chaos Heart. This means the master must undergo his first Dragon Tribulation as a mortal.
If the master can accomplish these five things, then the first form of the [Claw Art] can be learned, and the master will have the trump card he can use to face even True Immortals.]
Kent never expected the tower to be this thorough with preparations for his upcoming mission. It seemed the tower was even more worried than he was, so she had created the roadmap for him to follow.

"You really think I can form a Chaos Heart as a mortal?" Kent asked. One of the reasons the Chaos Dragon was destructive was due to several factors. However, the most important of them was the Chaos Heart.
From the memories Kent had recovered so far about Chaos, he had formed two [Chaos Hearts].
This allowed him to not only recover his energy much more quickly, but he could tap into the true Chaos Energy of his bloodline.
It made him chaotic and very dangerous by all standards during his time in the Blood System.
So Kent knew that if he managed to form a Chaos Heart, perhaps passing through the Star Gateway wouldn’t be impossible.

[Anything is possible, master. We just have to work hard to find the right opportunities and grab them. I have already prepared a roadmap and even started finding ways to get them much faster before your next meeting with Fate.]
"Thank you, tower."
[I am here to help the master grow into who he is meant to be.]
Kent knew the path to becoming a True Primordial would be harrowing. But he believed one day, he would make it. As to how, he knew it would be through pain and suffering,
But he would endure if it meant protecting what he loved and cared for.
Kent brought the Void Liquid that Vexthra gave him close to his mouth and gulped it down. The moment he did, the wings vibrated, sending ripples all over the Sword Tower.
Although the eye couldn’t see, tiny void cracks appeared wherever the ripple passed. Suddenly, without Kent even doing anything, the wings slowly rose from the ground and hovered on Kent’s back.
An insane amount of Void Energy suddenly started pouring out from it, instantly shattering the void around Kent. Then they began circling him.
[The master shouldn’t move.]
Kent nodded and remained seated in his lotus posture as the wings circled around. After a few minutes moving around him, they stopped but kept releasing powerful void energy.
Suddenly, all six wings turned into dark orbs, and as if they meant to hurt him, they slammed into his back and vanished into his body.
Kent only felt a tap on his back at first. However, a few seconds after the orbs entered his body, the pain came.
"AAAAAAAAAAARRGH"

The moment he did, the wings vibrated, sending ripples all over the Sword Tower.
Although the eye couldn’t see, tiny void cracks appeared wherever the ripple passed.
Suddenly, without Kent even doing anything, the wings slowly rose from the ground and hovered on Kent’s back.
An insane amount of Void Energy suddenly started pouring out from it, instantly shattering the void around Kent.
Then they began circling him.
[The master shouldn’t move.]
Kent nodded and remained seated in his lotus posture as the wings circled around.
After a few minutes moving around him, they stopped but kept releasing powerful void energy.
Suddenly, all six wings turned into dark orbs, and as if they meant to hurt him, they slammed into his back and vanished into his body.
Kent only felt a tap on his back at first.
However, a few seconds after the orbs entered his body, the pain came.
"AAAAAAAAAAARRGH"

chapters.title: Chapter 1267: Fusing With The Jade Void Wings
paragraphs: The pain was instant and extremely bone-shattering.
Kent didn’t even have a moment to relax since the pain didn’t stop but kept increasing by the second. He felt his bones breaking and reforming over and over again.
It was like the six orbs that entered his body had completely taken over his dragon physique and started remoulding him into a being worthy of using the Jade Void Wings.
However, while that is a good thing, the pain that came with it was just too unbearable.
No mortal should be subjected to that kind of pain. However, as painful as it got, Kent remained conscious, his gums bleeding from all the gritting and biting he was doing.
Minutes passed, and in no time, an hour came, but the pain only seemed to be increasing.
Eventually, it became so unbearable that staying conscious would break his mind, so he let the tower knock him unconscious.

However, just when he lost consciousness, his soul was pulled out from his body, appearing in a green field in an unknown realm. Everything happened so fast that before he knew, his surroundings had changed.
Kent had no idea the realm he appeared in, but he would take that over the pain he was going through in the physical realm.
"As long as this isn’t the afterlife, then I am cool." He took a deep breath and sat down, completely happy to have escaped the pain.
He expected to feel some pain when he made up his mind to fuse with the void wings. He knew those things were always painful.
However, what he felt was more than pain. It was a soul-eating, bone-shattering, mind-breaking pain that no man should be subjected to.
So, even if he didn’t know where he was, feeling no pain made him happy.
However, his relaxation was soon disturbed when, out of nowhere, the void shattered, and a powerful force slammed down, prompting him to wake.
It was only when the void shattered that he knew he was inside a special realm inside the wings. However, he didn’t concern himself with that.
"What now?" Kent looked at the crack, but aside from infinity of darkness, he saw nothing else. It was as if staring into True Darkness, hoping to see light.
However, no matter how hard he strained his eyes, he saw nothing.
The void remained open for a couple more minutes, unsure if he was being messed with. He expected something to happen, but it seemed he wouldn’t be too lucky this time around.
The void seems to be messing with him instead.
Suddenly, a wave of wind blew from it and washed over Kent.
The moment that happened, Kent saw them.

From within the void, strings of runic inscriptions poured out, arranging themselves into a string of nine vertical lines. If those verses in ancient runes saw this, they would grin and set aside everything to focus on interpreting them.
However, while extremely complex, Kent took just a single glance, and he understood what they represented.
"These are seals locked inside a technique called [Void Drive]." Kent read just a few inscriptions, but the bigger picture was painted in his mind.
"There are nine seals in total. To be able to harness the power of the Jade Void Wings fully, I must master the nine forms of the [Void Drive] technique.
The moment a level is mastered to perfection, a seal will be lifted. Once a seal is lifted, a portion of the true power of the Jade Void Wings will be lifted.
However, that isn’t all. The moment a seal is lifted, I will gain affinity for the void and be able to harness its true power in mastering the eight remaining levels."

Kent paused and took a deep breath. He may be casually reading these scripts, but the implications, the hidden meanings, and the true nature of the wing and the technique were more than he was showing.
The wings are legendary treasures. They have so much more use than just harnessing their flight ability. In fact, flight is just the basic use for it.
It can be used as armour, a weapon, a shield, and many more things. However, to master that, Kent must first of all learn the [Void Drive] technique.
Second, he must master the first form of the technique to at least an intermediate level before he can summon the wings and use them for flight.
Third, if he wants to unlock the first form of the wing, he must reach perfection, which would also give him void affinity and even set him at ’Medium’ void mastery.
It was basically going to be a wild ride and a lot of cultivation if he wanted to unlock the first form of the wing before entering the Star Gateway.
"I’d better start comprehending the technique before time goes against me." Kent closed his eyes and sent the runes to his mind space, where he began to comprehend them.
On the outside, his body was hovering midair, faint threads of void weaving a complex wing on his back.
However, if one examined the process carefully, the base of the wing wasn’t exactly touching his back. There was at least a 2-inch gap between them.
However, while that was intriguing, considering wings were supposed to be attached to the skin and even linked to their bones, the important thing was what happened 24 hours later.
After three pairs of wings formed behind him, he transformed into his dragon form, and the same process started again.
Only that this time, the weaving was gargantuan. Colossal wings were slowly being formed, and as the days passed, his aura started to rise.𝙧𝙚𝙚𝔀𝒆𝓫𝓷𝙤𝓿𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝙤𝓶
Thirty days later, after the last pigment was woven, a mighty draconic roar escaped Kent’s enormous maw, filling the entirety of the Sword Tower.
CRACK
Suddenly, the void cracked, and, as if Kent were on autopilot, he flapped his wings and vanished into the void. The void closed the next second.

Meanwhile, in the Jade Void Wing Realm, Kent had successfully comprehended the technique. Then, as if a higher intelligence possessed him, his mastery of the first form of the Void Drive Technique started skyrocketing.
A technique has four levels of mastery.
There were Basic, Intermediate, Advanced, and Perfection. Each level of mastery increased the technique or skill’s power output.
Kent had learned the first form of the [Void Drive] technique called [Void Glide]. This form allowed him to glide through the air by harnessing the power of the void.
When he achieved Basic mastery, he realised that his speed had multiplied by ten. Then, without having any idea how, his comprehension took a sudden jump, allowing him to attain Intermediate mastery.
That was when his speed was multiplied by 25. Now, as he closed his eyes, comprehending the [Void Glide] toward the Advanced mastery stage, he could tell his speed would surge even more.
CRACK
Suddenly, the void burst open again, and a colossal dragon flew up, a powerful shockwave following him. When he came to a stop, the space between his talons and around his wings shattered.
Kent raised his head into the air and let out yet another mighty and victorious roar.
ROAR
The three pairs of void wings hovered two inches off his extremely sturdy, scaly body.
His eyes opened a few seconds later, releasing a powerful energy. He transformed into his humanoid form. In that form, too, the void wings hovered inches off his skin.
However, when he gave them a command to spread, they did, and then, with a flap, he shot into the air like a missile.
"Interesting"

chapters.title: Chapter 1268: Planet Bayla
paragraphs: Kent circles in the air for a few minutes, getting used to the Jade Void Wings. They are like a new extension of his body, so he wants to feel it naturally first before unleashing their true power.
After getting a feel of it, he landed slowly on the ground, a beaming smile painting his face.
"This is amazing. I can choose which wing to use," he muttered.
Before fusing with the wings, he was concerned about something in both good and bad ways.

He knew fusing with the wings meant making them a part of him. He was okay with that. After all, Vexthra and the tower told him that the moment he was done fusing with the wings, his speed would skyrocket.
That was a good thing considering the kind of missions he has ahead of him. However, Kent couldn’t help wondering about the implications.
Vexthra said she had read in some records that relate to the [Jade Void Wings.] From what she said, the Jade Void Wing is a treasure even celestials will kill for.
It is a universal treasure that all would desire to have.
So if fusing with it makes it his wings, wouldn’t that become a problem when someone very dangerous were to recognise it?
Kent is not stupid. He knew even with Vexthra’s help, he wasn’t invincible. Vexthra already told him that even she could be in danger when the right warrior came around.
So displaying too much to attract more attention when he already has many eyes on him isn’t something he can take in easily.
In short, the three pairs of wings that he had fused with are Universal Treasures that celestials would love to rip from his back with their bare hands and make them their own.
Thankfully and luckily, now that he had fused with the wings, he saw that his worry was unwarranted.
"There are three natures of my wings now." Kent spread the Jade Void Wings and let a wave of vibration buzz out. This form is the Jade Void Wing True form.
It is dark, with a silver metallic sheen. Void runes littered its surface, glowing with power.
However, when he willed it to disappear, it did, and then his own dragon wings appeared. In this form, he maintains his true dragon wings.
In that form, he is already faster. And if he were to add the [Flame Veins] and harness the power of his [Flame Wheels], his speed would be several times faster.
However, Kent wasn’t aiming for that. He smiled and activated the third nature of his wings.
This time, when the void wing appeared, it pressed and merged with the dragon wings instantly, causing the void to tremble.
In no time, three pairs of dark wings lined with complex golden runes and engravings appeared, causing a grin to appear on Kent’s face.
"Now, this is what I call wings," he muttered, feeling an untapped power coursing through his wings. The feeling is just too electric to ignore.

Kent could tell that if his speed in both the [Jade Void Wings] and his own [dragon wings] could match that of a Spirit Immortal, then when they merged, not even a peak Spirit Immortal could see him coming.
Of course, he isn’t saying that to look down on immortals. Kent is already aware that some cultivate just speed and flight as their combat style. Such people could give him a run for his money.
However, the speed in him now gives him the right to place himself in the ranks of a Spirit Immortal in terms of speed.

"And the best part, no god, supreme or celestial will recognise the [Jade Void Wings] in this form." That is all he could ask for now. After all, he can tell he is still lacking six more pairs of the Jade Void Wings.
But that is a problem for another day.
Kent smiled and willed the wings to disappear.

Of course, when he unlocks the first form of the wings, after he is done mastering the first form of the [Void Drive] technique, using the wings in their dark silver form would have so much versatility.
However, when he needs to harness his true speed, merging them would be the best move.
That, in a way, is what Kent wanted, and he would be super proud of himself when he faced someone faster than himself, yet with these wings, he would manage to defeat them or escape from them.
"I need to face some danger and see if I can live up to the true nature of the [Jade Void Wings] like the hype it carries."
After making sure he had had enough of the wings, he decided to think of what he planned on doing next.
He is going to the planet Bayla to learn more about his life as the Faceless Assassin and to venture into the Upside Down Underworld Forest.
Naturally, that is now his main objective.
It turned out, aside from just the three beasts he must kill, there is one more he must kill as a requirement to become a Pill Emperor.
"Advancing my pill knowledge is a must. As I draw closer to the Immortal World now, I am sure the mission Vexthra gave me will start to set itself up.
So, I need to prepare. Killing a god isn’t going to be easy, but I must be ready for the day I will get my hands on him."
Kent let his mind calm down a bit, allowing him to think of what he must do first when he gets to Planet Bayla.

"I just need to acquire an underworld pass at the Warrior Tower or the Pill Tower, then I can enter the upside-down underworld forest." Kent smiled and muttered, "It has been billions of years, but I doubt those fuckers will be any less corrupt."
Kent shook his head and wished to be proven wrong. However, if those bastards who think they are better than everyone dare to mess with him, he would probably test a few things on them.
Kent stood up and went to the Harem Tower to let his ladies know he was leaving.
"Be careful when out there, Kent," Unity said, curling herself into his arms like a ball. Kent smiled and patted her head, "I will be fine. Your husband isn’t exactly weak, you see."

"We know. But be careful. Big Sister already told us about the kind of danger you will face on this journey. We won’t be there to save you, so be sure to keep yourself alive for us," Mara said, also holding Kent on the other side.
"Yes. Even if that handsome body isn’t important to you, be sure to keep the dick alive. Some of us can’t live without it."
Selene seemed to say what they all wanted to say but were shy to say it.
Kent smiled handsomely and said, "I will do well to remember that, my love."
Selene grinned and said with a nod, "You better."
Kent just brushed aside her shamelessness and decided to kiss all of them. When he was done, he noticed Miryssa and Yuyin weren’t with the rest of his ladies.
He knew they ran to hide from him because they were not yet ready for the next step. This made him laugh. When he returns, he will spend some time with them to get to know them better.
"You ladies should also be careful when you enter the dungeon. You will start facing powerful foes from the 5th floor upwards, so have each other’s back."
They nodded.
After another round of kissing, he left. Of course, he went to see the legion and Uncle Drew first before leaving.
And since he doesn’t need to take a ship, with a mere press of a button on his Planet Teleporter, he arrived on Planet Bayla in less than a second.

chapters.title: Chapter 1269: Back To Planet Bayla
paragraphs: "RUN"
A short, dark-haired young man with obsidian-black eyes and a lean body shouted, throwing one of his daggers at a colossal snake whose body is coated in metallic plate carapace.
The dagger flashed through the air, aimed at the giant green eye of the snake with deadly precision.
However, instead of closing its eye even when it spotted the dagger coming, its eye remained open, but it slashed its tail forward, aiming to break every bone in the second person.
She too had short hair, and judging by how she dressed and the weapon she held, it was plain she was an assassin, just like the first person.
"Ryen, watch out!" The first assassin shouted, making his teammate aware of the danger coming. Thankfully, she jumped deftly into the air, a pair of batlike wings appearing behind her.
The snake missed, and the dagger found its mark. It stabbed at the eye.
However, instead of piercing through the giant green eye, the dagger bounced off it. It was like piercing a blunt pole through rubber foam.
"Ryen, run. I will hold it back for you to get away," the young man said, jumping high into the air. He, too, had bat-like wings, allowing him to hover in the air.

He attacked with his other dagger, tapping into a powerful technique that manifested a large dagger forged from dark mist. It appeared overhead, and with a gesture, it moved, aiming yet again at the eye of the snake.

Looking at the snake’s scaly body, the young man knew that attacking anywhere else would yield no results. It would be a waste of energy. So he aimed for the part of its colossal body that was relatively soft... or at least should have been.
However, considering the snake’s size and comparing it to the dagger speeding toward it, the chance of the dagger doing any damage was less than 2%.
The snake was about 1.2 km long, its head alone about 200 meters wide. It was a giant snake that the two small assassins facing it had no business taking on.
One could only wonder how they found themselves in this situation.
The aura around them was that of peak Heavenly Ascension Stage warriors. However, job class-wise, they were both Shadow Emperors. This suggested they might be good assassins.
However, against a snake of this size and strength, they were lacking.
Ryen watched as the dagger again bounced off the snake’s eye. However, instead of waiting for it to rebound, she also fired an arrow, knowing deep down it would do nothing to it.

"Ryan, I am not leaving you. We either leave here together or die together," Ryen said, zipping through the air as she dodged yet another tail slash. She landed on the ground and fired an arrow into the ground.
The next second, the sky changed, and a large arrow appeared, radiating darkness.
"Ryan, RUN!"
The young man was only on the move before, even a moment late, when the arrow appeared. A tremendous pressure fell on the snake, causing it to turn its attention to the arrow.
This gave the two siblings a chance to run.
However, they couldn’t move even a couple of meters when a powerful tail came out of nowhere, aimed at the two of them.
This time, even if they dodged, they wouldn’t be able to entirely escape the attack. They would be struck, and they knew the impact would cause them to lose in the following exchange.
Recognising the power behind the tail that had completely blocked their view, they quickly made a decision. They can’t escape it, and neither can they defend against such a strike.
They are but assassins. Defence is not their speciality.
In the end, they held each other’s hands, accepting their fate since there was no walking out of this.
"I am sorry, Ryan," Ryen said, a tear falling down her face.
She tightened the hold on her brother’s hand, making sure even in death, they would never be separated. They had been a team from the very moment they started walking the path of assassins.
They had been through many life-and-death situations together. They learned so many things together that whenever they faced a target, they knew where to attack and how to do so.
However, this time they recognised the danger and knew there was no going home today. So while their death will break the heart of many, there is no escaping it.
Suddenly, just when the tail was meters from them, a figure appeared out of nowhere and extended his hand, blocking the powerful tail attack.
BOOM
Shockwave erupted, sending dust into the air. From how sudden the tail attack came to a halt, the shockwave was just too powerful.
Beasts within a 100-mile radius of the battle will be reduced to meat paste. However, the three people remained rooted in place, unaffected by the shockwave.
Ryan and his sister Ryen remained standing, unsure of what had happened. Soon, however, they did when someone spoke.
"Ouch, that hurt," Kent screamed, pushing away the tail of the snake.
Taking his hand back, he saw tiny cuts and blood painting his palm. Ryan and Ryen opened their eyes to the back of a dark-purple-golden-haired young man.
Kent’s hair is a combination of three different colours. But while it was a beautiful sight, the two siblings were left stunned, their minds blank on what to do or say.
Soon, another line of sentence entered their heads... "Just what kind of skin do you have, bastard?"
A cold look appeared in Kent’s eyes as he turned to face the snake. He raised his hand, and 10,000 blood seals activated. Then, like a god, Kent gestured down and muttered coldly,
"Be suppressed."
The snake, despite its size and might, froze, then, as if a planet fell on him, he came crashing down hard. An invisible force seized his body and slammed him against the hard floor.
BOOM
Its immense weight caused the ground to shake, with cracks forming along it. They snaked in several directions. Some even went as deep as a thousand feet.
Kent turned to the two stunned siblings and asked, "Do you want it dead or alive?"
"Huh?" Ryen hummed, unsure of what to say.
Kent smiled and spelt it out, mistaking their stunned expression for something else... "You know. The snake, do you want it dead or alive?"
"D-Dead," Ryan stammered, but he said what needed to be said.
Kent nodded and turned back to the snake.
"For hurting my palm, allow me to test my self-created technique on you." Kent made a fist and raised it. Then he muttered loud enough for the snake to hear:
"Divine Flame Armament - First Form:" His words never even left his lips when the sky turned green, a powerful burning heat fell on everyone.
From the cloud, golden knuckles painted in green flames appeared.
"Giant Gauntlet Descent."
RUMBLE
The ground shook, sending shockwaves everywhere. Ryan and his sister shielded their faces from the heat as the giant gauntlet appeared.
Then, as if gods had pushed it, it fell hard with a crashing force and slammed into the colossal snake.
BOOM
The ground exploded, and lava spewed out, splashing for hundreds of miles in all directions. Kent and the twins were thousands of miles away before even the explosion happened.
Kent took them away without them even knowing how he did it.
When the explosion ended, Kent vanished and reappeared 5 seconds later. He waved his hand, and the body of the colossal snake fell, slamming to the ground.
He then turned to face the two siblings and said... "Greetings. I am Kent Madson. I trust this is Planet Bayla... right?"
He grinned.

chapters.title: Chapter 1270: Nature of Planet Bayla
paragraphs: It took Ryan and Ryen some time to come to terms with all that had just happened.
Recovering from a near-death situation to learn that their saviour was the infamous Kent Madson, whose name had appeared on both the Sword Dao Tablet and the Ice Dao Tablet, was a lot to take in.
Many fakes appeared claiming to be Kent Madson; however, while no one believed them, the handsome dragon before them made them inclined to believe him.
Also looking at the colossal bodies of the strongest beasts they had ever faced, now lying dead, and at Kent smiling at them, they knew this was real. That he is the real deal.
Ryan and Ryen bowed at Kent and thanked him... "Thanks for saving our lives," Ryan said, and Kent merely nodded.
"No need to thank me. I was just passing by and saw you needed help," he maintained his smile and asked again, "I hope this planet is called Bayla."
Ryen nodded and answered, "Yes. This is the Green Rain Forest, just 200,000 km away from the Dark City."
"Oh, I see. I suppose I will be leaving now," Kent turned to leave, but Ryan stopped him... "Is there something I can help you with?" Kent asked, turning to face the two siblings.
He pointed at the snake, "Won’t you be taking it with you?"
"Nope. I don’t need it. So you can have it. After all, you came all the way here to hunt it."
Yet again, the two siblings bowed toward Kent... "In that case, allow us to lead you to the Dark City. That is where we are from."
"But of course. I could use the company."
Ryan and his twin sister smiled, and they hastily stored away the colossal body of the snake that nearly killed them. The worst part is they didn’t choose to hunt this snake. They were forced to.
It would have been a regretful death, one that would have haunted them in the underworld.𝙛𝓻𝒆𝓮𝒘𝙚𝙗𝒏𝙤𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝒐𝙢
Soon, they were in the air, flying at speeds several times faster than planes on Earth. Kent deactivated both his wings and horns, but Ryan and Ryen recognised his race from the moment they saw him.
On his neck, there were three layers of cute golden dragon scales. So even a blind man would know he was a dragon. Of course, if Kent tried, he could be a complete human.
However, for some reason, he hated that idea. It made him feel inferior even thinking about it.
As they flew over the Green Rain Forest, Kent noticed no airborne beast in sight. This stirred a memory in his mind...
’This is the forest I woke up in when the Silent Shadow assassins killed my mom.’ Kent took a deep breath and let his mind wash back to his life as the Faceless Assassin.
From the memories he had recovered so far, he saw what happened to his mother. One day, he was having fun with the other kids, playing all kinds of games, when his mom came and hastily took him away.

They ran and were chased. He was very young back then, but he managed to pick up the appearance of one of the assassins. That assassin was the key he used to kill the entire Silent Shadow assassins when he came back years later.
His mom hid him in a cave and transferred the [Faceless Art] to him. From all he could remember, his mom kissed his forehead and told him to wait for her, that she would be back.

Billions of years had already passed, but she hadn’t returned, so it was plain as day that she fell to the dagger of the assassins, or she killed herself to destroy the memory of the Faceless Art and the whereabouts of her son.
Faceless, then known as Jaqen, lived in the forest for 30 years, fighting one beast after another. In a way, he grew up around beasts.
His first Face when he cultivated the Faceless Art was a River Wolf.
When he got that form, he finally managed to leave the forest without having to battle all kinds of horrific beasts.
Now, as he flew over it, he could feel the emotions of the past wash over him.
"I learned the Dark Warden family now rules the Dark City." Kent chose to make it sound as if he had heard it from others. But from what he knew, the Dark City was ruled by the Dark Warden family.
They are a family of assassins.
From what he knew, Planet Bayla was ruled by three families back in the day.
There are the Dark Warden family, who rule the Dark City.
The Kailan Drow family, who rule the Hollow City, and the Gatty family, rulers of the Great Pill City.
It had always been like that for years. The Dark Wardens are assassins, the Kailans are swordsmen, and the Gatty are the alchemists.
Ryen answered... "Yes, however, they are now known as the Assassin Temple. They rebranded 20,000 years ago when the previous patriarch ascended, and his eldest son took over."
"Oh, sounds like I had outdated information," Kent chuckled and turned to Ryen. "Care to tell me the structure of Planet Bayla then?"
Ryen nodded and started updating him on all he had to know.

So it turned out, aside from the Dark City now turned upside down by an ambitious leader, the Gattys and the Kailans were still the same. They had the same structure as before. However, they now had strict and shameless rules.

For example, the Gattys had made it so that before one can enter the city, they must pay ten thousand high-grade spirit stones. But even when they entered, the city had been structured into three regions.
Paying ten thousand spirit stones only gets one into the outer region. One needs to pay 1 million spirit stones to enter the inner region and 100 million to enter the core region.
Of course, if the entrant is a Pill King or higher, there is a 50% discount. But that is where it gets weird and shameless.
If an alchemist enters and concocts a pill, they must buy a permit from the Gattys, and when they make a pill, they must sell it inside the city at a 50% discount.
Basically, the Gattys had become money-lovers who would do anything to earn it, even if it meant swindling alchemists.

As for the Kailans, they had adapted over the years and now take into their fold other weapon users besides swordsmen. However, despite that being a low blow to their former strict swordsmen-only rule, they still stuck to their beliefs.
Warriors were treated kindly, while the non-warriors weren’t even spared a glance.
"It is a shit show for sure." Kent didn’t know how to feel. The world he knew was on the brink of becoming a demented planet. All the people leading it were scums who loved to steal from the poor.
"It is indeed a bad place, but since they are protecting us from the outsiders and the beast invasions, we aren’t too mad at them," Ryan said with a chuckle.
"I guess you are right." Kent wasn’t about to get angry and go on a killing spree. If he had nothing better to do, maybe he would have attempted it, but not when he came for something important.
"I suppose you two ending up in the lair of the Metallic Scale Slash Snake had to do with the Assassin Tower," Kent asked, and the two siblings sighed.
