chapters.title: Chapter 1271: Unexpected News
paragraphs: "Something like that," Ryan said with a beaten sigh. Ryen continued, "The only way to keep our families protected is by having money.
However, making money in Dark City is extremely hard, so we had to come all the way here to see if we can kill some of the sought-after beasts. Their bodies sell for quite a few spirit stones"
Ryen also sighed, but she continued, "We had some success since both of us had formed pretty strong shadow domains. With our strength, we managed to keep our families protected.
However, three days ago, the youngest son of the current Dark Lord tried to assault our little sister, who had just started her cultivation.
Safe to say we didn’t take kindly to that. In the end, our entire family was captured, and unless we bring a scale from a Metallic Scale Slash Snake, they would be sold into slavery."
"Did that bastard at least die?" Kent asked with a chuckle. He already hated the bastard without knowing him.
The mere fact that he tried to force himself on someone without their consent is a clear sign of how such a person should be treated.
Ryan shook his head, "Unfortunately, no. He survived since his death would have been our death."
"I see." Kent didn’t even have to be told twice what kind of beating he would have to give this bastard when he got his hands on him.
In the past, he had assassinated many like him. Now, if he had the time, he would kill him to save a lot of young girls the pain of being suppressed by such scum.
"One last thing, if I want to enter the Upside Down Underworld Forest, where do I get an underworld token?"
This time, Ryan and Ryen widened their eyes, unsure of what to even say.
"You are kidding, right?" Ryen asked, looking at Kent with a stunned expression.
"I am dead serious. I want to get one since my reason for coming here is to enter the Upside Down Underworld Forest. This is why I would like to know where to go to get one."
"Haven’t you heard?"
"Heard what?" Kent stared at Ryan with a calm yet questioning gaze.

He seemed to be missing something, which is perfectly understandable. It has been billions of years already since he ventured into the Upside Down Underworld Forest, so it is normal if some things skipped him.
However, from the way the siblings are looking at him, it seems something big happened that he would soon be made aware of.
Ryan stared at his sister and then sighed... "From what I know, about half a million years ago, the Upside Down Underworld Forest fell."
"Fell? As in the upside down fell to the ground?"
"Yes. It fell, and nobody knew what caused it. However, from what I was told, when it did, something nobody was prepared for stirred within it.
All who went to inspect never returned. Later, rumours spread that the mysterious Midnight Shadows sent immortals to come and check." Ryan paused and calculated his words before continuing.

"They said twenty immortals entered and only one returned, barely hanging on to his life. They said he said only one word before passing out. He never woke up. Also, nobody was able to decipher the meaning behind that word."
"And what word was that?"
Ryan hesitated, but he said it, "Zhaeryn."
Kent’s eyes widened as he came to a sudden stop, his heartbeat rising in an instant.
Ryan and Ryen also stopped and turned to look at Kent. They were shocked to see he had turned pale. Naturally, they seemed to think he understood the word.
However, they didn’t dare ask him.
"Are you all right?" Instead, they decided to check up on him. Hearing Ryen’s concerned voice, Kent pulled himself together.
"I am fine." He let a smile appear on his face, but the two siblings knew he was merely putting up a farce. Kent was not fine one bit.
However, yet again, they didn’t dare ask him anything aside from looking at him. Eventually, Kent recovered and returned to his former self.
"Please tell me they’ve sealed the entrance after the fall," Kent suddenly asked.
"They did. An Immortal Lord from the Midnight Shadows came to seal it personally. From what I’ve heard, only a select few from the Midnight Shadows can enter.
Of course, all of this is what people said, and I heard. I apologise if I didn’t know everything."
"Thank you," Kent said and resumed flying. Ryan and Ryen followed.
Kent remained quiet, but his mind was spinning like a ball rolling down a steep slope. He had wanted to hear something dangerous, but what he had chanced upon was beyond dangerous.
’It can’t be. It can’t be them. It is still too early to be them.’
[Core of the Universe]
While Kent’s mind was spinning, a cosmic meeting was about to take place at the core of the universe between Lady Universe, the Enchantress, and Fate...

Lady Universe turned and looked at the silhouette of the Enchantress, then she turned to Fate. That sly old man, despite manifesting himself like a hologram inside the core of the universe, still had a pipe in his mouth.
Of course, since Lady Universe and the Enchantress said nothing, he could only continue to smoke it.
"So whose fault is it?" Lady Universe asked, directing her comment to the Enchantress and Fate. However, they both knew she was talking to Fate.
That old fox smiled and shook his head, "Don’t look at me like I have committed a grave sin. I am old, so my memory isn’t as sharp as before."
"Oh, cut your nonsense. You are Fate. Clearly, you knew what you were doing. Don’t blame it on your bad memory," the Enchantress fired back at him, already annoyed at Fate.
"Why did you do it? You and I both know the moment he learned that his adversaries are back, he would become restless, so why did you do it?"
Both Lady Universe and the Enchantress seemed pissed at Fate.
What many didn’t know was that when the Primordial Era fell, it wasn’t because the Void Beasts won. It was actually the opposite; it was because they lost that the Primordial Era fell.

The reason being, to seal them back, the entire Primordial Era was sacrificed. Of course, many lived to continue the many eras that came after the First Era. However, the majority of it was destroyed.
The seal prevented the Void Beasts from coming back.
However, they already knew a day would come when they would return. They would first come by influencing the universe to open a path for them.
They used the Fordaken race for that when they invaded the Primordial era, and now it seems they are trying the same, yet different, method.
Zhaeryn is a word from a language called Aelthryn. This language was the natural dialect of the Void Beasts Race.
It translates to Mutation.
While mutation is something that happens among beasts of all races and types, when spoken in Aelthryn, it means a Void Temple had appeared, and a mutation had started taking place.
It is a foreign language, and as such, only primordial beings understood it.
Kent had no idea why, but it seemed now he was fated to enter this place... Naturally, for the first time, he felt fear.
And all this was Fate’s fault.

sentences.text: "Something like that," Ryan said with a beaten sigh.
Ryen continued, "The only way to keep our families protected is by having money.
However, making money in Dark City is extremely hard, so we had to come all the way here to see if we can kill some of the sought-after beasts.
Their bodies sell for quite a few spirit stones"
Ryen also sighed, but she continued, "We had some success since both of us had formed pretty strong shadow domains.
With our strength, we managed to keep our families protected.
However, three days ago, the youngest son of the current Dark Lord tried to assault our little sister, who had just started her cultivation.
Safe to say we didn’t take kindly to that.
In the end, our entire family was captured, and unless we bring a scale from a Metallic Scale Slash Snake, they would be sold into slavery."
"Did that bastard at least die?" Kent asked with a chuckle.
He already hated the bastard without knowing him.
The mere fact that he tried to force himself on someone without their consent is a clear sign of how such a person should be treated.
Ryan shook his head, "Unfortunately, no.
He survived since his death would have been our death."
"I see." Kent didn’t even have to be told twice what kind of beating he would have to give this bastard when he got his hands on him.
In the past, he had assassinated many like him.
Now, if he had the time, he would kill him to save a lot of young girls the pain of being suppressed by such scum.
"One last thing, if I want to enter the Upside Down Underworld Forest, where do I get an underworld token?"
This time, Ryan and Ryen widened their eyes, unsure of what to even say.
"You are kidding, right?" Ryen asked, looking at Kent with a stunned expression.
"I am dead serious.
I want to get one since my reason for coming here is to enter the Upside Down Underworld Forest.
This is why I would like to know where to go to get one."
"Haven’t you heard?"
"Heard what?" Kent stared at Ryan with a calm yet questioning gaze.
He seemed to be missing something, which is perfectly understandable.
It has been billions of years already since he ventured into the Upside Down Underworld Forest, so it is normal if some things skipped him.
However, from the way the siblings are looking at him, it seems something big happened that he would soon be made aware of.
Ryan stared at his sister and then sighed...
"From what I know, about half a million years ago, the Upside Down Underworld Forest fell."
"Fell?
As in the upside down fell to the ground?"
"Yes.
It fell, and nobody knew what caused it.
However, from what I was told, when it did, something nobody was prepared for stirred within it.
All who went to inspect never returned.
Later, rumours spread that the mysterious Midnight Shadows sent immortals to come and check." Ryan paused and calculated his words before continuing.
"They said twenty immortals entered and only one returned, barely hanging on to his life.
They said he said only one word before passing out.
He never woke up.
Also, nobody was able to decipher the meaning behind that word."
"And what word was that?"
Ryan hesitated, but he said it, "Zhaeryn."
Kent’s eyes widened as he came to a sudden stop, his heartbeat rising in an instant.
Ryan and Ryen also stopped and turned to look at Kent.
They were shocked to see he had turned pale.
Naturally, they seemed to think he understood the word.
However, they didn’t dare ask him.
"Are you all right?" Instead, they decided to check up on him.
Hearing Ryen’s concerned voice, Kent pulled himself together.
"I am fine." He let a smile appear on his face, but the two siblings knew he was merely putting up a farce.
Kent was not fine one bit.
However, yet again, they didn’t dare ask him anything aside from looking at him.
Eventually, Kent recovered and returned to his former self.
"Please tell me they’ve sealed the entrance after the fall," Kent suddenly asked.
"They did.
An Immortal Lord from the Midnight Shadows came to seal it personally.
From what I’ve heard, only a select few from the Midnight Shadows can enter.
Of course, all of this is what people said, and I heard.
I apologise if I didn’t know everything."
"Thank you," Kent said and resumed flying.
Ryan and Ryen followed.
Kent remained quiet, but his mind was spinning like a ball rolling down a steep slope.
He had wanted to hear something dangerous, but what he had chanced upon was beyond dangerous.

It can’t be them.
It is still too early to be them.’
[Core of the Universe]

That sly old man, despite manifesting himself like a hologram inside the core of the universe, still had a pipe in his mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 1272: A Short Story
paragraphs: [Core Of The Universe]
"So, are you going to tell us why you did what you did?" Lady Universe asked, looking hatefully at Fate.
The old fox smiled and took a drag of his pipe, letting the smoke seep through his nostrils... He turned to the Enchantress and asked in a casual tone,
"Why don’t you pull up the timeline?"
She seemed hesitant, but to understand why Fate made Kent aware of the happenings in the Upside Down Underworld Forest, she did.
The Enchantress protects the sacred timeline of the universe. She ensures the timeline isn’t tampered with by an external force.

Within this timeline, everyone’s fate could be found and examined to some degree. Of course, since Fate was the one who commanded and controlled all fate, showing something that sacred wasn’t too much of an ask.
When the Enchantress summoned the timeline, Fate waved his hand, and a single string of fate was pulled from the countless streams of fate.
He made it hover before all three of them gathered at the core of the universe... The colour of the fate line was golden, a rather unique colour, considering most fate lines are white.
"This is the fate of someone I believe we are all aware of." The two ladies nodded.

Fate smiled and pulled another drag. Then he waved his hand, and two more threads appeared. When Lady Universe and the Enchantress saw the two purple strings of fate appear, they furrowed their brows.
"Now, tell me what you see," Fate asked like he was schooling a bunch of kids. The Enchantress and Lady Universe didn’t like his tone, but they answered.
"These strings are the fate of people destined to die unjustly."
"Indeed," Fate nodded, then waved his hand and brought the two strings of fate toward the golden one. When they got closer, they started changing from purple to white.

This made the two ladies frown a bit. Of course, they said nothing and let Fate do his thing. When he was done, the golden thread of fate remained brilliant gold, and the two purple ones turned to brilliant white.
"What do you see now?" Fate asked, and the two ladies turned and looked at each other.

"I see two fates full of light and greatness," Lady Universe responded, but then she added in a cold tone, "But this doesn’t explain what we asked you. Why did you mess with the fate of the Primordial Chaos Dragon?"
"To save the life of these twins, of course."
"Yes. But at the cost of Chaos’s. Do you know what learning about the Void Beast Race will do to him? You know of his history with them and what he had lost against these foes.
So was risking his life over two people whose original fate doesn’t have any impact on the universe really necessary?"
"Oh, but it is very necessary." Fate smiled and waved his hand again. This time, fourteen strings of fate appeared, all dull gold.
However, while they were dull gold compared to the fate thread of the Chaos Dragon, there were some similarities to them if one looks closer.
But while these threads of fate are candy to the eye, the two ladies didn’t focus on the thirteen golden threads.
They instead focused on the fourteenth thread. That one was crimson, a stark contrast to the thirteen dull gold, the brilliant gold and two white threads of fate.
When they saw this, they frowned. "What is the meaning of this, Fate?" the Enchantress asked, her wavy hair shaking behind her.
"Watch and learn, Enchantress. This might just be the only time you get to see Fate at work." The sly old fox grinned and waved his hand again.
This time, the two white threads of fate moved and stopped beside the crimson fate thread. The moment they got closer, they turned from white to gold.
"WHAT?" Both Lady Universe and the Enchantress exclaimed in shock.
"Impossible," Lady Universe was in shock, "That shouldn’t be possible, right?"

"No mortal can resonate with a True Primordial. Only a True Primordial can resonate with a True Primordial," the Enchantress said, looking at the crimson thread of fate and the two new golden lines of fate beside it.
Fate smiled and shook his head, "You say that, but we both know when it comes to fate, nobody can tell what is possible and what isn’t."
"But how? How can mere mortals break the barriers of fate and transcend beyond what is possible? How can mortals resonate with a True Primordial?"
Fate seemed taken aback by their question. He looked at them like he was looking at a bunch of troublemakers.
In his mind, all of this was their fault, yet they had absolutely no idea what was going on.
"How about I tell you a short story?" Fate said, and the two ladies frowned but nodded. It was Fate they were talking to, so they had to play by his rules.
In the Cosmic realm, every being had a role they played and rules they went by.

The old fox smiled and started his story... "A very long time ago, a lone Enchantress and a curious Universe Core decided to play a harmless game with deadly consequences with mortals." The expression on their faces changed, but Fate didn’t mind.

"They believed mortals were limited to the rules binding them, so they picked one of them and decided to reveal themselves to him. Fate tried to warn them about the consequences of losing the game, but they didn’t listen.

I believe their exact words were: ’Oh please, what can a mere dragon with a broken heart do?’ and ’You are too drawn to the fate of mortals that you see them to be superior to us cosmic beings’." Fate chuckled, and the frown on the faces of the two ladies deepened.
"Later, they came running to Fate with tears in their eyes. When asked, he found out the mortal they looked down on was a dragon among mortals.
They lost miserably, and with their loss, the dragon was made aware of the hidden mysteries of the cosmos. And with this discovery, the threat to the sacred universe ignited.

In a way, their harmless and reckless game had bound the fate of the universe to a single man who wanted only one thing... to kill all his foes. However, he ended up taking the burden of the universe, which in the end killed him." Fate paused and looked at the two ladies, amused, and continued.
"But what did these two ladies do? They went ahead and made him another offer, one that they had no idea came with even bigger stakes than the last time."
"You can stop, Fate. We get what you are trying to say."
"Oh, but you don’t. You see, when you troublemakers chose to reincarnate his shattered souls, you inadvertently sealed his fate to all major calamity events that followed.
In other words, when you two gave him thirteen chances at life, you accidentally injured his True Primordial Fate."
Hearing this, Lady Universe and the Enchantress turned pale. If others had made this statement, the two of them wouldn’t have minded, but when it came from Fate, they knew he was telling the truth.
"Relax, ladies," Fate said before taking a drag and spewing the smoke all over. "Luckily for you ladies, your big brother Fate saw this coming, so he made preparations to fix things."

chapters.title: Chapter 1273: Fate’s Intelligence
paragraphs: There are only three colours of fate in the known universe. There is white, which can range from dull to brilliant. These colours signify the fate of all those blessed and destined for greatness.
The brighter the colour of fate, the greater their potential.
Then there is purple, which means injustice. These colours are for people who have bigger destinies but die early and unjustly before they can fulfil them.
A very long time ago, the goddess of the hunt possessed such a colour of fate, and as such, she died before her greatness shone.
Lastly, there is the golden thread of fate. This colour is for beings worthy to fight for the fate of the universe. They rarely appear, but when they do, the universe becomes peaceful.
Their presence puts everything in control. They are like the representatives of the universe in mortal form. Naturally, it was said that golden fates change the fate of others.
It was seen during the Primordial Era when the goddess of the hunt had her fate changed by the Primordial Chaos Dragon, thereby taking her from dull gold to bright purple.
However, while only these three colours are known to the known universe, there is actually one last fate that has the crimson colour. This fate is only known to the Cosmic realm...
From the start of the universe to this moment, only seven of such fates had been recorded. Now, only one of the seven remained.

Naturally, the crimson fate belongs only to the True Primordials. Six of them are dead, and the last, while alive, has his crimson fate wounded due to a mistake made by two ladies who thought they were doing the right thing.
"Giving him 13 lives, while noble and had indeed saved countless lives, came at a cost, and that was two injuries to his True Fate.
One occurred during the Chaos Era, the other during the Dark Era.
This means that when he is fully awake, these two injuries will hinder him, thereby preventing him from fulfilling his true destiny. The injuries will prevent him from becoming a True Primordial.
However, because I saw this day coming, I used the last 13 eras to prepare, and as you can see, to heal those wounds, these two people should be kept alive no matter what."
Fate pointed at the two golden threads of fate beside the crimson one.
The remaining fourteen threads of fate are the lives Kent had lived.
He lived 13 lives, starting from the primordial era, before this one final one, destined to be his last, where he would finally become who he was meant to be from birth... a True Primordial.
"Unfortunately, while I might have created the cure, messing with the fate of two innocent people came with a price that Lord Chaos must yet again pay... and continue to pay"
The Enchantress and Lady Universe took a deep breath, their expressions returning to normal yet again. However, their heartbeat still hadn’t slowed down.
Learning that they had caused this much damage over a harmless game made them finally see the errors of their ways.

If not for them, nothing that is happening today would have come to pass. They messed with Chaos and, in a way, linked him to the universe’s fate. The moment that happened, the Void Beast Race became aware of this known universe.

In a way, the known universe declared to them that they were ready for a higher form of war. And because of that, instead of becoming a True Primordial during the Primordial Era, Chaos couldn’t have that chance.
The war came before they had the chance.
Perhaps the Great War wouldn’t have happened that early. Maybe the damage caused wouldn’t have happened if Chaos hadn’t become the guardian of the universe.
Of course, there are a lot of factors that, when placed on the what-if scale, would have made a big difference in the grand scheme of things.
However, in the end, everything came down to the game the ladies played with Chaos, which they lost.
"So how did revealing to Chaos the arrival of the Void Temple solve anything?" the Enchantress asked, sounding calmer now.
"Oh, revealing that was the price he had to pay. The important thing was saving the twins. They are his only chance to recover his fate.
Inside them is the imprint of his True Primordial Fate. If they can keep it alive until Lord Chaos inherits the Six Fate Marks and 13 Life Keys, everything will be worth it."
"So what now?"
"Very simple. Since Karma has an arrangement with him in five years, I will go to that old baldy and plead to make the destruction of the Void Temple his mission.
This means Lord Chaos would have to venture into that dreadful place and do the needful." Fate smiled and took yet another drag of his pipe, letting the smoke fill the air.𝘧𝓇ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝘣𝓃ℴ𝓋𝑒𝑙.𝑐𝘰𝑚

Lady Universe narrowed her gaze at him and asked, "What did Karma say? And don’t play with me. I know you. I know you are intelligent. So you wouldn’t come here without a solid plan. So what did that bald bastard say?"

Fate chuckled and coughed a few times... "What do you expect, my lady? You and I both know Karma is mad at Lord Chaos for what he did during the Primordial Era. And since the rules don’t exactly shackle Karma, he planned to make Lord Chaos pay.

Of course, Destiny and I intervened on his behalf, and after a few sacrifices, he accepted my offer. However, he plans to sabotage his trip through the Star Gateway even if he survives the Void Temple."

Lady Universe and the Enchantress didn’t seem too surprised about what Fate said. They knew Karma was mad at Kent for shattering his soul and breaking the Circle of Karma to bring his legion back in time.
He also went ahead and lived all 13 lives to the fullest, even earning the title, Karma’s Favourite.
So he had tried many times to sabotage him in all 13 lives he had lived, but failed. This time, it seemed he had a sure way to go about it.
"What did he want in order not to do that?"
"He wanted one of two things. First, he wants Lord Chaos to go down on his knees and apologise to him." Fate paused and smirked, "I think we both know he wouldn’t do that."
The two ladies nodded, letting a smirk form at the corners of their lips. "And what is the second?"
"That one, too, is a hard ask, but he wants Enchantress to sing a lullaby, record it, and send it to him on a Cosmic Unicorn."
"That bastard. I will rip him to shreds," Lady Universe exclaimed, her expression turning dark.
"I am afraid you cannot do that, my lady. Killing him will completely shatter the Circle of Karma. When that happens, the universe will end overnight."
Lady Universe gritted her teeth, frustration bubbling in her chest.
"I will do it," the Enchantress said, causing Lady Universe to sigh.
"It’s okay, sister. Our foolishness has brought this upon us. So if it means making this sacrifice to fix things, then I will happily do it."
"Don’t worry, sister. It is only a few cosmic essences. I will recover it in a few thousand years."
"Then it is settled. I will let Karma know so he can inform Lord Chaos."
"Thank you, Fate... really," Lady Universe said, bringing a smile to Fate’s face.
"Don’t worry about it. It is what big brothers do for their silly siblings." With that, he vanished, leaving the two ladies with varied expressions.

The Enchantress and Lady Universe took a deep breath, their expressions returning to normal yet again.
However, their heartbeat still hadn’t slowed down.
Learning that they had caused this much damage over a harmless game made them finally see the errors of their ways.
If not for them, nothing that is happening today would have come to pass.
They messed with Chaos and, in a way, linked him to the universe’s fate.
The moment that happened, the Void Beast Race became aware of this known universe.
In a way, the known universe declared to them that they were ready for a higher form of war.
And because of that, instead of becoming a True Primordial during the Primordial Era, Chaos couldn’t have that chance.
The war came before they had the chance.
Perhaps the Great War wouldn’t have happened that early.
Maybe the damage caused wouldn’t have happened if Chaos hadn’t become the guardian of the universe.
Of course, there are a lot of factors that, when placed on the what-if scale, would have made a big difference in the grand scheme of things.
However, in the end, everything came down to the game the ladies played with Chaos, which they lost.
"So how did revealing to Chaos the arrival of the Void Temple solve anything?" the Enchantress asked, sounding calmer now.
"Oh, revealing that was the price he had to pay.
The important thing was saving the twins.
They are his only chance to recover his fate.
Inside them is the imprint of his True Primordial Fate.
If they can keep it alive until Lord Chaos inherits the Six Fate Marks and 13 Life Keys, everything will be worth it."
"So what now?"
"Very simple.
Since Karma has an arrangement with him in five years, I will go to that old baldy and plead to make the destruction of the Void Temple his mission.
This means Lord Chaos would have to venture into that dreadful place and do the needful." Fate smiled and took yet another drag of his pipe, letting the smoke fill the air.𝘧𝓇ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝘣𝓃ℴ𝓋𝑒𝑙.𝑐𝘰𝑚
Lady Universe narrowed her gaze at him and asked, "What did Karma say?
And don’t play with me.
I know you.
I know you are intelligent.
So you wouldn’t come here without a solid plan.
So what did that bald bastard say?"
Fate chuckled and coughed a few times...
"What do you expect, my lady?
You and I both know Karma is mad at Lord Chaos for what he did during the Primordial Era.
And since the rules don’t exactly shackle Karma, he planned to make Lord Chaos pay.
Of course, Destiny and I intervened on his behalf, and after a few sacrifices, he accepted my offer.
However, he plans to sabotage his trip through the Star Gateway even if he survives the Void Temple."
Lady Universe and the Enchantress didn’t seem too surprised about what Fate said.
They knew Karma was mad at Kent for shattering his soul and breaking the Circle of Karma to bring his legion back in time.
He also went ahead and lived all 13 lives to the fullest, even earning the title, Karma’s Favourite.
So he had tried many times to sabotage him in all 13 lives he had lived, but failed.
This time, it seemed he had a sure way to go about it.
"What did he want in order not to do that?"
"He wanted one of two things.
First, he wants Lord Chaos to go down on his knees and apologise to him." Fate paused and smirked, "I think we both know he wouldn’t do that."
The two ladies nodded, letting a smirk form at the corners of their lips.
"And what is the second?"
"That one, too, is a hard ask, but he wants Enchantress to sing a lullaby, record it, and send it to him on a Cosmic Unicorn."
"That bastard.
I will rip him to shreds," Lady Universe exclaimed, her expression turning dark.
"I am afraid you cannot do that, my lady.
Killing him will completely shatter the Circle of Karma.
When that happens, the universe will end overnight."
Lady Universe gritted her teeth, frustration bubbling in her chest.
"I will do it," the Enchantress said, causing Lady Universe to sigh.
"It’s okay, sister.
Our foolishness has brought this upon us.
So if it means making this sacrifice to fix things, then I will happily do it."
"Don’t worry, sister.
It is only a few cosmic essences.
I will recover it in a few thousand years."
"Then it is settled.
I will let Karma know so he can inform Lord Chaos."
"Thank you, Fate... really," Lady Universe said, bringing a smile to Fate’s face.
"Don’t worry about it.
It is what big brothers do for their silly siblings." With that, he vanished, leaving the two ladies with varied expressions.

chapters.title: Chapter 1274: Meeting Karma...Again
paragraphs: Kent and the twins continue to fly toward the Dark City in complete silence.
After learning about the current nature of the upside-down underworld forest, Kent started thinking about a lot of things.
’From what Ryan and Ryen said, the forest fell 500,000 years ago. If the Void Beasts were indeed responsible, then it isn’t long enough for the Void Temple to open just yet.
It usually takes a million years to cause some needed destruction’
Kent hadn’t yet recovered his memories of Chaos to the point where he should know about the Void Beasts and the language they speak.
However, the moment he heard the word Zhaeryn, it was like a dam had opened in his mind, pouring out what he needed to know.
In those memories, he knew that before the Void Beasts arrived during the primordial Era, they sent their temples. These temples come with five temple masters who are bona fide Void Beasts.
The average cultivator stood no chance against them. It took a lot of deaths to see the danger they were dealing with, finally.
But nature isn’t too cruel. Despite their horror, they would be chained to the temple for 1 million years. However, that is also what makes them dangerous.
The longer they remained within the temple, the more corrupted Void Energy they exuded.
This energy then affects those closer to them. In this case, the beasts within the upside-down underworld forest become the first contact with their corrupted void energy.
They will mutate into beings that even gods will fear.
But it goes beyond that. In fact, if the temple remained unconquered for long, the mutation would spread to the entire planet and soon extend beyond it, going as far as a whole star system.
It had been 500,000 years since the void temple descended, causing the upside-down underworld forest to fall. In Kent’s mind, that is too short for the entire forest to be consumed.
However, he must destroy the void temple at all costs, since the longer it remains unconquered, the greater the risk of the entire planet being affected.

Also, it had been a long time since he dealt with the void beast, so just like how the universe grew and adapted, he knew the Void Beasts also would have long evolved, adapted and undergone so many changes.
’Thank the gods they didn’t send more immortals into the forest when it fell.’ Kent visibly seems pleased with that. Only 20 immortals entered, and only one returned.
That is indeed good, considering that the stronger beings the void beasts consume, the stronger they become. It was why, during the Primordial Era, many powerhouses fell.
The moment a great warrior falls, the void beasts consume them to become even more powerful. So the fact that the forest was sealed instead of sending more immortals into it was a good move.
’I need to take care of it before it grows unchecked.’ Kent sighs and turns to look at the two siblings and asks,
"You said your parents and siblings are held captive, right?" They nodded.
"Good. Take me directly to the mansion of the Dark Lord. I need to blow off some steam." Before, he was concerned about his mission and the reason for coming to Bayla, but now he is just too angry.
The Dark Warden family may just become his punching bags for the time being.
The twins said nothing, but they nodded to his words and continued flying behind him. Kent didn’t mind them again and just continued to fly in the direction of the Dark City.
Suddenly, his vision darkened, and before he could do anything, he found himself standing on the shore of a beautiful blue sea.
He had been here before, so the moment he appeared, he turned to his left.
There, he saw the same bald man he talked to before.
"Lord Karma," Kent greeted, walking toward the bald man. He is indeed Karma, the one who determines who is worthy to receive good karma or who is unfortunate to have bad karma.
"We meet again," Karma turned and looked at Kent with a wicked smile. "How has life been treating you lately?"
"Better than I had hoped," Kent replied, sensing a tension in the air. From the way Karma smiled and the tone he used when asking the question, Kent sensed he wasn’t pleased with him for some reason.
"Good to hear that." Karma grinned and asked a question that made Kent furrow his brow.
"So you heard the Void Beasts are back, right?"
Kent hesitated but answered... "I did. Is that why Lord Karma had summoned me here?"

"Unfortunately, yes. I was forced into summoning you ahead of time." He stood up and moved toward Kent... "I had big plans for you in our five-year appointment, but I was forced to make some modifications."
"So this is about the Void Temple."

"But of course. You see, to save this galaxy, you must venture into the Void Temple and defeat the five temple masters. However, that will depend on your strength since they have, in a way, evolved over the years."
"How so?" Kent asked, sensing something bad...
"Where is the fun in that when you will be finding out soon enough?" Karma smirked and walked past Kent. He moved toward a table, picked a yellow-looking fruit, and bit into it.
"I only called you here to inform you that if you manage to defeat the Void Temple, all the karma you owe me will be cleared.
But know that there is no way I would ever compromise again if the same thing happened. This is me bending the rules for you, so be grateful."
Kent nodded, but he knew there was something important Karma wasn’t saying. Even so, he said nothing and only nodded to his words.
As he said, he would find out soon enough.
"That would be all. Good luck, and may you have all the success," Karma said with a chuckle, sending Kent away. Once he left, the smile on his face vanished.
He turned to his left and spoke coldly... "This is the least I can do for him. The rest depends on him and his will to prevent a calamity. What follows after that, please don’t include me.
I am Karma. My role is to judge good and evil and assign karma. If I start taking sides, the fabric of the universe will shatter faster than we all hoped."

Fate appeared with a gleeful smile... "No need to feel sour, Karma. At the end of the day, we both know we will need him, so why don’t you let old grievances pass?" Fate smokes his pipe and walks closer to Karma.
"So what if he cheated Karma... even if he did it 13 times. The point is, he is daring enough to attempt it, so maybe let him have this, and hopefully, one day he will return all he owes you."
Fate repeated nothing. He just walked away, leaving Karma with a lot to think about.
Nobody had ever cheated Karma. In fact, nobody dared attempt it; however, Kent did so 13 times. So his grievances wouldn’t just end like that.
But Fate is also right. Kent is essential to the universe, so he should cut him some slack.
"I mean, if you weren’t a sour loser, he wouldn’t have defeated you in your own game." Suddenly, Destiny’s cheeky voice entered Karma’s head, causing the bald fellow to grit his teeth.
However, in order not to entertain Destiny, he chose to ignore her.
"Tsk, what a loser."

chapters.title: Chapter 1275: Another Deadly Quest
paragraphs: When Kent opened his eyes on the outside, they were drawing much closer to the Dark City. He didn’t know how his body remained flying when his soul was sucked away to the realm of Karma.
However, he was glad he didn’t go splat.
If only he knew the tower was to be thanked for that.
But now that he is back, he can only contemplate the implications of the mission he was about to embark on.
Initially, it was a mission to hunt four beasts; now, it has become a mission to clear a void temple. The danger shifted by so much degree in an instant.
’When did we get here?’ Kent said inwardly, feeling his mind go numb.
Suddenly, a ding he hadn’t heard for a while sounded in his head, making him smile inwardly. He already expected a quest from the moment he realised the void beasts were back.
He pulled up the message to see the quest details.
When he saw where this quest came from, a smirk formed on his face.
[You have received a quest from the Lord of Karma. Do you dare accept?]
Although there is no accept button, given that this is a non-negotiable quest, the last sentence made him wonder just what he had done to warrant such reactions from Karma.
If only he knew the humiliation he had put him through, he wouldn’t dare sleep at night.
[Quest details...]
[Name: Void Temple Destruction]
[Danger: Hell++]
[Description:

↠ 500,000 years ago, the Ancient Void Beast Race made contact yet again with the Known Universe by sending a Void Temple to the upside-down underworld forest. This arrival plunged the forest into the void, sparking a mutation.
↠ Over 500,000 years, the infestation of the Void Temple has spread to all regions in the upside-down underworld forest, turning it into a Void Forest.
↠ All kinds of beasts had undergone mutation, most becoming Pseudo-Void Beasts.
↠ If the infestation is not destroyed, the mutation will spread beyond the borders of the Void Forest, consuming the planets and moons within its reach.
↠ Your mission, should you dare accept, is to venture into the Void Forest and, against all odds, slay the five Void Temple Masters.

↠ Know that the longer the Void Temple remains unconquered, the threat of the Void Beasts will not stop. Also, the Void Temple must be cleared once entered. All forms of connections to the outside world would be severed once you step into the Void Temple.
[Rewards]
↠ All debt owed to Karma would be cleared
↠ 50 Billion Tower Points
↠ Destiny Dream Key
↠ Five Memory Keys (Chaos, Jest, Faceless) & 2 Memory Keys for the Ruthless Bandit
↠ Absolute Life Coin
↠ Forsaken Records (1st Volume)
- Good Luck. I will be watching
’I need to inform the ladies I will be gone for a while,’ Kent said inwardly, rereading the details of the quest.
Initially, he planned to enter the upside-down underworld forest to farm tower points and strengthen himself while also completing the mission he had given himself.
Of course, the plan had always been to enter the tower now and then to spend some time with his ladies, and even join Uncle Drew and the demigods to go save Kaelith.
However, from how things had turned out, he would be gone for a while, even losing contact with them. He didn’t want to divide his attention, considering he would be going against Void Beasts.
Even if they aren’t yet Void Beasts, they are in the process of becoming one, so he knew he had to dedicate his time to killing them.
A little mistake will cost him his life.
So he must first inform his wives who are about to enter the dungeon.
Kent came to a stop, prompting the twins to stop as well.

"I need to handle something, so give me a few minutes." They nodded and then, under their watchful gaze, Kent vanished. They became startled, but, realising who they were dealing with, they both calmed down.
Kent appeared inside the Harem Tower, but his ladies weren’t there. He quickly made his way to the Legion Tower, where Vexthra was about to brief them on the mission.
Seeing him arrive, Vexthra smiled and reached out to him.

Her sisters quickly surrounded him. Kent kissed them all and promptly proceeded to tell them what he had come to do. Initially, he was going to go from his wives to the Legion and then to the demigods.
But since they were all gathered in the legion tower, he spoke to all of them at once.
"I will be leaving for a while. Of course, I already said that when I came here before. However, this time I’m here to tell you there is a chance you might lose all connection to me.
Do if that happens, know that I am fine.
Where I am going has some restrictions, so it is best I tell you now than to leave you all worried when our connection is severed."
"Master, where are you going?" Kaizo asked, taking a few steps forward.
"I can’t say. You know, Karma and all." Kent indeed cannot say it.
This is a matter involving the Void Beasts.
It is considered a taboo to speak about them, since it was believed that the more who knew about them, the greater the chance of drawing them closer to the known universe.
Hearing his reply, all who wanted to protest and offer their help kept quiet. Even his wives said nothing. Vexthra had already told them that when something involved Karma, they shouldn’t argue.
Uncle Drew and the demigods were the same. They refrained from offering their help.
Kent was grateful for that. However, since he cannot join them to rescue Kaelith, he made them aware...
"The moment you get your hands on Kaelith, leave. We will go for revenge later." They nodded. After that, Kent pulled Vexthra to the Harem Tower.
"What is wrong, Kent?" she asked. As a goddess, she is eligible to know some hidden secrets of the universe.
"A Void Temple has appeared on the planet I am on, so I need to clear it before it spreads and infects all life."
That was all Vexthra needed to know to turn pale. However, she remained strong for her man.
"Can you handle them?"
Kent smiled and nodded. "If I don’t, who would?"
"Then be careful. My sisters and I will be waiting for your return."
"I will, and don’t worry, I will return to you ladies before you know it." After kissing her, Kent vanished and appeared back in the air, causing the twins to narrow their eyes.
"Let’s go."

They resumed their flight toward the Dark City. Now that he was done informing the people who would worry about him, he left to handle the remaining task required of him before entering that godforsaken place.
Along the way, Kent made one last move to secure his survival.
’Tower, move the system shop to the Soul Universe.’
[Already done with that, master.]
’Good.’
After ten more minutes, the tall walls of a rather vast and majestic city appeared in the distance. When Kent saw this, memories of his childhood came to mind.
He was born in the Dark City, and for the peaceful few years of his life, he spent them there. Seeing it again, he couldn’t help but feel some emotions.

My sisters and I will be waiting for your return."
"I will, and don’t worry, I will return to you ladies before you know it." After kissing her, Kent vanished and appeared back in the air, causing the twins to narrow their eyes.
"Let’s go."
They resumed their flight toward the Dark City.
Now that he was done informing the people who would worry about him, he left to handle the remaining task required of him before entering that godforsaken place.
Along the way, Kent made one last move to secure his survival.
’Tower, move the system shop to the Soul Universe.’
[Already done with that, master.]
’Good.’
After ten more minutes, the tall walls of a rather vast and majestic city appeared in the distance.
When Kent saw this, memories of his childhood came to mind.
He was born in the Dark City, and for the peaceful few years of his life, he spent them there.
Seeing it again, he couldn’t help but feel some emotions.

chapters.title: Chapter 1276: Dark City
paragraphs: Planet Bayla has just three cities, so in a way, it can be considered a small planet.
However, its size is enormous. Its diameter is over 14 million kilometres. Most of it is forested, but there is also a large body of water.
The forest takes up a rather large field of land, and each houses some of the most dreadful beasts in the universe.
However, the cities aren’t smaller either.
Just the Dark City alone is about 2 million kilometres on all sides. It is built in a square shape, surrounded by thick, tall walls.
As far back as Kent could remember, the Dark City had always had those walls, reinforced with powerful formations and arrays.
Because the beasts are much larger in number than the humans, considering the forests are just too many, there are constant beast tides.

However, the walls had prevented many beast tides and even outside invasions. Because of this, many people prefer to be within the protective walls of the city, at the mercy of the warriors and the Dark Warden family.

Now, however, as Kent gazes at the city from 100 km away, he can tell that while the walls are firm and built to withstand even attacks from Heavenly Ascension Stage beasts, they have weakened considerably.

It indicated that the Dark Assassin Temple isn’t looking after it like it used to. A major beast invasion, if not well protected, will, for the first time, bring down the walls, exposing civilians to the horrors of the forests.
"This sight is amazing," Kent said, causing the twins to nod.
They always stop here whenever they go hunting for days. Taking in this sight, in a way, lessens the stress on their minds and bodies after fighting near-death battles.
"Let’s go. The longer we wait, the more danger your family is put in," Kent said before taking off again. This time, he allowed the twins to lead him.
They are natives, unlike him, who came from the outside. Seeing a friendly face would, in a way, lessen the scrutiny.

In no time, they approached the city gate, where dozens of people could be seen paying the gate fee and being let in. Kent and the twins landed at the back of the line and started walking forward as it slowly dwindled.
There are about eight guards, each a Shadow Emperor. If they were swordsmen, they would have already reached the peak of the Sword Emperor stage.
They are clad in dark armour with green fluffy ropes tied around their necks.
’They look decent for gate guards,’ Kent seemed pleased, knowing the Dark City he knew still had powerhouses guarding the gates.
In the past, the gates were manned by powerful assassins, some even hidden in the shadows. However, while he spotted no assassin in the shadows, the eight standing guard aren’t at all weak.
But he wasn’t bothered by that. He had already seen worse.
Soon, only three people were in front of them. However, one of the guards looked in their direction, and in an instant, a grin formed on his face. Kent also knew trouble had found them.
"Oh, if not the death-courting twins who dare lay their hands on the young master."
Ryan and Ryen frowned, seeing that things were about to turn sour. The moment the guard said that, all attention turned to them, including Kent.
Even the three people in front and those behind locked their gaze on the twins and the handsome young man standing with them.
"Van, we don’t have time for this," Ryan said, taking a step forward to shield his sister.
Van, the guard, chuckled... "Oh, but you do. Attacking the young heir of the Assassin Temple is a grave offence, so you must make time."

The other guards moved forward, forming a barrier at the narrow opening leading to the city. Since the gates are enormous, from a distance the small opening looks small, but when closer, it is about 20 feet wide, showing how huge the main entrance is.

"What is the meaning of this, Van? The Dark Lord pardoned us by giving us a task to complete. We have done that, so why are you blocking us from entering the city? Do you want to incur the wrath of the Dark Lord?"
"I am not blocking you, Ryan. I am merely making sure whoever enters the city doesn’t have any animosity toward anyone, especially toward the Dark Lord and his family."
Van turned and looked at the people guarding around and added:
"The last I checked, you and your sister tried to murder the young heir of the Assassin Temple. So in my eyes, you two are a danger to the city and everyone.
Who knows who you might try killing next time?"
The frown on Ryan and Ryen’s faces darkened. The longer they wait, as Kent said, the more danger they put their family in.
So being barred from entering the city so they could deliver on their mission is rather dangerous to themselves and their family.
Seeing the looks on their faces, Van and the other guards started to laugh, knowing Ryan and Ryen would never dare come against them.
Unfortunately for them, their travelling companion is not of the same mindset.

"They are just stalling for time. They have already sent a message to the one who hired them, and currently, he is leading 12 Shadow Emperors here," Kent suddenly spoke, causing the laughter to die down immediately.
He walked forward and stood before Ryan and Ryen... "Too bad you losers won’t be of any help by the time they arrive."
Kent raised his hand, and without showing any mercy, he activated his blood runes and gestured down.
"Eat Dust."
An invisible force descended on the 8 eight guards, forcing them to drop flat onto the ground, their faces planted in the ground as every bone in their bodies was being shattered.
With every movement of Kent’s finger, a bone breaks in their body.
The sound of bones shattering quickly spread through everyone, turning them pale. Even Ryan and Ryen instinctively took a few steps back.
The sight is just too shocking.

Of course, they saw how Kent defeated the snake they nearly died fighting; however, while that is even more shocking than this, seeing eight guards directly linked to the Assassin Temple suppressed and being tortured made them afraid.
Screams of pain coming from the eight guards quickly spread into the city, causing many to make their way toward the city entrance.𝕗𝐫𝐞𝕖𝕨𝐞𝗯𝚗𝕠𝘃𝐞𝚕.𝐜𝗼𝚖
Somewhere in the city, a carriage surrounded by 12 Shadow Emperors is swiftly making its way toward the city gate.

Inside the carriage, a spoiled brat with one blinded eye held a furious look, gritting his teeth, wishing he were already at the gate where he was informed Ryan and his sister were after leaving for days.
"If I don’t kill them this time around, then I am not a Warden." The fury in his eyes said it all; he is pissed and ready for blood.
Suddenly, the carriage came to a halt, prompting him to ask in a furious tone... "Why did we stop?"
"Young master Hazen, there seems to be a commotion at the entrance."
"Clear them. Those who resist, kill them."
Soon, the carriage started moving again. However, a few seconds later, just when they arrived at the gate, it stopped.
This time around, before Hazen could ask why, the carriage exploded, and an invisible force took hold of him, pulling him forward.
"W-What?" He panicked, but before he could do so much, his neck entered Kent’s waiting draconic grip.

chapters.title: Chapter 1277: Meeting a Midnight Shadow
paragraphs: Hazen came with expectations, aiming to wipe the shame and humiliation he was put through days ago when Ryan and Ryen trashed him.
It had only been a week, but the humiliation he was put through still stung like a bee.
He is the youngest son of the Dark Lord.
This means he had the fame and authority to do anything he wanted without anyone saying shit. He had run rampant, caused so much pain, and each time, he walked away without any opposition.
However, the moment he set his sights on Ryan and Ryen’s baby sister, who had recently turned 16, those privileges and power were taken away.

Ryan and Ryen did a number on him, causing their entire family to be taken with the intent of executing them to set an example. However, to their shock, the Shadow General who had arrested them proposed a way for them to regain their freedom.
And to their luck, the Dark Lord accepted that proposal, with ill intent, of course.
Naturally, that didn’t sit well with Hazen. So he set it up so that if Ryan and Ryen somehow return, they should be stopped, and he would be informed first.
Because of this, he left his grand mansion and came to lodge much closer to the gate with the twelve Shadow Emperors, waiting for them.
However, just when his revenge was within reach, someone else came and destroyed everything. Now, he couldn’t even speak, considering his neck was held firmly in place.
On the ground, the first eight guards had turned to jelly, all their bones broken. Kent didn’t show them any mercy despite them merely following orders.
They, after all, knew what had happened between the twins and Hazen, yet they chose to block them, knowing the longer they remain on the outside, the closer their family comes to death.
One can argue that they had no say in anything since the order was given to them by Hazen, son of the Dark Lord. So when ordered, they can only obey.
However, at the end of the day, it is all about perspective. Kent saw them as nuisances and ass-lickers and punished them for it.
Now, he had his hands on Hazen, and all everyone could do was stand there, jaws hanging loose as they gazed at this shocking sight.
Kent didn’t immediately address Hazen; he turned toward the city gate, his gaze piercing deep into its walls.
"I know you can see me and are already planning an attack, so why don’t you make yourself known to us all before I kill your son?"
For a moment, nothing happened, leaving everybody wondering just what Kent meant by what he said. Soon, however, they realised what he meant.
A shadow portal opened in the air, and five people walked out. The moment everyone’s eyes landed on the man in the middle, they bowed toward him.
"Greetings, Dark Lord."
The man who arrived was indeed the Dark Lord. Leader of the Dark Assassin Tower, formally the Dark Warden family. He is a tall, thick man with sharp eyebrows, a curious gaze, and a relaxed demeanour.
In all of Planet Bayla, he is the only Shadow Legend. Just like how a Sword Legend is the highest a mortal could reach in a High World, the Assassin profession also has a limit of a Shadow Legend.
The four beside him are all Shadow Divine. So naturally, he demanded respect.
The mere fact that he made an appearance here shows the nature of things currently happening at the gate.
"Young man, can I know why you have my son hanging by the neck?" the Dark Lord asked, looking coldly at Kent.
For as long as he could remember, nobody dared be arrogant in his presence. However, Kent not only didn’t give him any face but also dared to keep his son in a chokehold.
"I think you and I both know why. The question is, what are you going to do about it?"
Many gasped, but Kent had no plans on minding them. His focus was on what the Dark Lord would do.
If he acts aggressively, he will follow up with what he wanted to do. If he turns out to be reasonable, he will also act more calmly.
Either way, Kent plans to act, but he also doesn’t want to be aggressive without seeing the kind of leadership the Dark City has now.
As expected, the Dark Lord frowned, focusing his energy into his palm. Kent saw this and smiled.
"So you choose violence, huh, as expected from the father of a scum." Kent tightened his hold on Hazen’s neck and glared hatefully at the Dark Lord.
The colour on Hazen’s face started to drain.
However, before he could finish him off, another shadow portal opened, and a man with no aura at all walked out.
When Kent saw him, his brow raised.
Even the Dark Lord and his four guards turned respectful, and the attack they were building up dispersed. It seems even the Dark Lord had to be respectful toward this person.
The man ignored them and focused on Kent.
"Young man, why don’t we take a step back and handle things more calmly?" Even his tone is calm and wiser.
Kent nodded and let go of Hazen. However, an invisible force held him in place. With just a thought, he would shatter his body and turn him into meat paste.
Seeing this, the man smiled... "My name is Adin Mattew, current leader of the Midnight Shadows in the Lanna Star System... May I know who you are?"
Kent smiled inwardly.

It wasn’t that he recognised Adin from his memories that made him soften up when he spoke. It was just that while his aura is basically nonexistent, Kent saw it and immediately recognised him as from the Midnight Shadows.
Faceless, his past incarnation, had created the technique he used to hide his aura, so he saw through him at a glance.
But even without him recognising the technique, the Tower would have picked up on Adin’s identity.
Now hearing him reveal his own hidden identity for all without fear, Kent could only applaud his bravery.
He let a smile appear on his lips. He is proud to see his legacy still alive and, from the look of things, even stronger than before.

From the memories he had recovered so far, the few assassins he had accepted into the Midnight Shadows had all received the modified version of the Faceless Art. But that wasn’t the only technique he gave them.
He made sure they had several other techniques that an assassin of their calibre should have. He didn’t want them to fall short when on missions.
So while he didn’t know how many techniques he had given them since he had no idea how much of his memories he had left, he recognised the [Shadow Clothe] technique at a glance.
"I have heard many stories about the legendary Midnight Shadows. Who would have thought I would be meeting one of them in the flesh?" Kent said with a smile, then he introduced himself.
"I am no one special, considering I am a rogue cultivator, but you can call me Kent Madson... Pleasure meeting you, Adin Mattew."

chapters.title: Chapter 1278: Cutting It Off
paragraphs: The narrative quickly turned to the fact that Kent Madson was standing before them. Whispers echoed in the background, many wondering if Kent is indeed the Kent.
Nobody cares about the Dark Lord or the fact that the legendary Adin Mattew is standing before them. Kent is the moment, and so they let their hushed comments run wild.
"It can’t be him, right?"
"I know, right. The Kent Madson everyone is looking for can’t be this young and ordinary."
"I don’t know about ordinary, considering he didn’t seem fazed despite holding Lord Dark’s son hostage."
"True. However, if this is indeed him, then why is he targeting Young Master Hazen?"
"Idiot, don’t you have eyes? Those two standing behind him are the twins who trashed Young Master Hazen about a week ago."
"Oh, it makes sense now. But why is Kent Madson helping them? And why is he on the Planet for?"

That question pops into everyone’s mind as Kent looks at Adin with a calm gaze. The leader of the Midnight Shadows in this star system also held his gaze, but a surprised look could be seen in his eyes.
He most certainly didn’t expect to be meeting the most famous person in the universe on Planet Bayla.
"I suppose the rumours are true. You indeed have the aura of someone worthy to appear on two Dao Tablets," Adin smiled and turned to Hazen.
Seeing this, the Dark Lord and his guards became expectant. They knew no matter how strong Kent is, in the presence of the Leader of the Midnight Shadow, he is but a bug.
The Dark Lord is a Shadow Legend, same as Adin; however, even he wouldn’t dare challenge him. Adin is a legend on this side of the universe.
He had assassinated countless powerhouses, with rumours even saying he had assassinated immortals and even escaped from the elusive Night Hunters on numerous occasions.

Nobody knew how he had managed to bridge the gap between the Heavenly Ascension Stage and the Immortal Stage. However, he had killed immortals, and knowing the kind of person he is, they knew it wasn’t exaggerated.
This made the Dark Lord hopeful that his son would be saved.
However, nothing prepared him for what Adin said next... "What do you intend to do with him?"

This question shattered the Dark Lord’s expectations, making him turn pale from sheer shock. The one he was hoping would save his son had no such plan. Instead, he wanted to know what Kent planned on doing with him.
It is the same as saying, "How do you plan on killing him?"

Kent smiled and answered, "I planned on killing him initially; however, upon reflection, he would just reincarnate and become an even bigger prick. So, as a believer in what is good and fair, I will take what is so precious to him."
The moment he ended his words, a sword appeared in his right hand. He waved his left hand, and Hazen flew into the air, his hands and legs spread like he was nailed to an X-shaped cross.
"It is only right to take what seems to be controlling you. Only then would you stop hurting innocent young girls."
In a flash, he swung his sword, causing his heavenly sword aura to create thin lines of sword light in the air.
For a moment, time froze. Then a chilling cry came from Hazen just when all the clothing around his body was sliced into countless pieces and fell off his body.
Then, to everyone’s shock, his dick was also sliced clean off his body.
But it didn’t end there.
The cut-off part of his dick was further shredded by the heavenly sword aura, making sure it wasn’t stitched back on after that.
The sword vanished from Kent’s hand.
He also let go of Hazen, who fell from the air and slammed into the ground. The Dark Lord wanted to attack Kent in that instant; however, a sidelong glance from Adin made him abandon all thought,
But that didn’t stop him from gritting his teeth.
Kent turned toward Ryan... "Bring out the snake."
Ryan nodded and waved his hand, bringing out the colossal snake they had nearly fallen prey to. This sight sent a chill down everyone’s spine, but Kent didn’t care.
He used his energy to hold the snake in the air and then, with a casual wave, one large, rough, metallic scale came off its colossal body.
Kent waved his hand, and the scale flew toward the Dark Lord... "I believe this is the payment you wanted for the life of their family."
Kent waved his other hand, and the rest of the giant body vanished into Ryan’s space ring. Everyone held their jaws loose, with shocked expressions plastered across their faces.
"Isn’t that one of the overlords in the Green Rain Forest?" a spectator asked, snapping many back from their daze.
"Yes... Now that you say it, it is indeed one of the Overlords. The Metallic Scale Slash Snake, I believe."
"Wait, so they killed it?"
"Damn."
As the onlookers kept talking about the snake whose scale was now hovering before the Dark Lord, the man in question looked pissed. However, looking at the scale, he knew a promise is a promise.
He must keep his end of the bargain, else a lot of things would happen.
’Damn it. If Lord Adin wasn’t here, I would have long slit this bastard’s throat,’ the Dark Lord said inwardly, staring hatefully at Kent.

"I don’t have much time to waste on scum like you. There are better things to spend my time on. So I will give you five minutes to bring out the family, or else I will kill every last member of the Warden family."
The moment Kent said the words, he released a part of his aura and directed it at the Dark Lord. He was pushed back a few steps, deepening the shock on his face.
"Tempt my patience and see the outcome."
Adin said nothing, but a lot of thoughts ran through his mind as he looked at Kent. He had been keeping a close eye on the Wardens for many years now.

Of course, he is a Midnight Shadow, not a vigilante. So, despite seeing many misgivings among the ranks of the Wardens, he turned a blind eye to things since they continued to protect the city and the people.

However, he had no love for them, and as such, when Kent came after them, he seemed okay with it. Now, however, he could tell that if the five minutes were over and they didn’t bring the family, Kent would indeed kill them all.
Once that happens, the city will be left unprotected. The Wardens held a rather strong influence, after all.
So he cannot let that happen... Many would die the moment all members of the Warden Family fall.
If only he knew Kent planned on killing the Wardens and then taking every last soul into a much more secure place.
Adin didn’t know that, so he turned to the Dark Lord and commanded him.
Three minutes later, five people, all hurt in different parts of their bodies, were brought.
"Hmmmm." Seeing this, Kent hummed, but it sounded like a growl.

chapters.title: Chapter 1279: An Overlord [End Of Volume VII]
paragraphs: The five people brought out are Ryan and Ryen’s family: their mother, father, two older brothers, and their baby sister.
Everyone sucked in cold breath when they saw the five people the assassins walked to the entrance of the city. Their focus shifted away from Hazen, who is groaning and moaning on the floor.
The new arrivals took everyone’s attention.
Both brothers are bleeding from their shoulders and backs. Though covered by silky blue clothes, it is plain as day that they had endured excruciating torture from the hands of the Dark Assassins.

As for the parents, their father is blinded in one eye — probably a retaliation for the twins’ blinding Hazen’s eyes. As for their mother, her left arm is broken, and she is bleeding from her forehead and thighs.
But the worst of them all is the little sister. She had both her hands broken and her skin cut in many places. But that isn’t all; they had used a hot iron to brand her forehead with the word ’slut’.
When Ryan and Ryen saw this, their hearts sank, fury bubbling in their eyes.
"Navira." They both bolted to their little sister, who is even struggling to keep her eyes open. Everyone gathered at the city entrance sympathised with her.
Since she is merely a level 2 Root Awakening Stage cultivator, she could be considered a mortal. So the pain is getting to her more than the rest.
Also, she isn’t healing at all, unlike her parents and big brothers.
Adin Mattew, who was planning on standing in for the Wardens, felt his heartbeat slow down when he saw this.
Before he could do anything, a sword light flashed through the air, and Hazen was sliced into countless pieces. Kent made his move, and it was plain that a massacre was about to happen.
ROAR
Then a mighty dragon roared, filling the air with anger, and danger erupted from Kent. In the air, a terrifying sight caught everyone’s attention.
Two majestic dragons, one made of blue ice and the other made of green flames, rose into the air and unleashed their fury on the Dark Lord and his goons.
"After today, the Dark Warden Family will be no more," Kent muttered coldly. Then, with a wave of his hand, Ryan and his family vanished into the tower, appearing in the tower garden.
’Gaia, help them settle in and find healers to take care of the injured,’ Kent spoke to Gaia, who nodded and quickly brought the new arrivals to Gaiaville.
She summoned Elaine’s parents, who are also healers, and a few healers from Nature City. Since Kent brought these people, they must be important to him, so Gaia didn’t waste any time.
On the outside, before anyone could process where Ryan and his family went, the dragons surged toward the Dark Lord and his guards. All five of them felt dread immediately.
The pressure behind the two dragons coming was just too overwhelming.

They raised a shield formed from a dark mist, aiming to block them and buy time for the Dark Lord to make his move on Kent. However, a second later, they realised their shield was no match for the dragons.
"Retreat," the Dark Lord said, teleporting back into the city. His guards also did; however, one of them was too slow to move.
Before he could teleport, the shield cracked, and the flame dragon fell on him, reducing him to ash.

"Raise the Dark Formation," the Dark Lord commanded, and in an instant, 12 pillars lit up in the city, manifesting a giant formation. The city gate shut, and a dome of dark energy covered the entire city.
But that wasn’t all. Just when the formation fully manifested, a large skull rose and towered over the city, casting an ominous atmosphere over everyone.
Even from afar, it looked colossal, showing just the kind of danger it commanded.
When the people saw this, they all turned pale.
"It is the Underworld Giant Skull."
"Yes. It is the Legendary Skull that has protected this City for tens of thousands of years."
"This Kent Madson is done for. To think he caused the Dark Lord to reveal his trump card right off the bat."
"Oh, he’d be dead for sure."
Suddenly, the sky turned dark, and a mega-storm began to form.

Still standing on the outside, Kent gazes at the formation and the skull with a calm expression. The formation is Tier 17. From Faceless’ memories, Kent learned that an insidious Formation Emperor had created it.
Faceless had studied that formation back in the day when he was planning to assassinate the Demon King. It turned out that the city where the Demon King lived had the same formation.
The same person created both formations.
So, in order not to be trapped if the mission went sideways, Faceless infiltrated the Dark City Sanctum and studied this formation.
This was how he knew its grade and who created it. But that wasn’t all. After three days studying the countless arrays woven into this formation, Faceless found a way to deactivate it.
The formation powers the Underworld Giant Skull, so the moment it is deactivated, the storm forming in the clouds, which Kent knew would be a danger to his life, would also deactivate.

However, Kent didn’t immediately attack; he waited for the thousands of assassins to arrive first. Naturally, in no time, they all stood behind their leader, daggers and bows drawn, ready to bring down Kent.
"Since you all are here, we can start." The moment Kent said that, his hand formed into complex seals. In an instant, a rune formed in the air.
Adin narrowed his gaze at the rune, sensing some familiarity with it. However, no matter how hard he tried, he couldn’t place his finger on where he saw this rune.
"Era of the Wardens comes to an end today." He gestured forward, and the rune flew and merged with the formation. The moment it did, the entire city shuddered.
Then the formation flickered and cracked.
"Huh," the Dark Lord looked at the formation with a startled gaze.
However, before he could do anything, the two dragons appeared over the city and took a nosedive into it, shattering the giant formation.
Kent turned to Adin and spoke in a commanding tone... "I will leave the safety of the Dark City to the Midnight Shadows."
Without waiting for a reply, Kent vanished into the city. What followed was the greatest massacre Adin had ever witnessed in his life.
A single slash of Kent’s sword cleaves through hundreds of assassins as if they were mere butter. But that wasn’t all; his speed is blinding.
From the start of the battle to the end, Adin nor anyone who witnessed this massacre could dare say they saw Kent’s silhouette. He was just too fast.
In less than 20 minutes, every last Dark Assassin was reduced to a pile of shredded bodies. Kent spared no one. He made sure every last one of them died screaming, begging, or completely unaware.
If the torture were only inflicted on Ryan’s parents and big brothers, he would have shown mercy. However, seeing what they did to their baby sister, Kent’s fury exploded.
They were just too cruel, and so by the time everyone realised, the deed had already been done.
Kent flew into the air and looked down at the city. Then, in a tone amplified by his essence, he spoke, his voice travelling as far as the wind could take it...
"From today onwards, this city is under the care of the Midnight Shadows. All who have a problem with that can raise their hands and let me send them to the afterlife."
The entire Dark City turned quiet, every living soul gazing at the silhouette in the air.
Nobody dared make a sound when the Overlord spoke.
[A/N: That would be a wrap on Volume VII. It took 140+ Chapters, but we managed to put Kent out there. Now, join me and let’s explore Kent’s history with the Void Beasts.
Volume VIII: Into The Void Temple & Back]
