chapters.title: Chapter 1280: The Reset
paragraphs: [Planet Warden - Immortal Realm]
During the Dark Era, long before the Faceless Assassin was even born, the Dark Warden Family ruled the Dark City. Many feared them, and many aspired to join them.
It was said that long before the Dark City was built, the landmass where the majestic city now stood was a nest to a very insidious and poisonous Spider Queen.

She held absolute control of that zone, killing thousands of humans and Beasts alike. Many tried to kill her and her spider minions, but they all fell. She grew to the point nobody dared venture there.
But one day, a Shadow Divine and 15 others ventured into such a treacherous place and killed the Spider Queen, clearing out the nest and laying the foundation of Dark City.
They wanted the city to represent the undying spirit of the heroes who fell in that nest. Their darkest hour brought such a city.

In no time, the City started to grow until it became one of the three Cities on Planet Bayla. Many legendary assassins rose from their ranks and ascended to become even mightier in the immortal realm.
The first Dark Warden, the one who led the charge against the spider queen, later ascended to godhood after spending just 800,000 years being an immortal.
He went on to fight in many era-ending wars and later ascended to Supremehood. He is one of the few deadly Supreme Assassins (Shadow Supremes) in the universe.
After him, many Wardens rose, some fell, but in the end, the legacy they built remained, and because of this, in the Immortal Realm, the Dark Warden Family is respected.
They even have a planet to their name.
So when news reached the Immortal Realm of the sudden annihilation of the Dark Warden Family in the High World, one could only imagine the reactions and chaos it had sparked.
Inside a narrow, dimly lit hall, ten Immortal Lords sat, staring at an 11th Immortal Lord, whose eyes were shut, chin resting on his fist.
The ten Immortal Lords here are all previous leaders of the Dark Warden Family, who, after their 1 million years of service, ascended to continue walking the path of immortality.
Suddenly, the 11th Immortal Lord opened his eyes and looked at his elders with a calm yet authoritarian gaze. One of them quickly addressed him on the purpose of their gathering.
"Lord Warden, from what we have gathered, the one responsible for the massacre is Kent Madson. The same Kent Madson who is being hunted down by the entire universe."
The elders nodded, some waiting to see their patriarch’s reaction.
"Do we know why he did that?" Lord Warden asked, sounding calm despite learning their legacy in the High World had been wiped out.
Although Kent didn’t slaughter every last Warden, the moment their central leadership was wiped out, their true root, born many eras ago, was over.
Kent is aware that there are some children and mothers who still have the Warden bloodline. However, despite his plan to wipe out the Wardens, he spared them.

He only killed those who pointed their weapons at him, just like he had done many times in the past. If later they grew up, learned the errors of their ways, and chose to be better, he wouldn’t come after them.
However, that doesn’t mean the massacre wasn’t a massive loss to them.
The elder who reported to Lord Warden took a deep sigh, a look of disgust painting his face as he answered,

"Before answering that question, Lord Warden should know the leader of the just-slaughtered family changed the name of the family from Dark Warden to Assassin Temple and started calling himself the Dark Lord.

We learned of this about 20,000 years ago, but to avoid worrying you, we said nothing. However, the youngest heir of the Dark Lord is a scum who preys on young and gullible girls, taking advantage of the power he has to do as he pleases.

Finally, after years of tormenting the weak, he had finally touched someone he shouldn’t have. The person seemed to have some connection with Kent Madson, so he came for answers, and the rest happened.
They tortured a family of five, breaking the arm of the youngest, who was barely strong enough to be called a cultivator.
Now, the Midnight Shadows had taken over management of the City and changed its name to Midnight City."
Lord Warden sighs.
He is angry, but he didn’t seem to show his emotions. The legacy his forefathers had built came crashing down just like that.

The Dark City was their root, yet overnight, everything changed. He would have to report to his higher-ups in the God Realm, who would also reach out to the true leader of the Dark Warden Family, the Dark Warden himself.
But even so, he wasn’t about to make a rash decision just yet.
"What do you think, Jose?" he asked, directing his question to the elder who spoke.

"In my opinion, this Kent Madson had done us an excellent service. The moment the family name changed, our beliefs shifted as well. So they aren’t one of us anymore, and I believe the rest of us share in the same belief."
The elders gathered nodded. They also hated what had become of their name in the High World.
"Then, if that is what you all think, I believe this meeting is over. There is nothing to talk about." The elders nodded and dispersed.
After they left, Lord Warden took a deep breath and called out... "Come out, Yin and Yang."
From the shadows, two assassins, one clad in white leather armour and the other in black, rose. The one in the dark is a female, making her Yin, while the white one is male, Yang.
"Master," they went on their knees and bowed. Both of them are True Immortals and Shadow Immortals.
"How was your training?"
"It was great and rewarding. We managed to bridge the first gap to the Shadow Sovereign stage," Yin answered.
"That is good to hear." Lord Warden said, then he turned and looked out the window. He then took another sigh before he spoke... "I have a mission for you two."

In less than a day, many changes had occurred in Dark City, leaving everyone surprisingly at peace and joyful. The changes were all within reasonable limits, making everyone who had suffered under the rule of Dark Assassin Temple joyous.
Kent had in no way interfered with the changes. He only handed everything over to Adin after he finished his slaughter and vanished into the Tower.
Adin didn’t know why Kent gave him the order to take over the affairs of the City, but he didn’t waste time and did as he was told.
Surprisingly, even the other two cities, after hearing what had happened to the Dark City, began making changes in fear that Kent Madson would come after them.
It was just too shocking to learn what happened to the Warden Family. In a way, just one massacre was all it took to reset Planet Bayla.
Now, as new management is being implemented, Adin and the Midnight Shadows started making provisions to ensure nothing like this ever happens again.
Sure, they had lost considerable manpower in the massacre, but that was a necessary massacre to put things back on track.
Kent had done them a service, but had also made every last Midnight Shadow active and ready to go to war when a beast tide were to happen.

But one day, a Shadow Divine and 15 others ventured into such a treacherous place and killed the Spider Queen, clearing out the nest and laying the foundation of Dark City.
They wanted the city to represent the undying spirit of the heroes who fell in that nest.
Their darkest hour brought such a city.
In no time, the City started to grow until it became one of the three Cities on Planet Bayla.
Many legendary assassins rose from their ranks and ascended to become even mightier in the immortal realm.
The first Dark Warden, the one who led the charge against the spider queen, later ascended to godhood after spending just 800,000 years being an immortal.
He went on to fight in many era-ending wars and later ascended to Supremehood.
He is one of the few deadly Supreme Assassins (Shadow Supremes) in the universe.
After him, many Wardens rose, some fell, but in the end, the legacy they built remained, and because of this, in the Immortal Realm, the Dark Warden Family is respected.
They even have a planet to their name.
So when news reached the Immortal Realm of the sudden annihilation of the Dark Warden Family in the High World, one could only imagine the reactions and chaos it had sparked.
Inside a narrow, dimly lit hall, ten Immortal Lords sat, staring at an 11th Immortal Lord, whose eyes were shut, chin resting on his fist.
The ten Immortal Lords here are all previous leaders of the Dark Warden Family, who, after their 1 million years of service, ascended to continue walking the path of immortality.
Suddenly, the 11th Immortal Lord opened his eyes and looked at his elders with a calm yet authoritarian gaze.
One of them quickly addressed him on the purpose of their gathering.
"Lord Warden, from what we have gathered, the one responsible for the massacre is Kent Madson.
The same Kent Madson who is being hunted down by the entire universe."
The elders nodded, some waiting to see their patriarch’s reaction.
"Do we know why he did that?" Lord Warden asked, sounding calm despite learning their legacy in the High World had been wiped out.
Although Kent didn’t slaughter every last Warden, the moment their central leadership was wiped out, their true root, born many eras ago, was over.
Kent is aware that there are some children and mothers who still have the Warden bloodline.
However, despite his plan to wipe out the Wardens, he spared them.
He only killed those who pointed their weapons at him, just like he had done many times in the past.
If later they grew up, learned the errors of their ways, and chose to be better, he wouldn’t come after them.
However, that doesn’t mean the massacre wasn’t a massive loss to them.
The elder who reported to Lord Warden took a deep sigh, a look of disgust painting his face as he answered,

"Before answering that question, Lord Warden should know the leader of the just-slaughtered family changed the name of the family from Dark Warden to Assassin Temple and started calling himself the Dark Lord.
We learned of this about 20,000 years ago, but to avoid worrying you, we said nothing.
However, the youngest heir of the Dark Lord is a scum who preys on young and gullible girls, taking advantage of the power he has to do as he pleases.
Finally, after years of tormenting the weak, he had finally touched someone he shouldn’t have.
The person seemed to have some connection with Kent Madson, so he came for answers, and the rest happened.
They tortured a family of five, breaking the arm of the youngest, who was barely strong enough to be called a cultivator.
Now, the Midnight Shadows had taken over management of the City and changed its name to Midnight City."
Lord Warden sighs.
He is angry, but he didn’t seem to show his emotions.
The legacy his forefathers had built came crashing down just like that.
The Dark City was their root, yet overnight, everything changed.
He would have to report to his higher-ups in the God Realm, who would also reach out to the true leader of the Dark Warden Family, the Dark Warden himself.
But even so, he wasn’t about to make a rash decision just yet.
"What do you think, Jose?" he asked, directing his question to the elder who spoke.
"In my opinion, this Kent Madson had done us an excellent service.
The moment the family name changed, our beliefs shifted as well.
So they aren’t one of us anymore, and I believe the rest of us share in the same belief."
The elders gathered nodded.
They also hated what had become of their name in the High World.
"Then, if that is what you all think, I believe this meeting is over.
There is nothing to talk about." The elders nodded and dispersed.
After they left, Lord Warden took a deep breath and called out...
"Come out, Yin and Yang."
From the shadows, two assassins, one clad in white leather armour and the other in black, rose.
The one in the dark is a female, making her Yin, while the white one is male, Yang.
"Master," they went on their knees and bowed.
Both of them are True Immortals and Shadow Immortals.
"How was your training?"
"It was great and rewarding.
We managed to bridge the first gap to the Shadow Sovereign stage," Yin answered.
"That is good to hear." Lord Warden said, then he turned and looked out the window.
He then took another sigh before he spoke...
"I have a mission for you two."
In less than a day, many changes had occurred in Dark City, leaving everyone surprisingly at peace and joyful.
The changes were all within reasonable limits, making everyone who had suffered under the rule of Dark Assassin Temple joyous.
Kent had in no way interfered with the changes.
He only handed everything over to Adin after he finished his slaughter and vanished into the Tower.
Adin didn’t know why Kent gave him the order to take over the affairs of the City, but he didn’t waste time and did as he was told.
Surprisingly, even the other two cities, after hearing what had happened to the Dark City, began making changes in fear that Kent Madson would come after them.
It was just too shocking to learn what happened to the Warden Family.
In a way, just one massacre was all it took to reset Planet Bayla.
Now, as new management is being implemented, Adin and the Midnight Shadows started making provisions to ensure nothing like this ever happens again.
Sure, they had lost considerable manpower in the massacre, but that was a necessary massacre to put things back on track.
Kent had done them a service, but had also made every last Midnight Shadow active and ready to go to war when a beast tide were to happen.

chapters.title: Chapter 1281: Making Sure They are Fine
paragraphs: [Gaiaville - Cultivation Garden]
While only a day had passed on the outside, 24 days went by inside the tower.
After the massacre, Kent quickly entered the tower to check up on Ryan’s family. He left them in Gaia’s capable hands so that he could deal with the Dark Assassin Temple.
The moment he is done, he leaves.
When he arrived, Gaia had already pulled all the top healers in the tower cities and had already attended to the parents and brothers.
The only one left was Navira.
Since she was basically mortal, the healers were taking their time to heal her. If they put too much effort into it, they might hurt her. So they took their dear time.
Thankfully, they managed to save her. However, she passed out afterwards and woke up ten days later.

During those ten days, Kent helped the family settle in. He gave them resources to raise their potential. The parents are Level 5 Spirit Lords, while the big brothers, just like Ryan and Ryen, are Peak Heavenly Ascension stage cultivators.
However, unlike the twins, Beta, the oldest of them all, is a swordsman, and Elio is a spearman.
After a few more chats, Kent found out they had only survived because of the Shadow General, who made the call for Ryan and Ryen to hunt the snake and bring back the scale.

It turned out that Elio once saved his life, so he did his best to save him. Kent felt bad after learning that, so he made the tower search through his kills, and to his relief, that general wasn’t part of it.
However, he also wasn’t in the Dark City, now Midnight City.
After further investigation from the Tower, it was found out that he ran away, probably to save his skin since the now-dead Dark Lord found out about his connection to Elio.
His heat signature shows he ran to the Gatty Pill City.
Kent plans to use the Midnight Shadows to look for him and bring him to leave the tower. He had earned that much for buying time for Kent to come, even if it wasn’t what he intended.
Fate played his bony hands after all.
After Navira woke up, Kent used an ancient method to speed up her healing and help her reach the Peak of the Root Awakening stage. This way, she could heal all internal wounds on her own.
Afterwards, he let her safely break through to the Root Blossom stage. That took her a couple of days.
Kent didn’t mind and stayed until she was done, since only a few hours had passed on the outside.
He had no idea why, but a part of him wanted to make sure this family was protected and safe. However, because he had a mission to return to, he spent only 24 days with them.
"Big brother Kent, are you leaving?" Of course, since Kent is that amazing, he may have just found yet another little sister in Navira. Too bad she isn’t a shorty like Gaia and the rest.
Looking at her innocent expression, the need to pop down to the underworld and torture the bastards who dared hurt her crossed his mind. However, he just smiled and brushed her hair.
"Yes. I have some things to take care of, so I will be gone for a while. However, you and the little ladies here can have some fun while I am away."
Gaia, of course, brought the whole gang: Gaia herself, Akira, Dori, Yuna, Purity, and Aala. Yes, the little foxy woke up and joined the band of troublemakers.
The only ones missing are Li Hua, who is still in the dungeon with Nyxira, and Nana, who isn’t done merging back with all ten pieces of her body she scattered in the ten Pill Worlds.
"Sure," Navira nodded, already happy to spend some time exploring the amazing cities she woke up in. After Kent was done with her, he turned to Ryan and the rest of his family.

"This is now your home. However, if you want to go back to the Dark City, I can take you. The Dark Lord and his family are gone, so there is no threat to your life ever again." Kent placed his left hand on Ryan’s shoulder and added, "Just know that this place is open to you all, any day."
They nodded... every last one of them.
"Thank you, Kent," Ryan said, and Kent merely smiled.
"Don’t worry about it. Just let Gaia know if you need anything later. She will help you get it." They are grateful to him, so they didn’t request much.
However, Elio had a request. "My girlfriend is still in the Dark City. Can I go check up on her once in a while to make sure she is okay?"
Kent nodded and said, "You can bring her here if you want, her family included. Gaia will handle everything."
"Thank you."
After all the necessary stuff was handled, Kent left for the Guardian Tower to see what he could do to protect Midnight City now that the Midnight Shadows were in charge.
He knew an assassin organisation like the Midnight Shadows wasn’t cut out to be babysitters of an entire city. They had missions to embark on, and as such, he wouldn’t want to keep them grounded.
So, since he had the Guardian Tower and a few rewards to claim there, he went to check that out. It had been a while since he’d purchased anything. Those rewards are yet to be claimed.
He didn’t bother going to the Harem Tower or Legion Tower since his wives and Legion had already entered the Planet Killer Dungeon, this time to come out only when Kent is back from his mission.
Vexthra wanted them to clear at least the first 30 floors since they had literal demigods with them. She herself could fight when they reached a floor featuring gods.
Kent told them the dungeon is akin to a unique world,where no limits are placed on the inhabitants.
However, there are some dungeon rules. Every floor has a base and a maximum cultivation limit. If the maximum is the Demigod Stage, then Vexthra would be punished for using her god powers there.
So aside from controlling the battle formations, she can’t do anything else. However, when the max cultivation limit is at the God Stage, then she can participate.
Although she is a Pseudo-Supreme, since there is no recognised cultivation stage like that, she can fight Gods inside the dungeon without fear.
So they entered the tower and arrived on the 4th floor where the last time, they handled the Church of Destruction, leaving the God of Demons pissed.
The other Demon gods had been laughing at him ever since. This made him so mad that he put a bounty on Neomi since she was the one who played a key role in that massacre.
His downfall stemmed from her temporary access to her divinity. So he wants her dead, and one day, if he gets his hands on her, he will make sure his fury is satiated.

But then again, when he did, he would find out that aside from the Goddess of Hatred and Resentment backing Neomi, the legendary Primordial Chaos Dragon would also be there, along with several other legendary figures who once shook era-ending battlefields.

chapters.title: Chapter 1282: Night Crawlers
paragraphs: The Guardian Tower basically has only one thing: the Guardian Shop.
The idea is to ensure the worlds and people under Kent’s protection have all the tools they need to keep themselves safe in case they are not inside the tower, where no harm would come to them.
Kent can’t bring every planet he has under his protection into the tower. Some also want to remain on the outside since they like it there.
So if that was the case, there should be a way to keep them safe even when he is away. That is where the Guardian Tower comes in.
He left some guardians in Fedora, Sonox and Enzi’s home planet.
Since her parents chose to remain on their cute little planet, Kent made sure that even if ten planets attacked at the same time, not a single hair would fall from their heads.
He takes protecting his wives’ families very seriously.

Now, it was time to protect the city he grew up in during his life as Jaqen, the Faceless Assassin. Being there brought back some memories, so the least he could do was protect it for the foreseeable future.
The moment Kent arrived there, he gave an order to the Tower.
"Tower, give me all the purchase passes I have yet to claim after adding dozens of planets to the Guardian Tower."
Whenever he adds a planet to his Guardian Tower, he gets a single purchase pass. That purchase pass is like a 100% off coupon he can use to buy anything in the Guardian Shop.
Back when he was fortifying Enzi’s home planet, he had tower points, so he didn’t redeem those passes...
And what an adventure Kent has had in the past couple of months.
The implementations he put in place before ascending to the high world and the moves he made when he went back in time to the Pill Worlds had left him connected to close to a hundred planets.
That is a whole lot of purchase passes for him to redeem, especially now that he is rotting in debt.
So, having no shame, he plans to use some, if not all, to see what he can buy this time around. The first time he used the Guardian Shop, he purchased a knight and two shadow spiders.

The knight later became Veydris, one of the 14 Lost Knights. Afterwards, he bought 13 more, believing they would one day become the rest of the Lost Knights after he upgrades them. He had yet to handle that.
Later, he bought metal swordsmen and archers, which he used to fortify Fedora and Enzi’s homeworld. They were more than enough to deter any army.
Today, he is about to find out what has been unlocked and how effective they can be.
[The master has 98 purchase passes to claim. Does the master want to claim them now?]
"In due time. For now, pull up all the new toys available in the Guardian Shop."

A screen appeared before Kent, displaying stylish cards for all the items in the Guardian Shop. There are weapons, arrays, formations, guardians, and a whole lot that a guardian would need to protect his wards.
However, Kent came for only the guardians. They are the humanoid and bestial warriors that can engage in all forms of combat without having to hold their hands.
The best part is that the Tower will have control of them, so even if Kent is in the God Realm, if something were to happen in the High World, he would know.
"Filter out the other stuff and display only the guardians."
Tower listened to his command and did as she was told. This time, only six cards were displayed. The first one is, of course, the Metal Knight. It was the first item Kent ever purchased.
A Tier 13 (Spirit Ascension) metal knight doll is 100,000. Tier 14 (Spirit King) is 200,000, and it increases by a hundred thousand tower points.
However, the best part is that even if the guardian is Peak Heavenly Ascension, Kent could still use the pass.
The second is the Shadow Spiders.
These shadow spiders are used for both spying and assassination. When planted in the target’s shadow, it would be able to pick up on their conversations and even kill on command.
Kent gave most of these to the Foxkins in Fedora to use when necessary. He knew they would come in handy in covert operations.
The third and fourth are the Metal Swordsmen and Metal Archers. This was the main legion Kent left with the Fedorians and Enzi’s homeworld.
They are the same price as the knights.
However, aside from these four, there are now two more additions. One is a bestial guardian shaped like a werewolf, but far more terrifying.
Kent quickly checked the details.

[Metallic Werewolf]: Metallic Werewolf Doll designed to fight like a True Werewolf with no weakness or ever getting tired. During full moons, it can absorb lunar essence, allowing it to evolve following the same path as wolves and werewolves.
Kent smiled, feeling like he had just found the guardian for the planets under his protection.
Looking at their combat power from the short demonstration video the tower made for him, he knew that when one of these monstrosities is dropped into battle, blood would flow like a fountain.
Of course, a Tier 13 Metallic Werewolf Guardian is worth 200,000 tower points. However, since he wouldn’t be using tower points this time around, he had nothing to worry about.
But Kent didn’t immediately buy it. He first checked the last guardian. Ideally, after reading what that one is made of, he was inclined to go with that.
[Night Crawlers]: Designed like an assassin, let your Night Crawlers hide in the shadows and wait for the prey to show themselves. The longer they stay in the shadows, the stronger they become.
The nature of these guardians aligns perfectly with the theme of the city he wanted to protect. They are assassins, and Midnight City is a city of assassins, so they would blend in perfectly.

The best part is that this doll is designed to look human. Although its entire body is covered in black armour, its height and form are those of a human assassin, so they can even move around, and nobody would suspect a thing.
"I have made a decision, Tower, buy 40 Night Crawlers and 28 Werewolves. They will be more than enough to keep the city safe from any form of threat."
Kent didn’t want to spend all his purchase passes on this purchase. He had two deadly missions ahead of him, so he tried to keep his options open for anything.
The tower followed through, and in no time, 40 Night Crawlers and 28 Werewolves appeared, bringing a smile to Kent’s face.

"This will do for now. If I survive the Void Forest and return with more tower points, I will add some more to the fold. But for now, you 68 will stand guard over the city and make sure all threats are dealt with as quickly as possible."
They didn’t speak, but Kent knew his words entered their metallic minds. He later spent some time looking through the other items, but he found nothing he needed.
The city already has a formation, so he didn’t need to buy one. He will help Adin take control of the previous one.
After handling everything else, he left and went back to Planet Bayla. It was time to meet Adin and put his plans in motion.

"I have made a decision, Tower, buy 40 Night Crawlers and 28 Werewolves.
They will be more than enough to keep the city safe from any form of threat."
Kent didn’t want to spend all his purchase passes on this purchase.
He had two deadly missions ahead of him, so he tried to keep his options open for anything.
The tower followed through, and in no time, 40 Night Crawlers and 28 Werewolves appeared, bringing a smile to Kent’s face.
"This will do for now.
If I survive the Void Forest and return with more tower points, I will add some more to the fold.
But for now, you 68 will stand guard over the city and make sure all threats are dealt with as quickly as possible."
They didn’t speak, but Kent knew his words entered their metallic minds.
He later spent some time looking through the other items, but he found nothing he needed.
The city already has a formation, so he didn’t need to buy one.
He will help Adin take control of the previous one.
After handling everything else, he left and went back to Planet Bayla.
It was time to meet Adin and put his plans in motion.

chapters.title: Chapter 1283: Meeting With Adin
paragraphs: Kent appeared yet again at the entrance of the city, since that was where he entered the tower from. However, unlike before, when he was blocked from entry, the moment the guards at the gate saw him, they quickly straightened up.
They saw what Kent did to the Dark Assassin temple, so they know best not to mess with him.

’Looks like Adin didn’t want to waste personnel, so he started employing the cultivators in the city and putting them to work,’ Kent noticed that the guards at the entrance aren’t Midnight Shadow assassins.
Some of them even held swords and spears.
Adin may have liked the idea of using the Midnight Shadow assassins to protect the city, but he wasn’t about to turn them into mere guards.
So he turned to the best option: using the wealth the Dark Lord had amassed to hire people instead.
Hopefully, after what Kent had in store for him, he wouldn’t have to stretch his assassins too thin in the name of creating a safe city for everyone.
"At ease, everyone," Kent said, walking toward them. Hearing his words, they all nodded and sighed. They made way for Kent to pass, which he did, considering he was only there to talk to Adin.
Upon entering the city, Kent saw that the bodies and destruction caused had been handled. Not even a drop of blood was seen on sight.
Adin had ensured the city was restored to its former glory, and a squeaky clean job was done to take away even the scent of the blood from the massacre Kent had committed.
This sight made him happy.
He quickly spotted Adin inside a private room in a restaurant, having tea. Using the Soul Map, Kent wasted no time and quickly teleported inside.
His sudden appearance startled Adin, but sensing it was Kent, he didn’t react. However, Kent, using the Soul Map, saw that if he were to attack Adin, he would have countered easily.
His reaction speed is breakneck, and coupled with his years of experience as an assassin, Kent knew not to underestimate him when it came to skills.
"Looks like you pass as a City Lord, Adin," Kent said, taking a seat as if he was invited.
Adin didn’t even want to think about how Kent had found him inside the inn. He had come in secret, and he had made sure he wasn’t followed.
However, seeing him seated as if he had invited him, Adin could only sigh and ask what he wanted.
"I only found out yesterday that the Upside Down Underworld Forest is no more and that it fell and was sealed by an Immortal Lord who is part of the Midnight Shadows. How true is that?"
The conversation had to start from somewhere, so Kent started with the obvious. His mission is to enter the Void Forest, which the Midnight Shadows sealed.
So naturally, he needs access, and the one who could grant that is Adin.
As expected, Adin sensed a hidden meaning to what Kent said, and so his answer aligned with what Kent would be asking next.
"The Upside Down Underworld Forest is indeed sealed after the fall. So if you are going to ask me to open it for you, know that I cannot since I wasn’t the one who sealed it.
But even if I could, I wouldn’t, since even 2 True Immortals, 4 Core Immortals and 13 Spirit Immortals died when they ventured in. You may be strong, but not stronger than a True Immortal."
Kent smiled and poured himself tea, taking a sip before responding to Adin... "No need to be harsh about it, Adin. I merely asked about the Upside Down Underworld Forest."
"So you aren’t planning on asking me to help you gain access?" Adin asked, and Kent responded with a straight expression.
"As a matter of fact, I was going to ask you to grant me access. However, now that I know your stance on things, asking will be wasting my time, so I suppose I would check it out myself."
Adin frowned, "What if I said no?"

Kent’s smile, "I am not going to fight you, Adin. I am not that unreasonable. However, since my mission here is to solve the problem brewing inside the Upside Down Underworld Forest, or else the entire world risks getting devoured, I would use any means necessary to enter."
"So you plan on fighting me since that is the only way you will be gaining access." Adin furrowed his brow, his gaze scrutinising every gesture Kent made.

"Oh, Adin, if I want to, none of you would even be able to take a step before stopping me. I may not look like it, but when I mean business, not even a demon king could make a fuss before me." Kent took a sip and waved his hand, sealing the room.

"If you were from a different organisation, I would have locked you up in my private prison and gone on with my business. However, since you are from the Midnight Shadows, I would let you in on a little secret that I believe will compel you to let me have access to the Upside Down Underworld Forest."
"Oh, I would very much like to hear what you have to say."

Adin didn’t want to show it, but he is not calm despite appearing calm. Kent is dangerous, and if what he had done to the Dark Assassin Temple wasn’t proof, then the fact that he wasn’t even bothered despite sitting in front of Shadow Legend said it all.

If they are going to compete skills-wise, like how sword duels happen, where the battle is only fought using sword energy, then perhaps Kent would be cornered and even defeated by Adin. He is a shadow legend, someone akin to a Sword Legend.
However, once that is taken out of the equation, Kent would trash him.
So he knew all this, yet he couldn’t bring himself to hear Kent’s words as mere rhetoric made by a child.
Kent didn’t seem to mind the mocking in Adin’s tone. He came prepared, and as such, he would soon shut him up.
Entering the Upside Down Underworld Forest would require him to have the approval and understanding of the Midnight Shadows.
He wouldn’t want to enter the Void Forest only for them to follow him in. That would be dangerous to them, something Kent didn’t want to happen.
So he wants to come to an understanding with them. This way, even if he enters, and the one who created the seal were to come, Adin would be able to prevent him from doing anything drastic.
This means he must find a way to tell Adin he is the Faceless Assassin without admitting it himself.

Adin would have to realise that and accept that Kent is the Faceless Assassin, without him opening his mouth and saying, "I am the Faceless Assassin." Only then can he talk freely about the Faceless Assassin without Karma affecting them both.
"You see, I came to this planet to meet the leader of the Midnight Shadows, since in a way I am your big boss that you are not even aware of just yet."
Kent held a smile on his face while Adin narrowed his gaze at him as if he were realising something.
A few seconds later, something unexpected happened.
"Hahahahaha," Adin burst out into a resounding laughter, causing Kent to sigh.

chapters.title: Chapter 1284: Revealing His Identity
paragraphs: Kent obviously didn’t expect Adin to laugh at what he said. In his view of Adin, he saw him as a no-nonsense kind of guy, so the last thing he expected from him was to laugh that loud and freely at his words.
This action changed the way he sees Adin.
But since he would love to revel in flipping Adin’s mockery, Kent knew he had to change his mind somehow. It would be a long stretch, but he had to do it.
Karma, from what he had seen recently, seemed to hate him, so he didn’t want to slip up. Thankfully, he had lived long enough to know how to go around Karma without offending him.
’If he takes offence, then he can just go fuck himself.’ Kent said inwardly, unaware that Karma heard everything.

"During the Dark Era, long before the creatures of the dark came, there was an assassin known by many as the Faceless Assassin. They gave him this name because, from what they know, he had many faces, and every face he took became his to command down to the last detail."
Adin fell quiet, his focus returning to Kent.
"They said two friends who would never dare backstab each other could become the weapon that would kill the other whenever the Faceless Assassin is added to the equation.
Many said he even killed the unkillable Demon King of the Askika Blood Demon Race, setting an unbreakable record in the society of assassins."
"It is common knowledge, so why waste your time using it to try to convince me?" Adin asked, giving Kent a bored look.

"Hold on and let me finish," Kent said, then he added, "You see, if I were to go on about the Faceless Assassin, we wouldn’t be leaving here today, so I will cut it simple and tell you what you don’t know."

Kent took another sip of his tea and began, "To many, Faceless just killed the Demon King after disguising himself as a trusted royal healer and best friend to the Demon King. However, what they didn’t know was how many he had to kill to get that close.
It started with a guard on night patrol. He killed him after finding out he was screwing two women at the same time, and he stole his face.
Then he used his face to kill another guard who patrols the mansion where the general overseeing the outer demon army lived.
From there, he had to kill his way to the General, who took orders straight from one of the Demon Lords, who was much closer to the Ashkrail’s wife, and yes, they were screwing.
So the moment he got that Demon Lord’s face, he finally managed to gain access to the Demon King’s Mansion.
From there, it was as simple as assassinating his way to the Royal Healer. It took 20 kills and a lot of planning, but he managed to reach him.

On the night he killed the Demon King, he killed his three sons and two daughters, including all 17 wives. Aside from them, he killed 305 guards and four maids. But he spared one of his daughters since he saw no fault with her.
Years later, he regretted his action. That harmless young lady turned out to be far worse than her father.
The death of billions of people caused by that harmless bitch told Faceless what he needed to do: never to let evil take the life of the innocent.
That is where the Midnight Shadows came from." Adin took a deep and large gulp, his back shaking.
"H-how did you know all this?"

"I am not done, Adin," Kent continued, "After he managed to kill that hateful lady finally, on his way back, he witnessed a battle between a Mountain Wardog, one of the deadliest beasts in the universe, and a frail-looking assassin wielding two red daggers.
From the start to the end of the battle, the bony fellow was at a disadvantage. However, in the end, he emerged as the winner.
He was Titus Elorm, a Dark Human. Years later, he would be known by all as Crimson Dagger, the first Faceless Agent. Then the Weeping Scythe would appear, becoming the second Faceless Agent."
Adin shuddered in his boot, his expression turning pale as he stared at Kent’s face.
All Kent had said just now sounded like nonsense. However, as he started linking it to the hidden records of the Midnight Shadows, he couldn’t help but validate them.

The Midnight Shadows worship the Faceless Assassin to the point that they spent several eras compiling all they could on him. As one rises through the ranks, they would be granted access to read them to strengthen their belief in their founder.
So, unless one is a high-ranking member of the Midnight Shadows, they would never know.
He knew Kent was not a Midnight Shadow, since he didn’t have the Midnight Seal. If Kent had one, he would have sensed it.
All Midnight Shadows can sense that mark.
So, for Kent to know such hidden details about their Leader and founder, he must have somehow come into contact with Midnight Records. That is the only explanation.
But when he started naming the First Faceless Agents, beings with similar powers to the Faceless Assassin, his mind broke.
"How did you know all this? Who are you?"
Adin asked, his hand resting on his dagger. Seeing this, Kent chuckled.
"I believe you know. You are brilliant, so I know you have already connected the dots." Kent paused for a moment, then he added jokingly,
"If you don’t believe I am him, I can just make you a Faceless Agent." Kent laughed and took another sip of his drink.

"You know what, I am just going to do it since I need no permission from anyone." Before Adin could process it, Kent pressed his finger against his forehead and transmitted the modified version of the Faceless Art to him.
It instantly integrated into his soul, and the Faceless Seal appeared on his forehead.
Adin’s eyes widened, feeling the change that happened to him. Before he knew it, the process was done, leaving him in a daze.
He sat there for a few minutes, his mind blank. However, when he finally regained his calm, he dropped to his knees and bowed, forehead touching the ground.
There is no denying it now. From what he knew, to become a Faceless Assassin, one must go through the Faceless Ascension Trial, something only a few had passed.
In the Midnight Records, only the First Seven Faceless Agents received their mark from the Faceless Assassin himself.
It was recorded in the Midnight Records that, aside from the Faceless Assassin, nobody else could give the Faceless Agent Mark unless they passed through the Faceless Ascension trial.
So the fact that Kent had casually transferred the Faceless Art to him and that he even received the Faceless Agent Mark was all the confirmation he needed.
"This Midnight Shadow greets the Faceless Assassin."
Kent grinned, liking the sound of that.
"Stand up, Adin. I am not fully back yet, so no need for the dramatics. I need your help, and since you aren’t an easy nut to crack, I had to go this extreme."𝒻𝘳𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝘯𝘰𝑣ℯ𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝘮
Adin bowed his head in shame. "I had no idea I was in the presence of the Faceless Assassin. I deserve to be punished."
"I suppose the idea behind the Faceless Art is to be unrecognisable, so it is not your fault. However, I need your help to reach the one who placed the seal on the Upside Down Underworld Forest."

chapters.title: Chapter 1285: A Lot of Thinking
paragraphs: "Whatever you need, tell me. I will promptly get it done," Adin said, his expression serious. Now that he knew he was sitting in the presence of the legendary Faceless Assassin, he became respectful.
"Tell me, if I were to break the seal and enter the forest, how long would it take for the one who placed the seal to arrive?"
"In less than a day."
"That fast?"
"Yes. The Supreme High Worlds have a much closer connection to the Immortal Realm. In our case, all Midnight Temples are linked, so coming down is as easy and simple as walking down a ladder."
"I suppose that is convenient. In any case, it would be best to inform him first," Kent said, knowing that breaking through would be more difficult.
A formation set up by an Immortal Lord is not something that even he can break. It would be maybe Tier 31 to 40 Formation, something only a Formation Immortal could create.

It would even make someone like Alina sweat if she dared attempt to break it. The best move is to ask the creator to lift it temporarily. That would even give Kent the chance to reach out to the people he wanted to make aware of his rebirth.
"Then get on that. However, if you don’t mind me asking, what do you know about the Crimson Dagger?" His targets are the first Seven Faceless Assassins.

"Aside from knowing he is one of the 7 True Midnight Shadows personally recruited and trained by the Faceless Assassin, the only thing I came to know of him when I became the Star Midnight Shadow is that he is a Shadow Supreme, the strongest of us all."
"Oh, I see." Kent seemed happy to know his first recruit is now a Supreme. Becoming a Supreme in this era is very difficult.
The path to Supremehood isn’t as straightforward as it was during the Primordial Era, so only a few can make it.
Unlike godhood, which is relatively easy if all factors are put into perspective, Supremehood is rare, dangerous, and expensive—not talking about Celestialhood. That is even more challenging.
’I just hope there are more Supremes and Celestials than in the Primordial Era. If not, then this era is toast.’
Now that the Void Beasts had made an appearance, it wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say they had already made an even bigger move somewhere else.
So Kent had already started making plans toward the bigger picture. He would need powerhouses on his side.
"Sounds like the Midnight Shadows have become a powerful organisation in the universe." Kent smiled, making Adin feel a little proud.
Looking at the happy expression on Kent’s face, now that he knew he was the one who founded the Midnight Shadows, made him super pleased to be a part of his organisation.
"Has that Immortal Lord who placed the seal become a Faceless Agent yet?" Kent asked, and Adin nodded.
"Yes. Every Galactic Midnight Shadow is a Faceless Agent."
"Even better. Go and reach out to him. I will catch up to you soon."
Adin nodded, but then he stopped himself from leaving, turning back to face Kent with a furrowed brow.
Seeing this, Kent smiled, "If you are wondering whether I know where the Midnight Temple is located, then don’t bother. I built that temple"
Hearing this, Adin faked a smile and nodded. Soon, he was gone. Kent just shook his head and let the smile on his face linger for a few moments.

’I must reach out to former friends and allies and start making plans to handle these threats as fast as possible. Aside from the Void Beasts, there are the Space Beasts, the Forsaken Race, and the many others that nearly brought the universe to its knees in the eras that had passed. If they are not handled and the Void Beasts come, we will be in hot soup.’
Kent leaned back in his seat and drank some more tea. Seeing his cup empty, he poured more since his mind was working in overdrive.
The tea seemed to boost one’s mental strength, so having more wouldn’t hurt.

With the threat of the Void Beast, Kent felt responsible for everyone. Maybe it was because he was the one who led the charge against them during the Primordial Era that made him think he was going to be needed now, too.
From what he had learned over the years in the memories he had recovered so far, whenever something big is about to happen, he would be the one to face it.
So he was preparing ahead of time now, too.
’If not because becoming an immortal would prevent me from using the Star Gateway, I would have ascended and let the ladies and the legion quickly raise their strength.
The faster they become gods, the better.’
Kent took another sip and closed his eyes, allowing himself to relax. Whether he likes it or not, he would have to rise to the occasion when the time comes.
This journey to the Void Forest is going to be the first step to test how prepared he is to become the protector of the universe once again.
’It shall be well. All I need to do is take every problem a step at a time, and hopefully, by the end of this expedition, I will know more about the Void Beasts and their plan this time around.’
After saying that, Kent pulled up the quest again and read through it one more time. The moment he steps into the Void Forest, he will be moving from one danger to another.
’I just have to find the four beasts I must kill and handle them first. Then I can focus on the Void Temple.’
Kent drank the last gulp of the tea and let out a sigh.
’Hopefully, by the time I am done with the Void Temple, Gaia will find the remaining three beasts I need kill so she can use the fangs to create the transportation portal for me.’
He stood up and, using the Soul Map, vanished, appearing 10,000 km away.

After he was done making his plans, he decided to walk around for a bit to waste time and see if he could awaken more memories. By the time he would return to the Midnight Temple, the Immortal Lord would have already arrived.
With Adin handling things, he knew things wouldn’t go too rough this time. The last thing he wanted was dealing with yet another unconvinced assassin.
So for the next 20 hours, Kent walked around the city, making sure he visited all the places he remembered he had been to. Some of those places were still there, some vanished into thin air.
However, one place gave him more than he could ask for. It was a rock bench. He didn’t remember going there in the past, but he sensed he had sat on the bench many times.

So he did, and that was when a flood of memories flowed into his mind. It was memories of when he left to handle the Forsaken Seer, to when he returned after killing an entire planet of Forsaken beings.
In short, he recovered memories from Root Immortal to Immortal Emperor in less than five minutes.
This brought a smile to his face, so he left for the Midnight Temple again.
However, on the way, he suddenly came to a stop and slowly turned back.

"I know assassins are meant to be in the shadows, but isn’t it creepy for two True Immortals to be following a mere mortal?" He chuckled and added, "If you have the balls or titties to face me, why don’t you show yourselves?"

sentences.text: "Whatever you need, tell me.
I will promptly get it done," Adin said, his expression serious.
Now that he knew he was sitting in the presence of the legendary Faceless Assassin, he became respectful.
"Tell me, if I were to break the seal and enter the forest, how long would it take for the one who placed the seal to arrive?"
"In less than a day."
"That fast?"
"Yes.
The Supreme High Worlds have a much closer connection to the Immortal Realm.
In our case, all Midnight Temples are linked, so coming down is as easy and simple as walking down a ladder."
"I suppose that is convenient.
In any case, it would be best to inform him first," Kent said, knowing that breaking through would be more difficult.
A formation set up by an Immortal Lord is not something that even he can break.
It would be maybe Tier 31 to 40 Formation, something only a Formation Immortal could create.
It would even make someone like Alina sweat if she dared attempt to break it.
The best move is to ask the creator to lift it temporarily.
That would even give Kent the chance to reach out to the people he wanted to make aware of his rebirth.
"Then get on that.
However, if you don’t mind me asking, what do you know about the Crimson Dagger?" His targets are the first Seven Faceless Assassins.

Becoming a Supreme in this era is very difficult.
The path to Supremehood isn’t as straightforward as it was during the Primordial Era, so only a few can make it.

That is even more challenging.

chapters.title: Chapter 1286: Yin and Yang
paragraphs: From the shadows, two assassins emerged, one clad in white assassin-style leather armour, the other dressed in black armour.
They each held daggers in their firm grip, their faces covered behind masks.
"To think words would reach the Immortal Realm this fast... It seems a lot has changed over the years." Kent smiled weakly, looking calmly at the two assassins sent by Lord Warden, his disciples.
"So you are the infamous Kent Madson," Yang (white) said, posing it as a question that demanded an answer, and also as a statement.
"I believe that is what my parents named me, so yes." Kent didn’t seem bothered one bit that he was standing before two Shadow Immortals who were also True Immortals.
"May I ask who you two are and why you have been following me?"
Of course, Kent already knew their names. The tower harnesses the power of his [Heavenly Jade Eyes] to discern their identities, but he asked to see what they would say.

"Our identities aren’t important here. What we would like to know is why you slaughtered every last member of the Dark Warden family." Yin spoke, sounding more arrogant than Yang. Clearly, she lived up to her nature as the yin in the yin-yang circle.
Kent chuckled, "Yin and Yang—disciples of the 3945th Dark Warden. Shadow Immortals and True Immortals who have already formed 7 Immortal Qis." Kent paused, then he added...

"It would be in your best interest to answer my questions truthfully, else you wouldn’t be leaving here alive today." Saying that, Kent stomped on the ground, and 10,000 blood runes appeared in the air, forming a 2,000 km wide containment formation.
Yin and Yang instantly became alert.

The fact that Kent knew their identities and the fact that they had just lost their connection to the marks they left in the Immortal Realm, the same mark that would teleport them back home, made them panic.
Sensing the danger, Yang decided to speak, knowing his twin sister would only make things worse.
"No need for hostilities, Kent Madson. We are merely here to know why you committed the massacre that took the lives of all Dark Wardens in the Dark City."
"They touched somebody they shouldn’t have. And the last time I checked, they are the Assassin Temple family."
Yang wanted to speak, but Yin beat him to it.
"And you think just because you are capable, you can do just anything you want? Do you even know the kind of people you are messing with?"
"But I do. However, I don’t give a fuck, so maybe shut up and let the adults do the talking."
"You—" Yin tried to lunge at Kent, but Yang held her back.

"Relax, Yin. This is not the Immortal Realm where you can do as you please." They had been suppressed to the Heavenly Ascension stage, so despite having the expertise of Shadow Immortals, Kent was far stronger than they were.
So they were at a disadvantage, and especially now that they were locked in Kent’s Blood Formation, making the wrong move would end their dear lives.
"Forgive her. She is much more hot-headed."
"I don’t mind. Just know that what is done is done. I killed those who pointed their weapons at me and left those who minded their own business.
If you want revenge, then go ahead; if not, then I happen to be going somewhere important."
"Hold on, please, there is one more thing." Yang retrieved a token from his space ring and threw it to Kent.𝒻𝘳𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝘯𝘰𝑣ℯ𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝘮
"What is this?"
"Lord Warden wanted us to give it to you. It is a message recorder jade token. Just channel your energy into it, and the message will be transmitted to you."
Kent didn’t waste time and quickly channelled his energy into it, as Yang said.
A message quickly entered his head. Kent accessed it, and the first thing he saw was the image of a man with an unfathomable aura seated in a throne-like chair.
The moment Kent laid his eyes on him, the need to go down on his knees and bow to him overwhelmed him. However, he resisted that compulsion and stood his ground.

On the outside, Yin and Yang furrowed their brows behind their masks. They had expected to see one thing: Kent on his knees, sweating profusely. However, his legs didn’t even buckle. That told them all they needed to know.
Meanwhile, Kent kept his gaze locked on Lord Warden.
"If you are seeing this, then it means you managed to withstand 2% of my energy. You should be proud of yourself; not many Spirit Immortals can do that.

I ask that my two disciples pass this message along to you so I can personally extend an invitation. Ninety-five years from today, the Dark Warden family will be hosting a youth ball to test the young, promising talent in th Eastern Galaxy.

It will feature some of the rising assassins, swordsmen, spearmen, and many more. It would also be an event aimed at helping the young talent form alliances ahead of the upcoming opening of the Chaos Rift.
Naturally, only True Immortals and above are invited to such an event; however, I want you to be there.
Before you think this is a trap, know that by accepting this invitation, a contract stating that I will personally ensure your safety will be formed and signed between us.
The coordinates of Planet Warden will be transmitted to you, and the token in your hand is the official invitation.
So what do you think, wanna swing around in the ranks of your peers?"
Kent smiled, "Calling it my peers is just stretching it, but why not. I will be there."
The moment Kent gave his answer, the message ended, and the token turned into a jade invitation token.
"Cute," Kent stored away the token in his tower storage.
"Tell your master he should expect me," said Kent.

"I will do that," Yang replied, and Kent gave him a nod. He then turned to Yin and chuckled, "I don’t know you, but from what I saw, your brother is the best thing to ever happen to you, so listen to him more often."
With another chuckle, Kent recalled his blood runes and vanished, leaving the two Shadow Immortals in a daze.
"I will kill him when I see him in the Immortal Realm," Yin said, gritting her teeth.

"You will have your chance when the Chaos Region opens. Until then, we’d better get back and enter seclusion. The Warden Youth Ball is just 95 years away; we wouldn’t want to disgrace Master now, would we?"
Yin gritted her teeth, but then a sigh escaped her lips. "I guess you are right."
Not sure which direction Kent teleported to, Yin and Yang looked west for a few seconds before they vanished into the shadows.
Standing 60,000 km away, Kent chuckled... "See you later, Yin and Yang. Next time, maybe you wouldn’t be suppressed by me again."
Kent teleported away again.
Inside the narrow hall on Planet Warden, a cold smile appeared on Lord Warden’s face as he stared at a still image of Kent.
"So you are Kent Madson, huh?"
He waved his hand, and the image turned into a small jade figurine and flew into his palm.
"See you in 95 years, Kent Madson."
With another cold smile, he vanished from the narrow hall and appeared inside a teleportation gate.
"Where to today, Lord Warden?" an Immortal King asked, standing at attention.
"The Warden Sanctuary, God Realm."

chapters.title: Chapter 1287: Thousand Blade
paragraphs: Kent spent 2 minutes teleporting continuously toward the Midnight Temple. He knew the location and was aware that to get there, he must use the secret teleportation gate built somewhere in the city.
The teleportation gate would have taken him to the midnight temple in under a minute. However, because he wanted to speak with Yin and Yang, he took the long route.
After two minutes of moving, he came to a stop atop a tall mountain. The mountain overlooks a forest with trees having only black leaves.
"The Black Leaf Forest," Kent muttered, looking at the dark forest stretching as far as the eye could take him. "I never knew I would come here again after this many years had passed."
Kent felt his heartbeat settle, rise, and fall as he gazed at one of the many forests he had trained in whenever he had free time in the past.
The beasts inside this forest are mostly dark type.
Their affinity for the darkness element is very potent, so it would be in any assassin’s best interest to train here if they want to improve their shadow manipulation abilities.
Faceless had frequented this forest countless times when he was still a mortal. So coming back is just too emotionally overwhelming.
Kent extended the soul map scanning abilities, and what he saw made him smile.𝗳𝐫𝚎𝗲𝚠𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝘃𝚎𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺

"Looks like they’ve made the forest their camp and even tamed most of the beasts." He saw some assassins hidden in the shadows, some playing around with the beasts, and others even sparring with them.
As someone who honed his abilities by battling beasts mostly, Kent knew the Midnight Shadows were still following his teachings.
In his opinion, after spending most of his teenage and adult life fighting beasts, Kent realised that if a human behaves like a beast, they become unpredictable to their fellow humans.
He realised this when, after he escaped the Green Rain Forest, whenever he battled an opponent, they couldn’t seem to grasp his battle style.
After fighting thousands of different beasts, he developed a unique battle style, and now, it seems these assassins are also doing the same.

"Good for them, I guess. If they can create their own beast battle style and incorporate human battle styles into it, then aside from killing from the shadows, even in a one-on-one duel, they would have nothing to worry about."
Kent took a step and appeared thousands of meters away in the air.
"Just over this range, the Midnight Temple stood tall and proud." With another step, he closed in some more. Then, with a few more steps, he appeared within 20,000 km of the Midnight Temple.
’Hmm, as expected, even with the restrictions, the Midnight Shadows aren’t affected,’ Kent thought, watching the Immortal Lords gaze back at him from 20,000 km away.

While in the high world where the restriction limits one’s cultivation base to Heavenly Ascension, their strength is still that of an Immortal Lord, and even more shocking is the fact that there are two other Immortal Lords with him.
They each held their scrutinising gaze on him as if they were sizing him up while holding themselves back not to offend him too much. They aren’t sure if he is indeed the real deal.
’Hmm, I am starting to see some trends here,’ Kent thought inwardly. First, it was the Night Riders who, after awakening a particular innate talent, wouldn’t be restricted.

Now, it is the Midnight Shadows. That can’t be a coincidence. Kent knew that, and so he started to suspect that maybe his Undead and Eternal Wrath Legion are there, just that he hadn’t found what he was missing.
’I will look into it when I am back.’ With his mind made up, Kent took the last step, appearing only a few meters from the main gate of the Midnight Temple.
It is built like a castle, with walls made from black stone.
BANG
The door slowly opened, revealing a long hall where, at the far end, four people awaited Kent’s arrival. There were three Immortal Lords and Adin, whose real Death Stage cultivation was revealed.

"Looks like you went above and beyond, Adin," Kent said, appearing inside the hall with a single step. He was using the soul map as a medium, so a single step could go as far as 80,000 km if he wanted.
Instead of replying, Adin bowed. "Welcome back to the Midnight Temple, Lord Faceless."
"Here is the drama again. I already told you to do away with the dramatics, Adin. I am not fully back yet, so treat my presence here as me merely passing by."
Adin nodded and then turned to the three Immortal Lords. But before he could say anything, one of them raised his hand and gestured down, causing a crushing pressure to descend on Kent.
Kent’s body froze in place. Not even his finger could be moved.
"Lord Thousand Blade, what is the meaning of this?" Adin tried to move toward Kent, but his body also froze in place, a horrified expression painting his face.
"Adin, I never saw you to be easily deceived. Do you really think a mere dragon mortal could be who he claimed to be?" Thousand Blades said, taking a step forward.
The other two Immortal Lords just sat there with their expressions calm, though the ridicule could be seen on their faces.
Adin called Thousand Blade since he was the one who created the seal. However, when he arrived, these two, who also seemed to be leaders of a galaxy in the Immortal Realm, came with him.

They all wanted to see who claimed to be the rebirth of their one true leader, the Faceless Assassin. However, when Kent appeared, all they saw was a dragon who had nothing in common with their leader.
So Thousand Blade wanted to test him first since he was told he was Kent Madson. If he were as strong as they said, he would either recruit him or wipe his memory and send him on his way.
He appeared in front of Kent and reached to touch his forehead to read his memories. However, before his hand could come inches from Kent, a grin appeared on his face.
"How interesting. This is just how I expected you losers to behave." Under everyone’s stunned gaze, Kent shook his body and started walking toward a large throne-like chair made from black wood.
He reached the chair and calmly sat down, a smirk on his face. "Cleaner than I expected. Looks like you guys knew I might return someday," Kent then raised his head and looked at Thousand Blade.
"Tsa Ke Lu Ha." He spoke an unrecognisable language and then snapped his finger. However, what happened next caused Thousand Blades and the other two Immortal Lords to drop to their knees.
The Faceless Agent Mark on Thousand Blades’ forehead flickered and dispersed. In an instant, his status as a Faceless Agent was taken from him.
From what they knew, only the Faceless Assassin could do that. This left them in a state of panic. However, what Kent and Adin did next shook them.
"Adin, didn’t you show them the True Faceless Agent Mark?" Kent asked, and Adin, who was supposed to be suppressed, smiled and formed a hand seal.
At once, a complete dagger appeared on his forehead, unlike the half-broken dagger on Thousand Blades and the other two Immortal Lords’ foreheads.
This sight instantly forced them to drop to their knees.

sentences.text: Kent spent 2 minutes teleporting continuously toward the Midnight Temple.
He knew the location and was aware that to get there, he must use the secret teleportation gate built somewhere in the city.
The teleportation gate would have taken him to the midnight temple in under a minute.
However, because he wanted to speak with Yin and Yang, he took the long route.
After two minutes of moving, he came to a stop atop a tall mountain.
The mountain overlooks a forest with trees having only black leaves.
"The Black Leaf Forest," Kent muttered, looking at the dark forest stretching as far as the eye could take him.
"I never knew I would come here again after this many years had passed."
Kent felt his heartbeat settle, rise, and fall as he gazed at one of the many forests he had trained in whenever he had free time in the past.
The beasts inside this forest are mostly dark type.
Their affinity for the darkness element is very potent, so it would be in any assassin’s best interest to train here if they want to improve their shadow manipulation abilities.
Faceless had frequented this forest countless times when he was still a mortal.
So coming back is just too emotionally overwhelming.
Kent extended the soul map scanning abilities, and what he saw made him smile.𝗳𝐫𝚎𝗲𝚠𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝘃𝚎𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺

"Looks like they’ve made the forest their camp and even tamed most of the beasts." He saw some assassins hidden in the shadows, some playing around with the beasts, and others even sparring with them.
As someone who honed his abilities by battling beasts mostly, Kent knew the Midnight Shadows were still following his teachings.
In his opinion, after spending most of his teenage and adult life fighting beasts, Kent realised that if a human behaves like a beast, they become unpredictable to their fellow humans.
He realised this when, after he escaped the Green Rain Forest, whenever he battled an opponent, they couldn’t seem to grasp his battle style.
After fighting thousands of different beasts, he developed a unique battle style, and now, it seems these assassins are also doing the same.
"Good for them, I guess.

If they can create their own beast battle style and incorporate human battle styles into it, then aside from killing from the shadows, even in a one-on-one duel, they would have nothing to worry about."
Kent took a step and appeared thousands of meters away in the air.
"Just over this range, the Midnight Temple stood tall and proud." With another step, he closed in some more.
Then, with a few more steps, he appeared within 20,000 km of the Midnight Temple.
’Hmm, as expected, even with the restrictions, the Midnight Shadows aren’t affected,’ Kent thought, watching the Immortal Lords gaze back at him from 20,000 km away.

While in the high world where the restriction limits one’s cultivation base to Heavenly Ascension, their strength is still that of an Immortal Lord, and even more shocking is the fact that there are two other Immortal Lords with him.
They each held their scrutinising gaze on him as if they were sizing him up while holding themselves back not to offend him too much.
They aren’t sure if he is indeed the real deal.
’Hmm, I am starting to see some trends here,’ Kent thought inwardly.
First, it was the Night Riders who, after awakening a particular innate talent, wouldn’t be restricted.
Now, it is the Midnight Shadows.
That can’t be a coincidence.
Kent knew that, and so he started to suspect that maybe his Undead and Eternal Wrath Legion are there, just that he hadn’t found what he was missing.
’I will look into it when I am back.’ With his mind made up, Kent took the last step, appearing only a few meters from the main gate of the Midnight Temple.
It is built like a castle, with walls made from black stone.
BANG
The door slowly opened, revealing a long hall where, at the far end, four people awaited Kent’s arrival.
There were three Immortal Lords and Adin, whose real Death Stage cultivation was revealed.
"Looks like you went above and beyond, Adin," Kent said, appearing inside the hall with a single step.
He was using the soul map as a medium, so a single step could go as far as 80,000 km if he wanted.
Instead of replying, Adin bowed.
"Welcome back to the Midnight Temple, Lord Faceless."
"Here is the drama again.
I already told you to do away with the dramatics, Adin.
I am not fully back yet, so treat my presence here as me merely passing by."
Adin nodded and then turned to the three Immortal Lords.
But before he could say anything, one of them raised his hand and gestured down, causing a crushing pressure to descend on Kent.
Kent’s body froze in place.
Not even his finger could be moved.
"Lord Thousand Blade, what is the meaning of this?" Adin tried to move toward Kent, but his body also froze in place, a horrified expression painting his face.
"Adin, I never saw you to be easily deceived.
Do you really think a mere dragon mortal could be who he claimed to be?" Thousand Blades said, taking a step forward.
The other two Immortal Lords just sat there with their expressions calm, though the ridicule could be seen on their faces.
Adin called Thousand Blade since he was the one who created the seal.
However, when he arrived, these two, who also seemed to be leaders of a galaxy in the Immortal Realm, came with him.
They all wanted to see who claimed to be the rebirth of their one true leader, the Faceless Assassin.
However, when Kent appeared, all they saw was a dragon who had nothing in common with their leader.
So Thousand Blade wanted to test him first since he was told he was Kent Madson.
If he were as strong as they said, he would either recruit him or wipe his memory and send him on his way.
He appeared in front of Kent and reached to touch his forehead to read his memories.
However, before his hand could come inches from Kent, a grin appeared on his face.
"How interesting.
This is just how I expected you losers to behave." Under everyone’s stunned gaze, Kent shook his body and started walking toward a large throne-like chair made from black wood.
He reached the chair and calmly sat down, a smirk on his face.
"Cleaner than I expected.
Looks like you guys knew I might return someday," Kent then raised his head and looked at Thousand Blade.

chapters.title: Chapter 1288: Opening The Seal
paragraphs: Many years ago, when Faceless was creating the modified version of the Faceless Art, he added a complex array that prevented all bearers of the Faceless Agent Mark from suppressing him, regardless of their strength.
Later, he made it so he could easily take away the power of the Faceless Agent Mark and even waive all restrictions on anyone who has the mark.

It wasn’t because he didn’t trust his assassins; he only put that condition in there to ensure moments when any of his assassins were to become puppets under anyone’s control, they wouldn’t be able to hurt him or anyone.
The Faceless Agent Mark isn’t as simple as one might think. It actually brought out the Midnight Shadows’ hidden potential.
Initially, the Midnight Shadows weren’t a powerful assassin organisation in the universe. However, after the Faceless Agents started appearing, their power skyrocketed.
So he made sure they were protected, and that was achieved through the Faceless Agent Mark.
Today, that mark came in handy when a Faceless Agent tried to suppress him. Thousand Blade had no idea he was standing before the Faceless Assassin.
Naturally, all these factors were a test Adin had devised to see how much the Faceless Agents could accept Kent as their master. He wanted to measure their level of trust.
Kent told him the Faceless Agent Mark he gave him is the True Mark. That one is a complete dagger, something only the first 7 Faceless Agents have.

So if he were to show this mark to the immortals, they would have instantly believed Kent was the Faceless Assassin. But he didn’t do that; instead, he merely called them over and let them judge for themselves.
Now, looking at the mark on his forehead, the three immortals felt like they had been conspired against, and the one to be blamed is Adin.
However, they have a much bigger problem now, which is especially true for Thousand Blade, who dared attack his own boss.

"I didn’t recognise the Faceless Assassin and even dared to try to suppress him. Please, Lord Faceless, I will accept my punishment," Thousand Blade said, his head bowed, his neck almost hanging by a thread.
"We will accept our punishment," the other two immortals also said.
"Stand up, guys. I am not here to punish anyone, so don’t sweat it." They lifted their heads and looked at Kent, who rested his right hand on the arm of the chair and his fist supporting his chin.
"You have done nothing wrong, so sit down and let’s talk. I asked Adin to call you here today for something more important."
Kent flicked his finger, and a beam of energy flew out, merging with Thousand Blade’s forehead. His Faceless Mark that Kent wiped appeared, but this time as a complete mark (dagger).
"Thank you, Lord Faceless."

Kent just smiled and looked toward the other two Immortal Lords. Seeing his gaze, they straightened up. They both had short dark hair, but one was a Dark Elf and the other an Umbral human. "May I know your assassin names?"
The Dark Elf answered, "I am Black Arrow."
"And I am Silent Requiem."
"Well, pleasure to meet you guys. I am Kent Madson, as Adin told you. However, if you prefer, you can call me Faceless, since that was once my assassin name."

They nodded. Kent also nodded and gave them the full faceless agent mark. It is their fortune to have met him today. With the full mark now activated, their powers would take a more powerful jump in the coming years.
"I believe Adin has already briefed you on why I asked you to come today," Kent turned to Thousand Blade and asked.
"Yes, Lord Faceless. I was indeed the one who created the sealing formation."
"I see. Looks like you took your second identity seriously and became a rather good formation expert."
Since every Midnight Shadow is expected to have a second identity that would allow them to blend in, Thousand Blade became a Formation Expert just like how Liora became an Alchemist.
There are many out there, certified assassins disguised as ordinary folks, some even as scholars.
"I was just lucky the Midnight Shadows gave me the best opportunity to learn."
"Be proud of your achievement, Thousand Blade. But in any case, I need to enter the forest for a mission, and I would like it if you could temporarily lift the seal."
"Sure." There was no need to ask what he intended to do in there. Just the fact that they knew he was the Faceless Assassin was enough.

"However, Lord Faceless should know that the forest has become dangerous now. According to what I extracted from the Immortal who came back barely alive, he only came out because one of the True Immortals who went in with them knows space law.

From his memories, I saw he was pushed into a space tunnel by that True Immortal, who was captured by something, perhaps someone. He didn’t know the thing, but it was strong enough to capture a True Immortal and several others.
So be careful when you go in there."
"I will be. I already know what I am walking into, so I will be ready for anything."
There were some talks here and there, but soon, they departed for the location of the Void Forest. Kent didn’t want to waste any more time.
Some time later, Kent, Thousand Blade, and the others arrived at the location of the Void Forest. As expected, it was a large, dark hole that looked eerie, like it should.
"When it fell, it became this large hole with strange and eerie sounds. Even we, Immortal Lords, feel like entering there would be the worst decision we would make."
"Oh, believe me. If any of you had entered, not even your bones would have returned."
If indeed the Void Beasts had made a move, then even if a god entered the forest and there was indeed a Void Temple there, their death would be guaranteed.
The Void Temple adapts to the strength of Immortal Kings and above. It was even one of the reasons Kent became happy that the forest was sealed instead of sending more Immortals inside.
During the Primordial Era, all the Void Temples that were destroyed were achieved by True Immortals and below.

The moment anyone higher than that entered, the temple would adjust to match them, and as simple as that may sound, a true god with average abilities can’t last even a minute against a True God Void Beast.
Because of these restrictions, not all Void Temples were destroyed. This fast-tracked the descent of the Void Beasts.
"Lift the seal."
Thousand Blade moved forward and formed a couple of hand seals. The moment he was done, the seal appeared and flickered.𝒇𝙧𝙚𝓮𝙬𝙚𝓫𝒏𝓸𝓿𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝙤𝓶
Then, suddenly, an opening appeared inside the seal.
However, before Kent could move in and enter, since the seal couldn’t remain open for long, a Roc flashed out, trying to escape.
However, Thousand Blade merely waved his hand, and it was cut in half.
"This is going to be super dangerous," Kent grinned and then flew toward the opening... "Wait for me here. I will let you know when I am done with my business so you can open the seal again."
With that, he took a nosedive into the opening and vanished into the darkness.
