chapters.title: Chapter 1289: Entering The Void Forest
paragraphs: [Void Temple - First Floor]
Deep within the void forest, a red pagoda surrounded by thousands of beasts, each a monster in their own right, stood, oozing with Corrupted Void energy.
The red pagoda is segmented into five floors, each floor having a name written in the Aelthryn language, the mother tongue of all Void Beasts.
On the first floor, the name ’Temple Master of Annihilation’ has been carved on a dark plate and hung for all who could read to understand.
Inside this floor, all that could be seen is fire and lava. It was as if a volcano or series of volcanoes had erupted there and kept erupting, filling the entire region with both heat and fire.
Jagged mountains and a sea of lava could be seen everywhere.

Somewhere deep in this godforsaken place sat a towering demonic entity with obsidian skin split by molten void-flame veins. He is leaning comfortably in his flaming throne, eyes closed, yet they continue to radiate flame.
He looks hideous and terrifying. Twin abyssal horns crown his head, and his core burns with flame and malice.
In his hand is a large chalice filled with red, scorching lava wine. The sheer heat coming off the wine is enough to incinerate anyone whose resistance to fire isn’t at the Perfect Immunity stage.
Suddenly, his eyes opened, causing the pressure in the air to increase.

"Hmm, someone is coming here finally." A twisted smile appeared on his face as his gaze pierced through the barriers of the void temple and toward a handsome dragon man who had just jumped into the Void Forest.
"It is going to be fun for sure." As if bored, he started to stir, pleasure appearing in his eyes. Kent’s arrival seems to make him happy.
On the outside, far from the void temple, all kinds of beasts, each not weaker than Tier 20 (Empyrean) stage beasts, started moving in the direction Kent was coming.
These beasts, although they look mutated, had yet to reach the level of Pseudo-Void Beasts compared to those much closer to the Void Temple.
They all heeded the call of the Temple Master of Annihilation and began moving toward the location where Kent would land.
It was like he was sending the cannon fodder to their death, but also to see the kind of person coming into the tower. The last time, 20 people came, but this time, only one.
He isnt dumb enough to think Kent entered by accident. He knew that for a lone figure to be sent here might mean he was no simple person.
Meanwhile, Kent, who had just jumped into the Void Forest, started falling at great speed. He allowed his weight to carry him since it was free-fall.
The Soul Map is active, allowing him to sense his surroundings and see 80,000km deep into the darkness.
"This place reeks of death," Kent muttered, falling like he had lost control. Suddenly, a thin sword appeared and flashed forward at an incredible speed, even greater than how fast Kent was falling.
Far ahead, a winged beast sensed Kent coming and moved toward him. However, before it could cross any distance, a thin 3-meter sword appeared and stabbed through its head.
There was no dodging it. Kent used the Soul Map to move it, so all it saw was a sword appear, and that was all.
Its blood essence appeared and flew toward Kent. But that wasn’t all he took. Considering the dead beast was within the range of the Soul Map, he drained its blood too.
He needed it to undergo his second Blood Cleansing Bath, so he needed the blood. As for the blood essence, it was absorbed by Kent.
Since there was no immediate threat to his life, he absorbed it directly instead of storing it inside the Soul Universe.
"As expected, the moment the mutation affects the beasts, their blood essence becomes much stronger." Feeling the power of the blood essence he had absorbed, Kent felt the danger also.
The stronger the blood essence, the more dangerous they are. So while he would gain more by absorbing the blood essence, the opponents he would go against wouldn’t be a walk in the park.
[Master, we have ten incomings.]

The tower informed Kent after the scan detected 10 winged beasts, each at the Peak Heavenly Ascension stage. They have been affected by the Void Essence’s mutation too, but have yet to reach the Pseudo-Void Beast stage.

Kent summoned nine more swords, which he added to the one he used to kill the first beasts. The weapon-creation process he started in the Soul Universe ended with the creation of 41,000 three-meter-long swords and 30,000 3.5-meter-long spears.
Although all of them are one-time use only, unless they shatter, he can reuse them. It was only if the sword breaks on the outside that he cannot take them back.
The first sword he summoned killed the winged beasts, so he could have sent it back to the Soul Universe, where it would have absorbed soul essence and strengthened itself.
However, it still has more energy inside it to take care of the ten incoming beasts.
Kent waited for the beasts to enter the 1000 km range. The moment they did, the ten swords moved and, like before, the beasts never saw the attack coming... well, one did.
Just when the sword was about to strike a spider-looking winged beast, two of its legs, which had mutated into metallic substance, were moved and deflected the sword.
"Oh."
Kent furrowed his brow when he saw this. The other nine were killed and had already been drained of all blood, but this one proved to be more agile.
And since it wasn’t struck head-on but was deflected, it didn’t lose its momentum. It closed the gap between it and Kent in an instant.
However, just when it saw the prey it was after, all ten swords it had ignored snuck up on him. This time, Kent aimed for both metallic legs and its wings.
With ten deadly swords stabbing at the same time, it wasn’t strong and fast enough to defend against them. It was quick and decisive, like one would expect an attack from a sword king.
However, Kent didn’t have a moment to rest; the next second, dozens more entered his scanning range.
He smiled and summoned a thousand swords, painting the air red. Soon, all that could be heard were the dying screams of the beasts that saw Kent to be easy prey, so they came for him.
[Outside]
On the outside, Thousand Blade quickly closed the portal that he had opened and even reinforced it some more. Then he turns to Black Arrow and Silent Requiem.
"Stand guard, I need to go back to the Immortal Realm and send a message to the God Realm. The leaders need to know Lord Faceless has returned."
"Rest assured, Thousand Blade, we will make sure no harm comes to the seal."
They aren’t worried about what’s going on inside; there are dangers on the outside as well. They wouldn’t want such dangers to enter the Void Forest, not when their leader had just ventured inside.
After making sure everything was as it should be, Thousand Blade left quickly. With their leader now back, things wouldn’t be the same anymore.

He needed it to undergo his second Blood Cleansing Bath, so he needed the blood.
As for the blood essence, it was absorbed by Kent.
Since there was no immediate threat to his life, he absorbed it directly instead of storing it inside the Soul Universe.
"As expected, the moment the mutation affects the beasts, their blood essence becomes much stronger." Feeling the power of the blood essence he had absorbed, Kent felt the danger also.
The stronger the blood essence, the more dangerous they are.
So while he would gain more by absorbing the blood essence, the opponents he would go against wouldn’t be a walk in the park.
[Master, we have ten incomings.]
The tower informed Kent after the scan detected 10 winged beasts, each at the Peak Heavenly Ascension stage.
They have been affected by the Void Essence’s mutation too, but have yet to reach the Pseudo-Void Beast stage.
Kent summoned nine more swords, which he added to the one he used to kill the first beasts.
The weapon-creation process he started in the Soul Universe ended with the creation of 41,000 three-meter-long swords and 30,000 3.5-meter-long spears.
Although all of them are one-time use only, unless they shatter, he can reuse them.
It was only if the sword breaks on the outside that he cannot take them back.
The first sword he summoned killed the winged beasts, so he could have sent it back to the Soul Universe, where it would have absorbed soul essence and strengthened itself.
However, it still has more energy inside it to take care of the ten incoming beasts.
Kent waited for the beasts to enter the 1000 km range.
The moment they did, the ten swords moved and, like before, the beasts never saw the attack coming... well, one did.
Just when the sword was about to strike a spider-looking winged beast, two of its legs, which had mutated into metallic substance, were moved and deflected the sword.
"Oh."
Kent furrowed his brow when he saw this.
The other nine were killed and had already been drained of all blood, but this one proved to be more agile.
And since it wasn’t struck head-on but was deflected, it didn’t lose its momentum.
It closed the gap between it and Kent in an instant.
However, just when it saw the prey it was after, all ten swords it had ignored snuck up on him.
This time, Kent aimed for both metallic legs and its wings.
With ten deadly swords stabbing at the same time, it wasn’t strong and fast enough to defend against them.
It was quick and decisive, like one would expect an attack from a sword king.
However, Kent didn’t have a moment to rest; the next second, dozens more entered his scanning range.
He smiled and summoned a thousand swords, painting the air red.
Soon, all that could be heard were the dying screams of the beasts that saw Kent to be easy prey, so they came for him.
[Outside]
On the outside, Thousand Blade quickly closed the portal that he had opened and even reinforced it some more.
Then he turns to Black Arrow and Silent Requiem.
"Stand guard, I need to go back to the Immortal Realm and send a message to the God Realm.
The leaders need to know Lord Faceless has returned."
"Rest assured, Thousand Blade, we will make sure no harm comes to the seal."
They aren’t worried about what’s going on inside; there are dangers on the outside as well.
They wouldn’t want such dangers to enter the Void Forest, not when their leader had just ventured inside.
After making sure everything was as it should be, Thousand Blade left quickly.
With their leader now back, things wouldn’t be the same anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 1290: Meteor Shower
paragraphs: SLASH
A red sword zipped through the air, cutting the head of a bat-like beast. It had a large head and jagged teeth, making it look hideous and surprisingly terrifying.
Many beasts of the kind were being slaughtered all around, making Kent wonder if he had appeared in their nest. Of course, other beasts are attacking him too, but the hideous bats are numerous.
All of them are Peak Heavenly Ascension Stage Beasts, but as he continued to kill and absorb the blood essence, Kent noticed the difference in their strength.
However, that is not of concern to him. All he needed was to level up much faster.

To someone like him, every level he ascends makes a lot of difference, so he is killing with the intent of reaching the peak of the Heavenly Ascension Stage before he even starts the first phase of his mission.
Thankfully, the swords he created were doing more than he couldn’t have done with his own two hands.
Some are getting destroyed, but with each explosion of a sword, a powerful soul attack follows. This is making the destruction of the swords even more worthwhile.

’Calix, use the new Soul Spirits to strengthen yourself. Soon, there will be multiple harrowing battles, and I need you at your peak.’ Kent transmitted to his soul warrior resting inside his Soul Universe.
"Okay, My Lord." Calix sat in a lotus posture and began absorbing the soul spirits that appeared within the Soul Universe as a result of Kent’s little airborne massacre.
He did say he needed stronger soul spirits if he wanted to have a shot at reaching the Root Immortal stage.
Although Kent knew it wasn’t going to be that simple, since he is now farming more soul spirits, letting him increase his strength wasn’t too bad.
[Master, we have lost 100 swords.]
’Replace them and then forge more. Since we now have the soul spirits, keep creating more swords and spears.’
[The swords cost less compared to the spears. So until we have more soul spirits, I will go for the swords. You have 30,000 spears untouched yet after all.]
’Do as you see fit, Tower. All I want is enough weapons to use when I need them.’
Soon, the ground entered Kent’s sensing range. However, what he saw made his blood turn cold.
On the ground, waiting for him, is a sea of monsters, some bigger than an apartment building, while others are relatively small to take them seriously.
Ant Queens, three-headed lions, metallic spiders, wyverns, rhinos, and a whole lot of monsters stood, growling, howling, roaring, and making all kinds of sounds.
Kent caught his fall and started moving at his own pace as his brain worked to devise a plan. "Looks like it is going to be a dangerous battle when I touch down, Tower."
[Indeed, Master. The moment you touch down, they will be all over you.]

Kent knew that, and so he started looking around him. All over, the swords he is controlling are doing their work; however, he knew even if he were to take out all his weapons from the Soul Universe, it wouldn’t be enough for what is waiting for him on the ground.
[The Master can go ahead and drop some meteorites. I am sure that will create a loud enough chaos for the Master to make his appearance.]
Kent grinned. He was thinking about the same thing. Although he has only 3000 meteorites, if he were to use just a hundred, the impact would be loud enough to clear a couple of thousand beasts.
But he would be down a hundred meteorites.

"Let’s do that," Kent said as he came to a stop just when he was 10,000 km from the ground. He tapped into his Soul Universe, and then, up in the air, 100 meteorites appeared, instantly clearing the darkness.
On the outside, Adin and the two immortals felt the Void Forest start to tremble as bright orange lights appeared through the seal.
They knew something big was going on deep inside the Void Forest, but they didn’t know what.
Meanwhile, on the ground inside the Void Forest, the thousands of beasts that had congregated started to scatter, watching as flaming mountains of space stones rapidly descended on them.
Kent remained in the air, a smirk playing on his lips as the meteorites passed him by and headed toward the ground.
Inside the Void Temple, the Annihilation Temple Master sat upright, his expression shocked. He never in his life expected someone like Kent to unleash such a power of annihilation.
However, inasmuch as he would love to deny it, the meteorites falling are worthy to be called annihilation-worthy attacks.
In the end, nothing could stop them from falling.
BOOM BOOM BOOM
They started exploding on the ground, creating deep craters. With every explosion of the meteorite, a sea of flames burst out everywhere, swallowing everything in its path.
Kent made sure he spread out the meteorites far enough to create a chain of explosions, ensuring all the beasts that moved back when the meteorites appeared were struck.
"Waste of precious blood," Kent shook his head, watching as thousands of beasts were being burned to ashes and charred remains.
Their blood is being burnt, leaving Kent with little to absorb into his Soul Universe.
However, the blood essences are being absorbed, and that is all that matters. He may lose blood during his second blood-cleansing bath, but it can be recovered later.
Once he finds a good place to settle down, he will absorb the blood essence to boost his cultivation and see if he can saturate his first core with this much.
In a span of five minutes, all 100 meteorites exploded and killed tens of thousands of beasts. When the last meteorite exploded, a vast land of scorched earth was revealed.
Kent had completely cleared about 300,000 km of land mass. Large craters stretching several thousand kilometres and going as deep as another thousand kilometres littered the ground.
"Tower, how many did we get?"
[102,567 beasts. The majority are Heavenly Ascension—a couple of thousand Empyrean and hundreds of Life stage beasts. We failed to kill any of the Death stage beasts.
However, their escape path has given a direction for where the Void Temple is located. It would also lead us to the beasts we came here to hunt.]
"Then it was a resounding success, huh?" Kent took a deep breath, and then he flew down, landing softly on the hot ground.
Inside the 80,000 km radius, no living beast could be seen. All of them had either become ash or charred remains of their former selves.
It was a good slaughter and a remarkable entrance for someone of Kent’s standing.
"Someone is watching me." Kent suddenly stopped and then turned sharply to the west. He cannot see the person, but he can tell they are watching him with extreme killing intent.
Knowing this, an idea formed in his mind. He let a grin form on his face...

"I don’t know if you can hear me, but know that I am coming, and the only thing you can do is wash your neck and wait for me." After saying that, Kent gave the person the middle finger before jumping into one of the craters, vanishing from sight.
Inside the Void Temple, the demonic-looking temple master gritted his teeth, flames bursting out from his eyes.
He heard what Kent said, and to make it worse, he also lost sight of him. It was like Kent had vanished from his eye.
Over a hundred thousand beasts he sent out died like chickens. That is a low blow...
So he sent out a thousand more, this time many Death stage beasts to surround the crater. When Kent comes out, he will be dead meat.

chapters.title: Chapter 1291: Reaching The Peak
paragraphs: The crater that Kent jumped into is about 1500 km deep. A testament to how devastating that Meteorite was. The deeper he fell, the darker it became. It was like falling into the Abyss forest all over again.
The darkness is endless, but he knew there was a button deep somewhere.
However, as he continued to fall deeper, the area around him started to grow hot, indicating he was nearing a lava pool.
Thankfully, he didn’t reach that deep, since after falling about 1200 km, he saw a large hollow cave through his soul map that seemed to have been formed by the explosion.
This took away the need to create his own cave.
He quickly stabilised himself and entered without any hesitation. The moment he did, a Tier 14 formation opened and enveloped the cave.
It was one of the formations Alina prepared for him before he left. She didn’t want her man to lack the basic tools that would come in handy in situations like this.
This formation creates the illusion that there is no cave there. But even if the cave was discovered, it is strong enough to withstand some of the attacks long enough for Kent to make his move.
"Tower, is the bastard still watching me?" Kent asked after creating an ice bed and sat down in a lotus posture.

[No, master. I have harnessed the power of the soul universe to block his senses. Unless he put some effort into it, he wouldn’t be able to find you down here. However, the moment you leave here, he would start seeing you again.]
"Good. How about his strength? Do you have an idea?"
[Not really. But based on the energy from his gaze and killing intent, he is within the first three stages of immortality. So there is a chance he is Root, Core, or Spirit Immortal.]
"As long as he is not a True Immortal, I have nothing to worry about. Even if I can’t kill him, I can make a run for it long enough to come up with a solid plan."
Kent knew the person whose gaze he sensed must be inside the Void Temple, so he knew they would meet one way or another soon.
But until they meet, he now has the time to strengthen himself. Until his two cores are saturated, he wouldn’t make a move against the Void Temple.
This means if he had to, he would kill every last beast in the forest.
He only hopes there are no nasty surprises waiting for him up there.
"Everything will take care of itself in due time." With that, Kent brought out over a hundred thousand blood essences and began absorbing them.
He never expected to make this much harvest in only a few minutes after he entered the Void Forest. At most, he expected to kill a few tens of thousands, then make a run for it.
However, with the meteor shower, he was able to do ten times that. So all he could do was absorb and hope that in due time, his cultivation would rise to the Peak of the Heavenly Ascension stage.
After about 20 minutes, a message appeared in his vision.
<You have absorbed enough Blood Essence to Level Up. Heavenly Ascension Level 5>
This sudden level-up gave Kent so much of a boost in strength that he couldn’t help letting a smile appear on his face.
His strength increased a lot, but aside from that, the amount of blood essence he could harness into his attacks also increased.

To many, a minor level-up was merely a drop in a large pool. But to Kent, who had formed two large blood cores instead of one, just this single boost was all he needed to bridge the gap between him and Root Immortals.
From the moment his strength reached Level 4 after the massacre he committed just recently, he knew he was on the same level as a Death Stage cultivator.

Of course, that doesn’t mean that if he meets a Death Stage warrior, he can misbehave. However, for a Heavenly Ascension Stage warrior to possess that much strength, it was only normal to say he is a monster among monsters.
Now, he is moving closer to the level of a Root Immortal. With a single level up, he had made so much progress.
If he happens to reach the rank of something at the Peak Root Immortal without an Immortal Qi, then even if he meets a Core Immortal with an Immortal Qi, he can face them squarely.
The only downside here is that he would have to do more than harness his blood qi, since an Immortal Qi is like a whole immortal. Luckily, with the blood runes, he can easily bridge that gap, too.
Soon, he started rising through the ranks just like how he wanted to.
<You have absorbed enough Blood Essence to Level Up. Heavenly Ascension Level 6>
<You have absorbed enough Blood Essence to Level Up. Heavenly Ascension Level 7>𝘧𝓇ℯ𝑒𝓌𝑒𝑏𝓃𝘰𝘷𝘦𝘭.𝒸ℴ𝓂
<You have absorbed enough Blood Essence to Level Up. Heavenly Ascension Level 8>
By now, Kent had absorbed about 30% of the blood essence he had farmed. And since he had reached Level 8, it is only a matter of time before he reaches Level 9, which is the peak.

Eventually, he did, and that was when something bizarre happened. The moment the message appeared indicating he had reached Level 9, the remaining blood essence in the air, about 55,000, rushed into his forehead like a magnet was pulling them.
Inside his soul sea, they flooded into his first blood core, causing it to release a surge of energy. Kent could feel his strength rising by the second.
The more blood essence absorbed into his core, the stronger he felt. Naturally, that shouldn’t be possible considering he had already reached the peak of a high world.
However, he was getting stronger, and that wasn’t stopping anytime soon.
Eventually, the last of the blood essence was absorbed; however, the core hadn’t saturated, leaving Kent frustrated.

"If this is just the first core, then how about the second and the third up to the 9th?" Just the idea made him want to punch the cave in. He had no idea how much he would need to make all that happen.
However, now that he had reached the peak of the Heavenly Ascension Stage and all blood essence had been absorbed, what he came there to do is done.
But that doesn’t mean he is leaving. His core is not yet saturated, but something else had taken a sudden leap, making him smile widely.

Reaching the peak of the Heavenly Ascension Stage impacted his blood runes, awakening more than he had hoped. Before he started this short seclusion, he had 55,600 blood runes; however, now it seems he had taken a huge leap.
<You have awakened 70,000 Blood Runes. Blood Runes: 70,000/105,600>
<You have awakened 26% of your Primordial Chaos Bloodline>
But aside from the blood runes, his bloodline had also taken a leap. This single leap came with so much improvement.
He had yet to form his Chaos Heart, but this level-up is enough to give him the power to go back out there and kick ass.

chapters.title: Chapter 1292: Underworld Soul River
paragraphs: With Kent now at peak, his next move was to focus on his soul cultivation and then break the limits on his four attributes: body, mind, soul, and cultivation.
So far, he had broken 3 limits each on his four attributes, making 12 in total. Naturally, that was more than enough for someone in the high world.

Most prodigies in the high world can go as far as 16, some 18, and the best of them sit at 20. Naturally, they could go further than that. However, the resources in the high worlds are limited, so those who can go as far as 20 are both wealthy and hardworking.
However, Kent already has the means to break at least 3 more limits each, since to him, breaking a limit is as simple as having sex with his wives.
Ever since he began walking the path of slaughter, instead of earning spiritual qi from the yin qi he absorbed from his wives, it has turned into limit-breaker points.

Now, with every sex he has with his wives, he earns those points. However, while it isn’t enough to break more limits, since each limit broken increases the number of limit-breaker points required for the next, Kent happens to have a goddess in his harem.

When he was in the medium world, he wasn’t earning anything usable from Vexthra when they had sex. In fact, the yin qi she had sealed inside him when they first met in the god realm was basically useless.
She was too powerful for Kent to use even a drop of her yin qi.

However, the moment he ascended, the essence he had stored from her began to show its might. Now, provided he has the required cultivation level and soul strength, he can use the points to break the limits.

So now that he had reached the peak in cultivation level required of a mortal in the High World, the only thing left was to increase the strength of his soul. Thankfully, he has more than enough soul essence to use for that.

He had more worlds linked to him, and millions of people inside the tower now, so the last thing he would be worried about is running out of soul essence, at least while he is still in the high world.
"Time to increase my soul strength and see the surprises waiting for me inside my soul universe and soul sea."
The tower started directing the soul essence into Kent’s soul. The thrill instantly sent him into a state of joy. The more soul essence channelled into his soul, the stronger his soul gets.
His soul is vast, so like his cultivation base, a single level up is enough to boost his soul strength beyond mortal comprehension.
The last time he checked with Elsa, she had already reached Tier 21, showing she wasn’t limited by the high world limit either. She is a soul sentinel after. One of the 13 legions.
However, Kent knew he would be restricted at the Tier 19 stage. He knew this because he could tell his existence, if not kept in check, would topple the heavens.

Unlike Elsa, who, if restricted at Tier 19, would have her growth stagnate, Kent isn’t like that. Even if he was shackled at Tier 19, his soul universe is there to keep him growing, just like how, at the peak of his cultivation, his core is still absorbing blood essence.
So he wasn’t too worried. Even at Tier 16, he feels like he would win in a soul battle against a Tier 19. So if he gets to Tier 19, then perhaps even Tier 23 wouldn’t be his match.
Also, once he is back from Elina’s galaxy, he will ascend to the immortal realm.
After about three minutes, a message appeared showing his progress. Soon, more messages started appearing.
<You have absorbed enough soul essence to level up. Soul Cultivation: Tier 17>
<You have absorbed enough soul essence to level up. Soul Cultivation: Tier 18>
<You have absorbed enough soul essence to level up. Soul Cultivation: Tier 19>
<Congratulations, you have unlocked a new soul skill. Name: Underworld Soul River>
The moment the last message appeared, the limits started breaking. It was like the tower wanted to take her master to the peak as quickly as possible.𝒇𝒓𝙚𝒆𝔀𝓮𝓫𝒏𝓸𝙫𝓮𝓵.𝓬𝙤𝙢
Of course, that is perfectly understandable, considering the situation they had found themselves in. Soon, however, the limits started breaking like crazy.

In no time, he has broken 4 limits on all four attributes: mind, soul, body, and cultivation. After the 4th limit for each attribute was broken, the process stopped, indicating that he had reached another bottleneck.
But even so, he had made so much progress that he never saw coming. He estimated three each, but he got 4 instead.
<You have broken the 7th Limit on your Mind.>
<You have broken the 7th Limit on your Soul.>
<You have broken the 7th Limit on your Body.>
<You have broken the 7th Limit on your Cultivation.>

"Well, that took an unexpected turn real quick," Kent grinned, feeling the power surge through him. "Breaking 28 limits in total while only at the Heavenly Ascension Stage. I wonder how many I can break when I become an immortal."
Kent didn’t even want to know, considering that Vexthra had told him that breaking limits on the four attributes is what increases one’s chance of forming Immortal Qi.
So at the Immortal Stage, aside from forming Immortal Qi, one thing everyone focuses on is breaking the limits on their four attributes.
She even bragged and said that by the time she became a True Immortal, she had broken 40 limits. According to her, that achievement put her on par with prodigies in the Immortal Realm.
However, Kent had just broken 28 limits, and it only stopped because of the restrictions of the high world. If and when he becomes an immortal, he can easily break more limits.
"I am a freak of nature." With the joy on his lips, he focused on the soul skill he had awakened.
So far, the only soul skills that aren’t from the soul universe are [Soul Shock], [Soul Torture], and [Soul Shatter], which he had no use for thanks to the soul universe.
Now, it seems he had awakened something good.
[Name: Underworld Soul River]
[Rank: Supreme+]
[Mastery: Perfection+]
[Description: Reach into the underworld and open the gate of your soul river, drowning the souls of all who dare oppose you. All souls drowned become a part of your strength.
NB: The more soul essence harnessed into the skill, the more water you can channel.]
"Looks like this time I have something good." Kent tried to test the skill, but just as he accessed it, he saw something that made him turn it off, his expression turning pale.
"What the fuck?" Kent screamed, gasping for breath.
[Hehe... The master is scared.]
"Hell yeah, I am scared. Who wouldn’t be scared of something like that?" Kent wasn’t even bothered by the fact that the tower just laughed. What he saw left him freaked out beyond his understanding.
"What the hell have I awakened?"
[I believe the master has awakened an innate talent that links to him somehow, or more precisely, a part of his past.]
"So you are saying one of my incarnations used to have this skill?"
[Created it would be more precise.]
"Damn."

chapters.title: Chapter 1293: Coming Back Out
paragraphs: "So are you saying the Underworld Soul River was created by someone, and that person was one of my 13 incarnations?"
[Yes and no. Yes, in the sense that the skill was created by your incarnation. However, no, since he wasn’t the one who created the Underworld River.]
"I need more context, Tower."
[There are many forbidden things in the universe. Those things, as far as the mind could go, are only meant to be used by the Daos to restore balance to the universe.
They are never meant to be possessed by ordinary men. Of course, it wasn’t that ordinary humans can’t use it; it was just that nobody is crazy enough to dare take what belonged to the Dao.
The river you glimpsed is the Underworld River. It is the river that takes all dead souls to the underworld.
This river takes the resentment from the souls it carries and sends their free souls to the underworld, making it the most dangerous place in the underworld, just like the Damned Hell River.
It is a place filled with resentment of endless souls. Under no circumstances would one be able to take it, let alone harness its power, much less make it their own.
However, somehow, someone was able to make a part of their own by turning it into their strength. So yes, the skill was created, but the water belongs to the Dao of Death.]
Kent remained seated, his pale expression not brightening up. He still seems scared, and that alone is enough to tell what he saw.

[Relax, master. What you saw is merely a fraction of the true Underworld Sea. But even so, what will be coming out whenever you use the Underworld Soul River will be restricted to how much your soul can take and how many resentful souls you will be devouring once you start using it.
I know you are scared, but you have nothing to worry about. So instead of worrying, think more about what you can do with this new ability.
It drains a lot of soul essence, but trust me, it will be worth every last soul essence spent.]
"I am not even about to start to think about how crazy I might have been to wake up one day and dare venture into the underworld simply to steal something of the Death Dao."
Kent forced a smile, trying to take his mind off what he had seen and focus on the positive. However, no matter how much he thinks, there is just no way for him to forget what he saw.
In the end, he decided to think about his next step.
[There is no doubt the master would be welcomed chaotically when he goes back out there. This is why I have created the best move to handle them and at least help you gain your footing.]
"Let me hear what you have, Tower."
[At the moment, the master has about 150 Tier 21 (Life Stage) soul spirits. This means the master has enough firepower to commit yet another massacre through soul explosion.
This time, the massacre will be through soul attacks. I believe with this move, the master would not lose precious blood again like did with the Meteor shower.
With enough blood, the master can even create another Blood Life or Death Seal. So what do you think?]
"It is perfect."
Kent nodded to what the tower said. He indeed would be surrounded on all sides. However, with the plan the tower had come up with, if he made a move, the chances of him killing more would be high.
He can even go so far as to kill more than with the meteorites.

"Since I am done here, I might as well go see what I have to deal with." Kent stood up and stretched his body, letting his muscles loosen. After he was done, he deactivated the formation and quickly left the cave.
Soon, he was flying back to the surface.
Meanwhile, on the surface, a sea of beasts could be seen populating the location Kent jumped into the crater. They had been commanded to come by the temple master of Annihilation.
The first loss he had incurred was just too humiliating for him. He wanted to see Kent cornered and struggling; however, in less than 5 minutes, he had lost over 100,000 beasts.
Though the number Kent had killed wasn’t close to wiping 10% of the beasts inside the forest, it was still a huge blow.

During the Primordial Era, Void Temple arrives, and it tries its best to mutate as many beasts, people, and any spirit beings it can. This is to ensure that when it opens, there will be enough army to wreak havoc and steal precious souls to open the Void Gates (Doom Gates).

So, since that was their main objective, they would hate to lose their manpower. So while Kent may have done what he did simply to survive, to them it was an insult, and as such it must be paid in full.
So he sent out twice the number he sent at first, and this time, there are thousands of Death Stage beasts in the mix.
But they aren’t the only monsters after Kent this time. There are 4 Pseudo-Void Beasts with them.

Far from the crater, standing west of where Kent would arrive, is a colossal wolf that seemed to have been made from condensed void matter, 20 meters tall, radiating a corrupted void aura. Its body appears half-real, half-erased, with jagged Claws and Fangs. Its eyes are hollow, and its maw leaks strands of liquid that melt the ground as they fall.
This hideous creature is the Void Howler Beast, one of the beasts whose fangs Kent needed. It is a Peak Death Stage beast that underwent mutation, becoming a Pseudo-Void Beast.
Its hollow gaze was fixed on the location where Kent had jumped into the crater, eagerly awaiting when he would emerge.

On the east stood another terror, a massive serpentine beast with a body wrapped in abyssal ice that seemed to freeze everything closer to it. Its scales resemble cracked glaciers, glowing faintly with deep-sea frost runes.
The Abyssal Frost Serpent had also been deployed.𝙛𝒓𝒆𝙚𝒘𝒆𝓫𝙣𝓸𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝒄𝒐𝓶
But they aren’t the only ones. In the south, the Solar-Pelt Lion of the First Dawn is blazing like a morning sun.
These three beasts Kent needs their fangs for the formation that will take him closer to the edge of the galaxy.

However, standing at the north is the Seven-Horn Nightmare Devastating Shark Beast. It is a colossal shark with a body made from what appears to be metal. Seven massive horns curve backwards from its skull—each etched with ancient runes.
This is the beast Kent initially planned to come to Planet Bayla for. It is his other requirement to become a Sword Emperor.
From what he knows of this beast, only sword-related skills can hurt it.
Now, it had become a Pseudo-Void Beast, and judging by how it was looking in Kent’s direction, it had no holy intention toward him.
This time, he will either fight or flee. However, since he is now in the home of the Void Beasts, there is nowhere to run.
Soon, Kent was only a couple of km away from the surface... "Here we go."
150 Life Stage soul spirits appeared and sped toward the surface. Inside the Void Temple, the master of Annihilation sensed Kent coming, so he got ready to make sure he died today.

chapters.title: Chapter 1294: Soul Explosion
paragraphs: The first time Kent used the [Soul Explosion] ability of his Soul Map was back in the past when he saved Princess Autumn back in the Flame Sea.
She went by Commander Agnes back then. She and her team were ambushed, and only she and one other person survived.

Back then, Kent only exploded two Tier 14 souls, but the result was overwhelming. Kent never expected the aftermath to be that devastating. He used both the physical and the soul aspects in the gory explosion.
Luckily for him, he saw firsthand what potential that ability of his has.
Today, just when he was emerging from the deep crater, he sent forth 150 Tier 21 soul spirits with absolutely no idea what would ensue.
This time, he is only going for a soul attack, meaning the power would be even greater.

He opened the soul map and spread his senses, allowing him to see the 80,000 km radius. The moment that vastness became his to see and control, he teleported the 150 Soul Spirits, spreading them in a way that they covered an 80,000 km radius.
To get the most outcome, he needed to cover a vast area. Luckily, the soul map came in handy for him.
The gap between them was vast, but he knew a Tier 21 soul spirit explosion was akin to a Tier 21 core explosion.
The only difference — and why the Tier 21 soul spirit is stronger — is that when it comes to attacks against the soul, resistance is very hard.
One struggles to defend against soul-based attacks more than physical attacks, so Kent had absolute confidence in this attack.
The moment the soul spirits were teleported to the surface, the beasts sensed it and reacted, attempting to block them. However, Kent was already a step ahead.
"Soul Explosion."
He snapped his finger, and what followed was pure chaos. A blinding white light instantly covered the entire forest, sending out a blinding solar flare that illuminated the air.
In an instant, every sound went silent, despite the soul explosion producing next to no sound. It was a silent explosion filled with so much power.
"What in the hell?" Silent Requiem, one of the Immortal Lords on the outside, muttered, forming a shield around himself, Black Arrow, and Adin.
The moment the light appeared, it illuminated the outside, unleashing a powerful soul attack that even as an Immortal Lord, he felt and reacted to shield himself and the others.
"What was that?" Adin muttered, sweat breaking on his forehead.

"Soul attack." Silent Requiem, who specialises in the soul art, was quick to pick up on the attack, causing the two assassins with him to look worried as they gazed down at the hole that had once again turned dark.
"Would Lord Faceless be okay?" Adin asked in a calm tone, though his shaken voice betrayed his composure.
"He will be fine. I don’t know how, but I believe the attack came from him, so you have nothing to worry about."
Adin nodded.
Meanwhile, back inside the forest, what could be described as utter carnage had taken place, and the bodies littering the ground were a testament.
Within an 80,000 km radius and beyond, regardless of how strong the beast was, they all lay dead, their bodies lying perfectly still as if they had merely fallen asleep.
There were no visible wounds, showing they weren’t attacked physically. However, blood kept flowing from their noses, eyes, mouths, and ears, vanishing into thin air.
Their blood essence was not being spared either. Kent was taking everything from the massacre he had committed.
The soul explosion proved more devastating than he expected. He knew things would be so simple when the soul was concerned, but he never expected this level of annihilation.
He teleported and appeared in the air, watching as thousands of beasts lay dead.
"Looks like I have earned enough blood for my blood cleansing bath," Kent muttered, looking around him inside an 80,000 km radius of his soul map.

[That is indeed true. The master has harvested enough blood for his second blood cleansing bath. However, that can be handled after the battle. There are injured beasts trying to get away, and the master cannot waste precious blood essence.]
Kent smiled and summoned Gaap. The moment the jagged living sword of his appeared, a smirk formed on his lips.
"It is time for you to harvest some resentful souls, Gaap. Make sure to saturate your resentful core before we leave this place."
"I will be sure to do more than that, Lord Kent," Gaap responded, the thick blade trembling slightly.
Deep inside the Void Temple, the demonic-looking temple master burned with rage as he watched the wasted corpse of his beast legion.
He had hoped his second attempt to kill Kent would bear fruit, only for him to be struck again where it hurt the most.

His furious gaze locked on Kent, who instantly sensed the killing intent directed at him and turned to meet his gaze. Although Kent could not see him, he knew the bastard must be burning with rage, so he further taunted him.

"Must really hurt getting your face dragged in the mud twice," Kent laughed. "Even if it doesn’t hurt, considering you might have a thick skin, there is no doubt it would be rather embarrassing to be defeated twice by a mortal.

Of course, you have nothing to be mad about since I plan on killing all the beasts in the forest before I come for you. Know that before I get to you, all beasts under your corruption will fall to my weapons."
The moment Kent finished saying that, his head turned to the west, and he smiled.

He sensed the danger coming, and he knew the shameless temple master had made his third move. The beasts that had fallen were a huge blow to his ego; however, he had an insurance policy for that, too.
From four different directions, four harrowing beasts slowly advanced toward him.

"Looks like we have company." Kent’s cotton-like cloak armour appeared around his body, millions of runes activating within it, turning the ordinary cotton cloak into sturdy armour that rivalled several metallic armours.
Kent tightened his hold of Gaap and looked toward the west.
The Void Howler Beast advanced in silent steps as its hollow eyes gazed deep into Kent’s soul, an untamed fury burning in those sockets.
However, Kent seemed unfazed. Instead, he pointed his sword at it and muttered to the temple master, who was watching everything.
"Thank you for sending them to me early. I will make things quickl"
The moment Kent said that, he disappeared, only to reappear 30 km away from the Void Howler Beast. The other three beasts, seeing that he had isolated one of them, moved at great speed to block him.
However, inside the soul map, Kent is faster than a god.
He lifted his sword into the air and brought it down in a single terrible slash, sending out a 100-meter-wide black crescent sword arc.
At first, when the sword arc left the sword, the Void Howler Beast sensed no threat. However, the moment it gained some ground, it sensed the danger coming and quickly made plans to evade.
However, the [Void Cleave] sword attack had already locked onto its body. There was no evading it, only defending.

But the longer the Void Cleave attack travelled, the stronger it got. So by the time it reached the Void Howler Beast, it had become a terribly strong sword arc, one that the Void Howler Beast never saw coming.

sentences.text: The first time Kent used the [Soul Explosion] ability of his Soul Map was back in the past when he saved Princess Autumn back in the Flame Sea.
She went by Commander Agnes back then.
She and her team were ambushed, and only she and one other person survived.
Back then, Kent only exploded two Tier 14 souls, but the result was overwhelming.
Kent never expected the aftermath to be that devastating.
He used both the physical and the soul aspects in the gory explosion.
Luckily for him, he saw firsthand what potential that ability of his has.
Today, just when he was emerging from the deep crater, he sent forth 150 Tier 21 soul spirits with absolutely no idea what would ensue.
This time, he is only going for a soul attack, meaning the power would be even greater.
He opened the soul map and spread his senses, allowing him to see the 80,000 km radius.
The moment that vastness became his to see and control, he teleported the 150 Soul Spirits, spreading them in a way that they covered an 80,000 km radius.
To get the most outcome, he needed to cover a vast area.
Luckily, the soul map came in handy for him.
The gap between them was vast, but he knew a Tier 21 soul spirit explosion was akin to a Tier 21 core explosion.
The only difference — and why the Tier 21 soul spirit is stronger — is that when it comes to attacks against the soul, resistance is very hard.
One struggles to defend against soul-based attacks more than physical attacks, so Kent had absolute confidence in this attack.
The moment the soul spirits were teleported to the surface, the beasts sensed it and reacted, attempting to block them.
However, Kent was already a step ahead.

He snapped his finger, and what followed was pure chaos.
A blinding white light instantly covered the entire forest, sending out a blinding solar flare that illuminated the air.
In an instant, every sound went silent, despite the soul explosion producing next to no sound.
It was a silent explosion filled with so much power.
"What in the hell?" Silent Requiem, one of the Immortal Lords on the outside, muttered, forming a shield around himself, Black Arrow, and Adin.
The moment the light appeared, it illuminated the outside, unleashing a powerful soul attack that even as an Immortal Lord, he felt and reacted to shield himself and the others.
"What was that?" Adin muttered, sweat breaking on his forehead.

"Soul attack." Silent Requiem, who specialises in the soul art, was quick to pick up on the attack, causing the two assassins with him to look worried as they gazed down at the hole that had once again turned dark.
"Would Lord Faceless be okay?" Adin asked in a calm tone, though his shaken voice betrayed his composure.
"He will be fine.
I don’t know how, but I believe the attack came from him, so you have nothing to worry about."
Adin nodded.

There were no visible wounds, showing they weren’t attacked physically.
However, blood kept flowing from their noses, eyes, mouths, and ears, vanishing into thin air.
Their blood essence was not being spared either.
Kent was taking everything from the massacre he had committed.
The soul explosion proved more devastating than he expected.
He knew things would be so simple when the soul was concerned, but he never expected this level of annihilation.
He teleported and appeared in the air, watching as thousands of beasts lay dead.

The master has harvested enough blood for his second blood cleansing bath.
However, that can be handled after the battle.
There are injured beasts trying to get away, and the master cannot waste precious blood essence.]
Kent smiled and summoned Gaap.
The moment the jagged living sword of his appeared, a smirk formed on his lips.
"It is time for you to harvest some resentful souls, Gaap.
Make sure to saturate your resentful core before we leave this place."
"I will be sure to do more than that, Lord Kent," Gaap responded, the thick blade trembling slightly.
Deep inside the Void Temple, the demonic-looking temple master burned with rage as he watched the wasted corpse of his beast legion.
He had hoped his second attempt to kill Kent would bear fruit, only for him to be struck again where it hurt the most.
His furious gaze locked on Kent, who instantly sensed the killing intent directed at him and turned to meet his gaze.

chapters.title: Chapter 1295: Four Vs One (1)
paragraphs: The [Annihilation Sword] technique that Vexthra gave to Kent has seven forms. So far, Kent had only mastered the first two forms, or more like he had only learned the first two forms.
He was too busy to focus on the other forms, and since he wasn’t always in danger, which required him to go above and beyond, he never bothered to learn.
The first two were enough for him.
[Rapid Slash] is the first form. It allows him to unleash 450 sword arcs with a single swing of his sword. He had already mastered this to perfection, allowing him to unleash all 450 sword arcs.
Although it is a powerful sword skill, it is most useful in large-scale battles. Since not all 450 sword arcs would land on the target, using it against multiple targets is more useful.
Then there is the [Void Cleave] form. This skill is as simple as unleashing a single sword arc, but the longer it moves, the stronger it gets.
The same sword arc will do more damage to a person standing 30km away than 3km.
Of course, Kent realised he had been limiting himself due to his low mastery of the sword. However, the moment he became a sword king, he saw something that had eluded him all this time.

He discovered that it wasn’t just the distance that affected the strength of the void cleave. It had to do with the size of the arc, too. At first, the maximum length of the arc he was able to unleash was 30 meters.
However, now he had unleashed 100 meters. Looking at the Void Cleave tear and fracture the void around its colossal form, he knew there was more to unlock.
The single attack had become a disaster on the move, packed with so much power as it locked on the insidious Void Howler Beast.
It raised its legs and unleashed two powerful attacks, manifesting the claws of a primal beast. However, long before they could close in on the Void Cleave, they fractured and tore apart.
HOWL
The Void Howler Beast howled, raising its strength to the max, and channels of void energy moved through its body toward the two front legs.
This time, it stomped on the ground, causing it to shake. It fractured and spread across the ground for a few seconds before exploding, sending thick beams of obsidian toward the sword arc.
BANG
The void cleave landed on it, creating a loud bang. The defence of the Void Howler Beast turned out to hold this time around. However, a few seconds later, they shattered.
What followed was a powerful bang that sent the Void Howler Beast flying away.
However, Kent had no time to see whether he had killed the Void Howler Beast, considering he was under heavy assault the next second.
From the east, the Abyssal Frost Serpent unleashed a breath of abyssal ice, freezing a trail behind it as it aimed to freeze Kent into an ice popsicle.
He raised his left hand and, tapping into his ice element, commanded thick walls of ice into existence. The beam landed on it, shattering the first few layers.
But at the same time, from the south, a beam of fire came from the Solar-Pelt Lion, causing Kent to unleash a powerful sword arc, cleaving through the fire.
However, before he could retaliate, a shadow fell on him, followed by a surging sea of nightmare-infested water.
"The fuck?" Kent raised his head only to see the Seven-Horn Nightmare Devastating Shark Beast falling on him from above like a mountain.
"Bitch, the fuck is this monstrosity?" Kent channelled energy into his sword and was about to unleash a powerful slash when he suddenly sensed the void tremble a few meters behind him.
CRACK
It cracked, and from within, the Void Howler Beast emerged, a large wound cut into its body. It seemed the void cleave worked as intended, but it had also enraged it.
Now, with a surging sea coming and a raging beast slashing forward with its claws, Kent found himself locked down.
All four beasts were Tier 22 (Death Stage), that is, three realms above Kent. However, he didn’t seem too alarmed by being surrounded.
The Four beasts are calamities of their own uniqueness, yet he seems unbothered.
He waited for the Void Howler Beast’s claw to reach his face. At the same time, the water was less than a meter away.
If he were to be swallowed by this water, he would fall into a nightmare-type illusion. That is the main aspect of the Seven-Horn Nightmare Devastating Shark Beast.
So he waited, and when the time was ripe, he raised his sword and stabbed it into the ground.
"FREEZE."
With an absolute command, the water that was surging toward him stopped mere inches from him, same as the Void Howler Beast.
Its body froze under the freezing power of Kent’s Chaos Ice. He knew he had to use the absolute ice to the max if he wanted maximum effect.
The sea is frozen, and so is the Void Howler Beast.
But he wasn’t done. He didn’t spend this much Ice essence just to freeze a surging sea and a Primordial beast. The main attack came after the freezing.
"EXPLODE."
The moment the word left his lips, the frozen world around him grew colder and then exploded into a bombardment of Ice and carnage.
BOOOOM
The Void Howler Beast’s frozen body burst apart like brittle glass, chunks of void-tainted flesh scattering through the air before dissolving into streams of black mist.
Only its Blood Essence was collected from its terribly exploded body. Kent would have loved to have its blood too, considering it is Tier 22. But that was even frozen and shattered into mist.
However, the tower collected the frozen fangs since those are important to him. After all, they are what he came for.
The sea of water hovering inches from Kent detonated too, blowing outward in a violent whirlpool of frost and steam.
The explosion ripped through the air, shaking a major part of the forest as shockwaves travelled for hundreds of kilometres. Everything in its path was frozen.
The Abyssal Frost Serpent recoiled instantly, sensing the pulse of Chaos Ice tearing through the battlefield.
Its massive body bent unnaturally as it retreated with frightening speed, unwilling to be caught in another one of Kent’s soul-numbing ice detonations.
But Kent wasn’t watching the serpent. He had a much more pressing issue to handle.
His gaze had already shifted upward.
The Seven-Horn Nightmare Devastating Shark Beast was still falling. Its jaws opened wide, revealing a vortex of nightmare qi swirling within its throat.

The seven horns on its skull were dim, showing it wasn’t using them just yet. Kent didn’t know what would happen when they lit up, but he knew only a sword could kill this bastard, so he wasn’t about to use any other skill.

He could turn into his dragon form and easily trash it. However, since killing the Seven-Horn Nightmare Devastating Shark Beast is a requirement that must be fulfilled using the sword, Kent knew it must fall to his sword.
The beast looked like a living calamity, a creature forged entirely for slaughter and corruption. If it swallowed Kent whole, even with his soul immunity, he would still suffer soul damage.
Even if he somehow survives, he would never be the same.
He would lose himself to madness inside its belly, that is, if the acid in its belly didn’t melt him to a puddle upon contact.
Kent planted his foot on the shattered ground, cracked earth racing outward from beneath him.
"Come down then," Kent muttered, tightening his grip on Gaap.

chapters.title: Chapter 1296: Four Vs One (2)
paragraphs: The shark beast dropped like a collapsing mountain, its shadow pressing down on Kent. The stars only know how it was able to jump that high.
However, it was clear was also determined to crash into Kent, and with a body about 600 meters long and several thousand pounds in weight, Kent would be an idiot if he let it fall on him.
"How can there be such colossal beasts in a high world? I thought these were only found in immortal and god worlds," Kent muttered, changing his stance.
He seemed to have a change of mind just when the shadow of the beast had completely enveloped him. Hoping to use blood runes is a foolish move, and so he changed his mind at the last second.
He vanished and reappeared above it, one foot stepping onto the thick hide between its first and second horn. The beast’s singular eye widened, sensing him only after he had already moved.
"Gaap," Kent whispered, his voice calm amidst the chaos.
The jagged blade trembled, releasing a wave of resentful sword aura.
Kent swung downward with a devastating force.
A massive arc of black-red energy ripped into the beast’s skull. However, what Kent anticipated didn’t happen. In fact, it felt more like he had fallen into a trap despite managing to injure it.

Just when his sword sank into the thick skull of the Seven-Horn Nightmare Devastating Shark Beast, a powerful ice-cold tail slash slammed into his back, sending him flying in the direction of the Solar-Pelt Lion, its entire body engulfed in flames.
"Interesting," Kent smirked, watching as his body slammed into a pillar of fire manifested into being by the Solar-Pelt Lion.
Kent’s body tore through the blazing pillar, fire curling around him like ravenous serpents eager to devour his flesh. The Solar-Pelt Lion didn’t hesitate to attack a second time.
It pounced, claws wrapped in molten flames as if it intended to carve Kent into chunks midair.
The perfect coordination between it and the Abyssal Frost Serpent pushed Kent to a corner; however, to their shock, the bastard held a smile on his face.
Just when the claw was inches away, Kent simply rotated once, letting the fire trail along his cloak-like armour, runes flaring violently as they drank in the heat rather than resisted it.
’Looks like breaking four more limits on my body had boosted my speed and strength to unimaginable levels,’
He was body slammed twice just now, but he didn’t seem to feel any pain. And while he didn’t see the first tail attack coming, he saw the second clawed attack, and to be frank, he saw it in slow-mo.
It was like the moment he was struck, his body adjusted to speed, allowing him to see his next attack come at him slowly.
’If I have become this fast without flame veins or the Jade Void Wings, then who knows how fast I would become with all two active’
The crackling flames dimmed around him the moment he stabilised himself. It looked like the stylish cloak, like armour, he had on lived up to its hype.
The armour is a gift from Vexthra, reinforced by Alina.
The amount of runes etched into it is enough to take on an attack from all three beasts without sustaining any injury.
It is also a soul relic, so with enough soul essence, it can repair itself. Naturally, Kent has a universe full of soul essence.
"Tsk. You’re all really trying today," Kent muttered, rolling his shoulder as if the tail strike and flames were nothing more than gentle taps.
The Solar-Pelt Lion roared before its mane erupted, sending burning fragments of solar energy spiralling through the forest like miniature suns falling from the sky.
Each fragment detonated on impact, turning the battlefield into a land of erupting craters. The already formed craters from Kent’s meteor shower were being widened further.
As Kent watched the detonations move toward him, he knew if he didn’t end this fast, he would be in trouble. At this point, he had already seen that all three beasts weren’t his match at all.
He is someone who should be fighting immortals. The level-up and limits broken had increased his strength, speed, stamina, and defence to the point that he was overpowering Death-stage beasts.
He had yet to use his [Flame Veins], [Blood Seals], [Jade Void Wings], [Dragon Wings], [Dragon form], [Flame Element] and [His Flame Technique], yet he is in no way feeling the heat he expected.
He is still holding back, and that alone shows he has become too powerful.
Seeing the flame detonating toward him, he made his move.
"Here we go."

Kent vanished again, reappearing on the lion’s back before the beast could even register his presence. Gaap hummed eagerly in his hand, hungry for blood, hungry for resentment, hungry for something only a battlefield like this could offer.
The blade descended toward the Solar-Pelt Lion’s spine—only for a thick shadow to coil around Kent’s arm like a living chain.
This time, too, Kent didn’t see the attack, something that baffled him. However, while he could have evaded, he let himself be caught since he had made up his mind to kill the serpent first.
The serpent’s icy breath washed over Kent’s body, frost blooming on his armour, freezing the ground with it.
Kent’s entire arm stiffened as the serpent yanked him off the lion’s back and hurled him through the air.

He crashed into a mountain of charred timber, exploding through it and out the other side. If this were before he broke the limits on his body, he would have harnessed blood runes to take on this fall.
But now, he took it like a man.
Kent skidded across the splintered ground, stopping only when he willed himself to stop. But when he came to a stop, he saw all three beasts charging at him from three directions.
And yet, he was smiling.
"Time to kill you all." His grip tightened on Gaap. Then he unleashed his Level 6 Heavenly Blood Sword Aura. In an instant, the entire air turned sharp like a sword.
Kent then tapped into his incomplete sword realm and activated the sword realm he stole from Adrian. Well, Jest stole it, and he inherited.
"Broken Sword Realm."
The moment he activated the sword realm, a vast crimson battlefield under a blood-red sky appeared, changing the environment.
Broken blades littered the ground like gravestones, while countless shattered swords floated in the air, responding to Kent’s intent.
The moment the three beasts were caught inside the domain, their death was sealed in stone.
Kent’s sword aura enveloped the broken swords, causing the thousands of them to activate. What followed was complete annihilation as thousands of swords rained down on the three beasts.

They all tried to defend, raising defences to block the swords. However, after a few minutes of relentless assault, they all succumbed, showing just how dangerous Adrian’s sword realm, which had been copied by Lord Genesis, had become in Kent’s hand.
By the time the sword realm was deactivated, all three beasts had died a rather gruesome death, their bodies littered with countless stab wounds.

And while he didn’t see the first tail attack coming, he saw the second clawed attack, and to be frank, he saw it in slow-mo.
It was like the moment he was struck, his body adjusted to speed, allowing him to see his next attack come at him slowly.
’If I have become this fast without flame veins or the Jade Void Wings, then who knows how fast I would become with all two active’
The crackling flames dimmed around him the moment he stabilised himself.
It looked like the stylish cloak, like armour, he had on lived up to its hype.
The armour is a gift from Vexthra, reinforced by Alina.
The amount of runes etched into it is enough to take on an attack from all three beasts without sustaining any injury.
It is also a soul relic, so with enough soul essence, it can repair itself.
Naturally, Kent has a universe full of soul essence.
"Tsk.
You’re all really trying today," Kent muttered, rolling his shoulder as if the tail strike and flames were nothing more than gentle taps.
The Solar-Pelt Lion roared before its mane erupted, sending burning fragments of solar energy spiralling through the forest like miniature suns falling from the sky.
Each fragment detonated on impact, turning the battlefield into a land of erupting craters.
The already formed craters from Kent’s meteor shower were being widened further.
As Kent watched the detonations move toward him, he knew if he didn’t end this fast, he would be in trouble.
At this point, he had already seen that all three beasts weren’t his match at all.
He is someone who should be fighting immortals.
The level-up and limits broken had increased his strength, speed, stamina, and defence to the point that he was overpowering Death-stage beasts.
He had yet to use his [Flame Veins], [Blood Seals], [Jade Void Wings], [Dragon Wings], [Dragon form], [Flame Element] and [His Flame Technique], yet he is in no way feeling the heat he expected.
He is still holding back, and that alone shows he has become too powerful.
Seeing the flame detonating toward him, he made his move.
"Here we go."
Kent vanished again, reappearing on the lion’s back before the beast could even register his presence.
Gaap hummed eagerly in his hand, hungry for blood, hungry for resentment, hungry for something only a battlefield like this could offer.
The blade descended toward the Solar-Pelt Lion’s spine—only for a thick shadow to coil around Kent’s arm like a living chain.
This time, too, Kent didn’t see the attack, something that baffled him.
However, while he could have evaded, he let himself be caught since he had made up his mind to kill the serpent first.
The serpent’s icy breath washed over Kent’s body, frost blooming on his armour, freezing the ground with it.
Kent’s entire arm stiffened as the serpent yanked him off the lion’s back and hurled him through the air.
He crashed into a mountain of charred timber, exploding through it and out the other side.
If this were before he broke the limits on his body, he would have harnessed blood runes to take on this fall.
But now, he took it like a man.
Kent skidded across the splintered ground, stopping only when he willed himself to stop.
But when he came to a stop, he saw all three beasts charging at him from three directions.
And yet, he was smiling.
"Time to kill you all." His grip tightened on Gaap.
Then he unleashed his Level 6 Heavenly Blood Sword Aura.
In an instant, the entire air turned sharp like a sword.
Kent then tapped into his incomplete sword realm and activated the sword realm he stole from Adrian.
Well, Jest stole it, and he inherited.
"Broken Sword Realm."
The moment he activated the sword realm, a vast crimson battlefield under a blood-red sky appeared, changing the environment.
Broken blades littered the ground like gravestones, while countless shattered swords floated in the air, responding to Kent’s intent.
The moment the three beasts were caught inside the domain, their death was sealed in stone.
Kent’s sword aura enveloped the broken swords, causing the thousands of them to activate.
What followed was complete annihilation as thousands of swords rained down on the three beasts.
They all tried to defend, raising defences to block the swords.
However, after a few minutes of relentless assault, they all succumbed, showing just how dangerous Adrian’s sword realm, which had been copied by Lord Genesis, had become in Kent’s hand.
By the time the sword realm was deactivated, all three beasts had died a rather gruesome death, their bodies littered with countless stab wounds.

chapters.title: Chapter 1297: Battle Royal
paragraphs: Although Kent hadn’t personally made progress in forming his own sword realm, he had found a path that involved stealing the sword realms of others and making them his own.
Of course, it sounded like a terrible idea, since he knew the path to forming his own sword realm would be for him to first steal from others.
It doesn’t sound unique since he would be basing his sword realm on others. The sword realm he would later form would be by merging all the sword realms he had stolen.

He saw how Jest started walking that path, and for now, he knew he, too, would have to walk it. But since Jest had already done it, the only thing left for him now is to recall more of his memories, and he, too, would be able to form his own.
Of course, he knew there was more to it than he was made aware. But that is for later.
Thankfully, he already has three sword realms stolen.
What he never expected, however, was how powerful those sword realms had become under his command.

Compared to what he saw in Jest’s memories when he used the [Broken Sword Realm] just now, the power output was several times stronger. He is now a sword king, but back then, Jest was one too, but he couldn’t command such devastation.
So there shouldn’t have been this much gap between them.
Initially, the plan was to use the sword realm to distract them long enough to unleash the kill move. However, when the broken swords attacked, he saw the shock of his life.
Even the colossal and extremely hard skull-like body of the Seven-Horn Nightmare Devastating Shark Beast was pierced by the broken swords.
It was a very shocking moment, but a welcome one. With this boost, his swordsmanship, which he was worried about, has proven to be much more stable than he expected.
"I’d better take these fangs before more come," Kent swung his sword, and thin lines of sword aura formed and cut the fangs from the Abyssal Frost Serpent and the Solar-Pelt Lion.
He only needed the fangs for those two.
The Seven-Horn Nightmare Devastating Shark Beast was for his swordsmanship requirement trial.

That particular beast was supposed to be devastating, but thanks to his level-up, it was easily killed, to Kent’s shock. Now, after taking what is required of him, he turns and looks in the direction of the Void Tower.
Naturally, he knew he was being stared at by the temple master, so he grinned and spoke.
"Do not have cold feet now, buddy. We are just getting started," Kent pointed his jagged sword in the direction of the void temple.
However, before he could make a sound, the ground started shaking from all sides. As someone who had seen and fought in many beast tides, Kent recognised the danger coming.
The Temple Master of Annihilation didn’t learn his lesson, so he sent more beasts toward Kent.
"Never mind. I will just use this to train before we meet," Kent waited for the first batch of the beasts to appear within range.
"Let’s see how strong the three sword realms in my arsenal have become," he activated the Broken Sword Realm again, manifesting thousands of broken swords.
They trembled, creating clicking sounds as both those in the air and those embedded in the ground stirred, and what followed was a rain of death.
Kent didn’t hold back his assault in the slightest. With thousands of beasts coming his way, the only thing he needed now was to use his swordsmanship to the max.
It is true that his dragon form is his strongest form. However, when it comes to swordsmanship, he is terrifying there as well. He wasn’t known in the past as Lord Genesis for nothing.
His terror with the sword is evident in his single-handed slaughter across the battlefield.
The Broken Sword Realm only covered a 10,000 km radius. Kent could have limited it to just 100 meters or even less; however, with its vastness, everything entering is being killed.
Somewhere within the sword ream, a centipede monster sneakily made its way toward Kent through the ground, hoping to catch him by surprise.

Looking at its aura, it was in no way weaker than the four beasts Kent had just killed. So it was a monster, and slowly it was gaining ground on Kent, unaware that it had already been discovered and that Kent was ready for it as well.
Eventually, just when Kent turned to look to his right since he sensed another powerful presence coming toward him, the centipede burst out from the ground and lunged at him.
However, a smirk formed on Kent’s lips as he tapped into his already prepared skill aimed at ending him.
"Doom Shards"
From the same ground the centipede came from, thousands of doom shards, pointed and shining with deadly intent, burst out and aimed at the centipede.
It sensed the attack and reacted by coiling its body.

Exoskeleton armour appeared on its skin, giving it a metallic shine. The doom shards, pointed and deadly as they may be, bounce off it. However, Kent didn’t seem bothered since his attack wasn’t the doom shard.
That was only meant to distract it long enough to unleash a sword move he had created as the foundation of a sword technique he would be developing in the future.
He trailed his index and middle fingers along the thick and jagged form of his sword, igniting it in green flame. His flame core surged and filled the sword with so much fire.
The moment his fingers came off, he slashed the sword, and a 200-meter-long flame crescent arc flashed out, cutting the centipede in half.
"Still got it," he smiled, but then his left brow twitched.

Kent took a step to his left as if he were merely moving. However, right when he moved, a thick shard made from bone zipped past where he stood a second ago. The bone shard stabbed into a Death Stage Lizard Beast sneaking up on Kent.
Looking ahead, Kent saw a bone dragon standing atop a hill, staring hollowly in his direction.
"Looks eerie," Kent chuckled, and then he waved his hand, sending three Tier 19 Soul Spirits in its direction. Before it could make a move, a terrifying soul explosion enveloped it.
Kent smirked and turned to face a few more dangers coming toward him. However, he quickly jumped backwards, evading yet another bone shard.
He turned and saw the bone dragon standing still, looking at him with the same hollow gaze.
"Well, I didn’t see that coming." Kent furrowed his brow, looking at the bone dragon. "Motherfucker doesn’t have a soul."
Kent jumps and hovers in the air, thousands of doom shards flying and stabbing hundreds of beasts in rapid succession.
"How is that even possible?"
[It has no soul because it is merely a puppet. Somebody or something else is controlling it. I believe the master should be ready for a more advanced form of combat.]
Just when the Tower said that, an extremely large black flag rose into the air from the ground, and a demonic human appeared in front of it, locking eyes with Kent.
