chapters.title: Chapter 1298: Black Flag
paragraphs: The moment Kent set his sights on the black flag, he felt dread. He felt like he was staring at the flag of death. It is tattered, with intricate white markings, some torn by a disgusting hole.
He had never seen anything like it before.

But while that is understandable, considering this is a vast universe, where there are countless unimaginables, the fact that just looking at the flag invokes the fear of death deep within his soul made him feel like something terrible is wrong.
The flag isnt normal at all.
Suddenly, the Bone Dragon became a terror unlike anything Kent had ever met, and he had met quite literal angels...killed even a few.
Then there is the demonic human staring at him.
He looked humanoid but with burning red eyes and a bony expression. He is also taller than 3 meters, with a long, bone-like sword in his firm grip.
The more he looked in Kent’s direction, the more intense the burning sensation in his eyes became.

"Tower, do you know what we are dealing with?" With danger everywhere, Kent didn’t want to move away to get a better look just yet. The fact that he felt fear made him know the flag and the demon human have what it takes to threaten his life.

[The flag looks like a Soul Flag, like the one you have. However, looking at the runes carved on it, this one seems to hold both the soul, living and/or the dead. It is something akin to a living storage but also a furnace.]
"A furnace. That is a new one," Kent slashed his sword back, cutting the head of a spider-demon that lunged from a web woven by thousands of spiders.
Looking ahead, Kent saw more of such spiders crawling and limping from one spiderweb to another toward him. Thousands are being killed, but they keep coming like a tide.
"Why is it a furnace, though, and why is that sucker just staring at me as if I owe him money?" Kent knew the demonic human didn’t show himself and the flag just for fun.
There had to be a reason, one he is not finding. However, he trusts the tower to find it.
For now, his best move was to farm more blood essence since saturating his cores was one of the reasons he came.
The tower had already given him a road map that, if he were to fulfil it before embarking on his journey to Elina’s Galaxy, he might not face too much resistance.

So he keeps killing, and as the pressure mounted, Kent chose to activate the second sword realm he had turned into a sword skill. Jest stole three, and so far, he has only used the first one. However, he saw the need to use the second.
Thankfully, he can use the sword realms like mere sword skills.
"Light Sword Realm"

Beside the [Broken Sword Realm], a light domain appeared, brightening the dull battlefield. However, it wasn’t a single large light like the moon or the stars. Instead, tens of thousands of golden orbs appeared in the air, filling the air with extreme sword intent.
This sword realm was stolen from Sword Saintess Mirily, a sword god from the Golden Realm. She told Jest back then that if and when he reached the god realm, he should come to the Light Sword Temple.
In fact, later, Jest would learn that all the sword realms he had stolen were from people who, against all odds, had risen to the rank of sword gods during the era of Lord Genesis.
They are going to be good friends and later walk the remaining path after Jest reaches the peak, becoming the first Sword Celestial.𝕗𝐫𝚎𝗲𝘄𝐞𝕓𝐧𝕠𝘃𝕖𝐥.𝐜𝚘𝚖
So, using a sword realm of such a legendary figure commands some power.
Kent gestured down, and the orbs transformed into beautiful yet deadly swords. Unlike the Broken Sword Realm, these swords are complete and incredibly dangerous.
They rain down, killing as many as they can while Kent keeps summoning more. With an incomplete sword realm, he was committing a massacre unlike any other.
[Well, it is bad, Master. You remember when I told you that when a person dies, their soul splits into three. Well, that was for mortals who hadn’t formed Spirit Roots yet.

When one who has formed their Spirit Root dies, a part of their soul enters reincarnation. One becomes essence that can be devoured, and the last becomes the Soul Spirit that travels to the Underworld.
However, there are two more. One is the Resentful Soul. This only comes from beings who have killed quite their fair share of beings. The more they kill, the more resentment they absorb.
This can also be absorbed, mostly by soul cultivators walking the demonic path.
However, the most insidious of them all is the Death Soul, which many like to call Death Energy. This one goes straight to Hell. Now guess what the Black Flag is doing.]
Kent didn’t even have to think twice to come up with a logical answer. "Damn. Does it mean the demonic human is using the Death Souls to temper beings inside the flag?"
[I am sure. This is why the master must kill him as soon as possible. Who knows what he planned on doing once he had absorbed enough Death energy?]
Kent looked at the black flag fluttering in the air and then at the demonic human one more time. Around him, a campaign of death is ongoing; thousands of beasts are being slaughtered.
From the south, Kent could sense three dangerous beasts coming. They had already entered the 80,000 km sensing range of the soul map, so he could see them.
"Just what is that bastard scheming?" Kent didn’t want to rush to a conclusion, not when he had just made a small breakthrough.
However, he had already seen to some extent an insidious plan brewing, and he knew the Temple Master of Annihilation had his hand in it.
There is something mysterious about the flag that keeps making him hesitate to act. However, as the Tower said, if he waited long enough, something bad might happen.
This leaves him with only one choice, and that is to confront the demonic human and the black flag.
"Should I unleash Calix and let him handle it?" Kent muttered, considering the idea of letting his soul warrior handle the black flag. However, the idea was quickly wiped from his mind.

He wants to use Calix when he enters the Void Temple. So showing him now is a bad idea. He knew there were 5 temple masters in the Void Temple, and even if one was bone-headed and had mush for a brain, the other four wouldn’t be dumb.

Showing a powerful aid like Calix this early will give them a chance to create countermeasures. Inside the temple, they are basically gods. So his surprise will give them little to no time to prepare.
"That’s it, I will handle it quickly and get back to my slaughter." Kent made up his mind.

Thankfully, the demonic human and the black flag are within the range of his soul map. So the moment he made up his mind, he locked onto the demonic human and teleported, appearing 300 meters away from the flag with sword raised.
"Huh"
Before his shoulder could fall down with a deadly sword slash, Kent felt a terrifying power come from the black flag, grab hold of him, and, without much resistance, he was pulled toward it.
"So it is a trap, and I fell for—" He tried to teleport, but his teleportation power was severed. His body vanished into the flag in the next second.

chapters.title: Chapter 1299: Perfect Trap
paragraphs: Right when Kent was pulled into the flag, he appeared in the air in a rather insidious realm reeking of death and decay.
The entire world looks and smells like a rotting corpse.
Dirty smokes, muddy waters, half-shattered mountains, dying trees, and all kinds of stuff that represent death and decay could be seen there.

Large skulls that could as well come from beast gods and all kinds of abominations littered everywhere, making one wonder just where the black flag came from. It is a shit show, and Kent had stepped into it.

However, while he would love to admire the decayed world and make sense of a few things for a few seconds, the perfect trap set by the Temple Master of Annihilation surrounded him in an airtight circle.
Three True Immortals, seven Core Immortals, and nine Spirit Immortals surrounded him, no friendliness in their hollowed gaze.
Kent found himself surrounded by these people, and what is even more shocking is the fact that all three True Immortals are at the peak.
[Master, it seems the mystery behind the disappearance of the 19 out of the 20 immortals that entered the void forest after it fell has been discovered by you.]
’No shit, Tower, and it looks like they want me dead.’
Kent never expected to be staring at the immortals who tried to discover what caused the fall of the Upside Down Underworld Forest.
They seem to be under some kind of spell after they were killed, of course. Their bodies are basically a vessel for something dark and twisted.
If they are alive, he would have sensed their breath, but it seems all 19 of them are dead.
Kent narrowed his eyes, seeing as 19 channels of death energy keep coming out of nowhere and entering the bodies of the 19 immortals. The more energy they take in, the stronger they get.
’So this is why the bastard remained standing despite me massacring the beasts. He was feeding the death energy to these fools.’ Kent suddenly felt like he had been played.
However, he didn’t let it wound his ego. It instead raised a concerning question.
’If I am now here and my connection to the outside world has been severed, then how come there are still channels of death energy entering these immortals?’
Kent narrowed his eyes, ’Don’t tell me.’𝙧𝙚𝙚𝔀𝒆𝓫𝓷𝙤𝓿𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝙤𝓶
Indeed, his suspicion is spot on.
On the outside, a massacre unlike any other is ongoing between the beasts. They are fighting among themselves and slaughtering each other.
The demonic human remained hovering in the air, the black flag still standing tall. However, the bone dragon is unleashing a barrage of attacks.
But it wasn’t the only death machine on the battlefield. Several other soulless fiends had appeared, and as the seconds go by, the slaughter only seems to intensify.
This time, Kent had found himself in hot soup.
He landed on the ground and looked up at the 19 immortals, jokingly asking, "Is there any way we can make this a one vs one battle?"
He wasn’t even done when one of the Core Immortals moved and appeared before him with a sword, stabbing toward his chest.
"I guess not," Kent twisted his body, forcing the sword to move past him, only for a second attack to come from behind him from yet another Core Immortal.
Up in the air, the remaining 17 immortals, which included the three True Immortals, all lunged at him with deadly intent.
BUZZ
Kent’s body trembled as he unleashed all of his sword intent and Blood Sword aura, filling the air with both Killing Intent and extreme sharpness.
"Endless Sword Domain," he unleashes Jest’s classic sword move. It was one he mostly uses against multiple targets coming at him from multiple directions.
Tiny sword arcs exploded out, tens of thousands of them, each filled with extreme killing intent. All 19 immortals were blasted out, the first two Core Immortals getting cut all over their bodies.
They had no time to raise a defence, so they were injured the most.
However, the moment they stabilised themselves, all injuries on their skin healed at an alarming rate. This sight made Kent frown.
’This is going to be a problem,’ he jumped into the air, meeting the dagger of one of the True Immortals, only for a Core Immortal to slide behind him.
However, Kent didn’t let him get close. Immortals arent exacty normal warriors all. He activated his ice element, freezing his path.
However, before he could take a breather, a flame ball came from behind as one of the True Immortals unleashed a powerful blast from his spear.
The impact melted Kent’s ice, causing the Chaos Dragon to realise he had to put his back into things. The True Immortal had just used a flame that had already reached the ’absolute’ stage.
That alone shows he had no upper hand when an absolute element is involved. Who knows what the other two immortals have up their sleeves?
However, that also didn’t mean he was lacking. There are several immortals he could use it against.
But he cannot be careless with the ice element, since he can run out of ice essence much faster. So he must use it sparingly when he sees a sure opening.
But to make him move ahead of things, he decided to hold back the ice and unleash his flame element instead.
Unlike the ice, which he needs to be careful about how much essence he uses, the flame element is a different ball game.

He has a flame core, which powers his flame attacks, so tracing his finger along the blade of his sword, he unleashed a devastating slash that forced three of the immortals back, allowing Kent a second chance to examine things.
’All True Immortals are close-range fighters. So are the seven Core Immortals and seven Spirit Immortals.’ Kent’s eyes narrowed at the two last remaining Spirit Immortals holding bows.
’One has ice oozing off his body while the other is on fire.’
Kent notes that down and examines his options. ’I must use my sword knowledge to learn their battle style. That would give me enough chance to find out if there are any hidden surprises.’
Kent checked his soul map and saw some openings, but they were too dangerous to exploit, so he would work on it slowly.
Once he finds what he is looking for, he would turn to his demi-dragon (wings, horns, and claws/talons) form and go for the kill.
’Of course, it is easier said than done. With them getting a sturdy supply of death energy, who knows if they can be killed?’
’Simple rules: avoid the archers, keep a close eye on the True Immortals, and find openings in the combat style of the other immortals.’
Kent made up his mind and was about to execute when he suddenly felt the space crack, and a long spear flashed out, aimed directly at his chest.
’I guess Plan B then.’ Kent threw Gaap at one of the True Immortals, and the sword went into combat mode, controlling itself.
In the air, 2,000 swords and 1,000 spears appeared, and they lunged at the immortals. But Kent didn’t hold back anything; his dragon wings, horn, and claws appeared along with 20,000 blood runes.
"Flame Wheels," he activated his movement technique, along with the 50,000 flame veins, to boost his speed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1300: Jade Void Wings Dominate
paragraphs: Plan B is a contingency Kent devised before entering the forest. In the situation where he had to make a last-minute decision if his perfectly crafted plan was thrown into disarray, Plan B would come into play.
Obviously, he never expected there to be a hidden mechanism in this rotten world. He never expected such a deadly attack to come from nowhere.
However, as he narrowly evaded the spear, he knew he’d had to be careful, else his death would come faster than he hoped.
A little mistake can obviously cause a god’s death in the most shocking ways.
So he abandoned the sword and took on the dragon claws, which Kent knew and was confident enough to face the immortals. His claws are gradeless, deadly weapons.
However, nothing prepared him for what happened next. The moment he activated 50,000 flame veins, something rather unexpected happened.
Just when he saw his speed reach a different kind of crazy, one of the True Immortals moved with a single step and slashed his chest with his dagger.
Kent moved back, harnessing his speed; however, the dagger left a deep cut on his chest.
"What the fuck?"𝙛𝒓𝒆𝙚𝒘𝒆𝓫𝙣𝓸𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝒄𝒐𝓶
Kent was struck dumb as he looked at the blood from the cut seep and soak his brown cloak armour. The attack came at a speed he never saw coming, and that shocked him.
However, as he took a moment to observe, he saw three immortal qi surrounding all three True Immortals and two each for the Spirit Immortals. As for the Core Immortals, they each have only one.
’So that is what three immortal qi can do, huh?’ Kent didn’t take his assumptions seriously since he knew these duds were merely brainless puppets on a string.
The real deals who are living and breathing would be much more deadly with even just one immortal Qi. But he was shocked that he sustained such a deep cut from a puppet.
He increased the flame veins to 70,000, which was already too much for such a battle. However, when the three True Immortals moved, he realised he was once again lacking in speed.
This shook Kent greatly. However, he allowed himself to feel the thrill of battle. In an instant, the 16 remaining immortals became insignificant.

The speed at which he and the three True Immortals were moving was just too fast for them to track. Kent was exchanging blows with the three True Immortals to the point that, within a second, he blocked close to 300 attacks and counted them all.
"Thrilling. So this is how it feels to be fast and deadly." Kent let himself see and feel how easy it would be to kill the 16 other immortals.
Although the speed he was going is less than that of the three True Immortals, it gave him a measure of how much he is lacking and what it feels like to be super fast.

"Ah, what the hell?" Kent was pushed back after he managed to seize a dagger from one of the True Immortals. He examined the dagger for a second before storing it away, leaving the immortal with one dagger.

Naturally, that left the poor guy handicapped. However, Kent didn’t care, and from the look of things, the True Immortal didn’t seem to care either since he was already upon him in a fierce stabbing posture.

In less than ten minutes, Kent had sustained dozens of deep cuts. However, he wasn’t the only one injured. He had managed to injure the three True Immortals to the point they chose to move back to heal.
[What do you think, Master?] Tower asked, watching as the Core and Spirit Immortals moved toward Kent.

"It seems that if I want to win against True Immortals who aren’t puppets, I must use all 120,000 flame veins and at least 40,000 blood runes. I might even do more against Void and other era-ending Beasts"
Just when Kent said that, the attacks arrived, but he blinked away and appeared behind one of the Core Immortals. His claws moved and grabbed his head.
"But if the True Immortal has 4 immortal qi, then I must either become a full-on dragon or use the void wings."
Kent gave the head a hard squeeze, smashing it like a watermelon. It exploded, and blood gushed out. However, Kent was long gone before the other immortals arrived on the scene.
[In that case, why not dominate from now onwards? Although the master wished to see how strong he had become, instead of waiting for a powerful opponent, why not use the weaker ones to have fun?]
Kent appeared behind another Core Immortal, and like the first one, he gave his head a hard squeeze, and it exploded.
"That doesn’t sound half bad." The True Immortals closed in on him, but Kent used the soul map again to blink to another target, and for the third time, he exploded his head.
[Let’s try it then]
Kent nodded and suddenly came to a stop, his dragon wings dragging the wind with him. However, just when he stopped, the three True Immortals appeared, each stabbing their weapons at him.
"Too late."
BUZZZZZZZZ

Three pairs of dark metallic wings appeared behind Kent, shattering the void. The three immortals who attacked were blasted back, their bones barely handling the pressure that came from the jade void wings.
Kent instantly felt his speed explode beyond the level the True Immortals could track.
"This is insane." When a Core Immortal moved, Kent saw him in slow-mo.
It was like he had no speed in him. But even more chilling was the fact that Kent could see through him. ’He looks so hollow that I can even move through him.’
To test that theory, he stepped forward and, as expected, he smashed through the Core Immortal, his body exploding into mist.
"Insane." Though invisible to the naked eye, Kent could see a force field made of void essence surround him. This was what caused the Core Immortal to explode.
Kent simply pulled the void through the poor, dead gut, turning him to blood spray.
To test it some more, he targeted the three remaining Core Immortals and moved through them, causing their bodies to explode.
[Go for it, Master. I am collecting their blood essence and blood. Although contaminated by the energy of death, that would be perfect for refining more Blood Life and Deal seals.]
"Very efficient and effective, I guess. In anycase, I like the feeling of walking through people. Kent grinned and took a step forward, pulling 300 km between him and the True Immortals.
"In that case, why not run headfirst into my problems?" Like he had lost his sense of direction, he started exploding their bodies.
The True Immortals tried to intervene, but Kent was moving at a speed none of them could track. In fact, what they were seeing was merely an afterimage of another afterimage.
Kent was just too fast, and the Temple Master of Annihilation could see everything happening. This left him shocked and slightly terrified.
In no time, Kent had killed every last immortal, the True Immortals included. Just when the last of them died, the flag trembled, and Kent appeared on the outside.
SHRINNK
The demonic human was first to go.
